title: Monetary Policy and Sovereign Risk in Emerging Economies (NK-Default)
abstract: This article develops a New Keynesian model with sovereign default risk. Inflation is set by forward-looking firms, monetary policy is an interest rate rule, and the fiscal government borrows externally, long-term, with an option to default. In this framework, default risk creates inflation pressures through an expectations channel, and tight monetary policy disincentivizes fiscal overborrowing. The model sheds light on temporary inflation events in emerging-market data: short-lived spikes in inflation, spreads, and domestic policy rates. As spreads rise, firms increase their prices in expectation of higher future inflation and low consumption during default. Monetary policy tightens, which reduces inflation and helps bring spreads down by disciplining government borrowing. These monetary-fiscal interactions imply that delivering the flexible-prices allocation may not be optimal for monetary policy.
title_cn: 新兴经济体的货币政策与主权风险（NK-Default）

title: Do The Effects of Nudges Persist? Theory and Evidence from 38 Natural Field Experiments
abstract: We formalize a research design to uncover the mechanisms underlying long-term reductions in energy consumption caused by a widely implemented nudge. We consider two channels: technology adoption and habit formation. Using data from 38 natural field experiments, we isolate the role of technology adoption by comparing treatment and control homes after the initial resident moves, which discontinues the treatment for a home. We find that fully half of energy reductions persist in the home after treatment ends and show this persistence is consonant with a technology adoption channel. The role of technology in creating persistent behaviour change has important implications for designing behavioural interventions and evaluating their long-term social impacts.

title: The Macroeconomic Impact of Climate Change: Global Versus Local Temperature
abstract: This article estimates that the macroeconomic damages from climate change are an order of magnitude larger than previously thought. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1ºC warming reduces world GDP by over 20% in the long run. Global temperature correlates strongly with extreme climatic events, unlike country-level temperature used in previous work, explaining our larger estimate. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model. Business-as-usual warming implies a present welfare loss of more than 30%, and a social cost of carbon in excess of $1,200 per ton. These impacts suggest that unilateral decarbonization policy is cost-effective for large countries such as the United States.
title_cn: 气候变化对宏观经济的影响：全球气温与本地气温之别
abstract_cn: 本文估计，气候变化造成的宏观经济损害比此前认为的高出一个数量级。利用全球气温的自然变率，我们发现升温1ºC会使世界GDP在长期内下降超过20%。与以往研究使用的国家层面气温不同，全球气温与极端气候事件强烈相关，这解释了本文估计结果更大的原因。我们利用这一证据在新古典增长模型中估计损害函数。照常情景下的升温意味着超过30%的现值福利损失，以及超过每吨1200美元的碳社会成本。这些影响表明，对于美国等大国而言，单边脱碳政策具有成本效益。

title: Coarse Bayesian Updating
abstract: Studies have shown that the standard law of belief updating—Bayes’ rule—is descriptively invalid in various settings. In this paper, I introduce and analyse a generalization of Bayes’ rule—Coarse Bayesian updating—accommodating much of the empirical evidence. I characterize the model axiomatically, show how it generates several well-known biases, and derive its main implications in static and dynamic settings. Each axiom expresses a property of Bayes’ rule but, conditional on the others, stops just short of making the agent fully Bayesian. The model employs standard primitives, making it suitable for applications; I demonstrate this by applying it to a standard setting of decision under risk, leading to a close relationship with the Blackwell information ordering and comparative measures of cognitive sophistication and bias.
title_cn: 粗粒度贝叶斯更新
abstract_cn: 已有研究表明，标准的信念更新法则——贝叶斯规则——在各种情境下描述性无效。本文引入并分析贝叶斯规则的一个推广——粗化贝叶斯更新——它能够容纳大量经验证据。我以公理化方式刻画该模型，展示其如何生成若干众所周知的偏差，并推导其在静态与动态设定下的主要含义。每条公理都表达了贝叶斯规则的某一性质，但在其他公理给定的条件下，都恰好未使经济主体成为完全贝叶斯式的。该模型采用标准基本参数，因而适合应用；我通过将其应用于风险下决策的一个标准设定来证明这一点，由此得到与 Blackwell 信息序以及认知复杂性和偏差的比较测度之间的密切关系。

title: Narratives about the Macroeconomy
abstract: We study narratives about the macroeconomy—the stories people tell to explain macroeconomic phenomena—in the context of a historic surge in inflation. In our empirical analysis, we field surveys with more than 10,000 U.S. households and 100 academic experts, measure economic narratives in open-ended questions, and represent them as directed acyclic graphs. Households’ narratives are strongly heterogeneous, coarser than experts’ narratives, focus more on the supply than the demand side, and often feature politically charged explanations. Moreover, narratives shape how households form inflation expectations and interpret new information, which we demonstrate in a series of experiments. Informed by these findings, our theoretical analysis incorporates narratives into an otherwise conventional New Keynesian model and demonstrates their importance for aggregate outcomes through their effect on agents’ expectations.
title_cn: 关于宏观经济的叙事
abstract_cn: 我们研究关于宏观经济的叙事，即人们为解释宏观经济现象而讲述的故事，并将其置于通胀历史性飙升的背景下。在实证分析中，我们对超过1万户美国家庭和100位学术专家开展了调查，在开放式问题中测度经济叙事，并将其表示为有向无环图。家庭的叙事高度异质，比专家的叙事更为粗略，更多聚焦于供给侧而非需求侧，且常常带有政治化的解释。此外，叙事塑造了家庭形成通胀预期以及解读新信息的方式，我们通过一系列实验对此进行了证明。基于这些发现，我们的理论分析将叙事纳入一个其他方面均属常规的新凯恩斯主义模型，并证明叙事通过影响经济主体的预期而对总量结果具有重要性。

title: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
abstract: We estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jointly. Notable exceptions are income and the average propensity to consume, which correlate positively with the MPC. Household observable characteristics explain only 8% of MPC variation, highlighting the role of latent heterogeneity.

title: Decision Theory for Treatment Choice Problems with Partial Identification
abstract: We apply classical statistical decision theory to a large class of treatment choice problems with partial identification. We show that, in a general class of problems with Gaussian likelihood, all decision rules are admissible; it is maximin-welfare optimal to ignore all data; and, for severe enough partial identification, there are infinitely many minimax-regret optimal decision rules, all of which sometimes randomize the policy recommendation. We uniquely characterize the minimax-regret optimal rule that least frequently randomizes, and show that, in some cases, it can outperform other minimax-regret optimal rules in terms of what we call profiled regret. We analyse the implications of our results in the aggregation of experimental estimates for policy adoption, extrapolation of Local Average Treatment Effects, and policy making in the presence of omitted variable bias.
title_cn: 部分识别下处理选择问题的决策理论
abstract_cn: 我们将经典统计决策理论应用于一大类具有部分识别特征的处理选择问题。我们证明，在具有高斯似然的一般问题类别中，所有决策规则都是可容许的；忽略所有数据在极大极小福利意义下是最优的；并且，当部分识别程度足够严重时，存在无穷多个极小极大后悔最优决策规则，这些规则有时都会对政策建议进行随机化。我们唯一地刻画了随机化频率最低的极小极大后悔最优规则，并表明在某些情形下，该规则在我们所称的剖面后悔（profiled regret）方面可以优于其他极小极大后悔最优规则。我们分析了本文结果在以下方面的含义：为政策采纳而进行的实验估计的加总、局部平均处理效应的外推，以及存在遗漏变量偏误时的政策制定。

title: Civil War–Induced Displacement and Human Capital
abstract: We study the effect of conflict-induced displacement on human capital and occupational shifts, focusing on the Mozambican civil war (1977–1992), during which millions of civilians were forced to flee to the countryside, cities, and neighboring countries. Reconstructing the wartime mobility histories of the surviving population, we examine the consequences of multiple displacement trajectories in a unified framework. First, we characterize the education and sectoral employment of the universe of (non-)displaced. Second, we exploit differences in relocation trajectories among extended kin members during their schooling years. Displacement is associated with significant gains in education. Third, using a movers design, we show that minors displaced earlier to better districts experienced an increase in educational attainment. Focusing on moves during the intensification of the war and when comparing members of the same household, regional childhood exposure effects remain strong, whereas spatial sorting becomes negligible. Fourth, we jointly estimate place-based, spatial sorting, and uprootedness effects, showing that all forces are at play. Fifth, a small survey in Mozambique’s largest northern city reveals long-term effects: internally displaced people report higher education than their siblings who stayed behind but lower social capital and worse mental health relative to locals. Our findings demonstrate that displacement shocks can foster human capital accumulation, even in very low-income settings, albeit at the cost of enduring social and psychological traumas.
title_cn: 内战引发的流离失所与人力资本
abstract_cn: 我们研究冲突导致的流离失所对人力资本和职业转换的影响，聚焦于莫桑比克内战（1977—1992年），期间数百万平民被迫逃往农村、城市和邻国。通过重建幸存人口在战时的迁移史，我们在一个统一框架下考察多种流离失所轨迹的后果。第一，我们刻画了全体（非）流离失所者的教育和部门就业状况。第二，我们利用扩展家庭成员在求学期间迁移轨迹的差异。流离失所与教育方面的显著收益相关。第三，采用迁移者设计，我们表明较早迁往更好地区的未成年人受教育程度有所提高。聚焦于战争加剧期间的迁移，并在比较同一家庭成员时，地区性童年暴露效应依然很强，而空间排序变得可以忽略。第四，我们联合估计基于地点的效应、空间排序效应和连根拔起效应，表明所有这些力量都在起作用。第五，在莫桑比克北部最大城市进行的一项小型调查揭示了长期效应：境内流离失所者报告的教育程度高于留在原地的兄弟姐妹，但相对于当地人，其社会资本更低、心理健康更差。我们的发现表明，流离失所冲击能够促进人力资本积累，即使在收入极低的环境中也是如此，尽管代价是持久的社会和心理创伤。

title: Disaggregated Economic Accounts
abstract: We develop a system of disaggregated economic accounts. The system breaks down national accounting positions into bilateral flows between consistently defined groups of consumers (consumer cells), groups of producers (producer cells), the government, and the rest of the world. We disaggregate the full circular flow of money, including consumer spending, labor compensation, firm profits, intermediates trade, foreign trade, and government transactions, while satisfying all national accounting identities. We implement the disaggregated system for small region-by-industry cells in Denmark and present stylized facts, such as variation in domestic spending, local and urban bias in consumer spending, and a pattern of triangular flows across regions. Cell-level measures of spending intensity capture how much spending by a cell contributes to the income of cells experiencing unemployment after a shock. Using a general equilibrium model, we show that fiscal transfers raise aggregate GDP by more when they target cells with high spending intensity on unemployed cells. The disaggregated economic accounts help governments select more effective policies.
title_cn: 分项经济账户
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个分解式经济核算体系。该体系将国民核算头寸分解为定义一致的消费者组（消费者单元）、生产者组（生产者单元）、政府与世界其他地区之间的双边流动。我们分解了货币的完整循环流动，包括消费者支出、劳动报酬、企业利润、中间品贸易、对外贸易和政府交易，同时满足所有国民核算恒等式。我们在丹麦按小区域—行业单元实施了这一分解体系，并呈现了一些典型事实，例如国内支出的差异、消费者支出中的本地与城市偏向，以及跨区域的三角流动模式。单元层面的支出强度指标刻画了一个单元的支出在冲击后对经历失业的单元的收入贡献程度。利用一般均衡模型，我们表明，当财政转移支付瞄准对失业单元具有高支出强度的单元时，其提升总体 GDP 的幅度更大。分解式经济核算有助于政府选择更有效的政策。

title: Organizational Change and Reference-Dependent Preferences
abstract: Reference-dependent preferences can explain several puzzling observations about organizational change. We introduce a dynamic model in which a firm bargains with loss-averse workers about organizational change and wages. We show that change is often stagnant or slow for many periods, followed by a sudden boost in productivity triggered by a crisis. In a crisis, workers concede to organizational change but resist nominal wage reductions. In addition, the model explains why different firms in the same industry often have significant productivity differences. Finally, the model demonstrates the importance of expectations management even if all parties have rational expectations.
title_cn: 组织变革与参照依赖偏好
abstract_cn: 参照依赖偏好可以解释关于组织变革的若干令人困惑的观察。我们引入一个动态模型，其中企业与损失厌恶的劳动者就组织变革和工资进行谈判。我们表明，变革往往在多个时期内停滞或缓慢推进，随后由危机触发生产率突然提升。在危机中，劳动者会接受组织变革，但抵制名义工资削减。此外，该模型解释了为何同一行业中的不同企业往往存在显著的生产率差异。最后，该模型表明，即使所有各方都具有理性预期，预期管理仍然十分重要。

title: Insuring Peace: Index-Based Livestock Insurance, Droughts, and Conflict
abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of how an innovative market-based solution using remote-sensing technology can mitigate drought-induced conflict. Droughts are a major driver of conflict in Africa, particularly between transhumant pastoralists and sedentary farmers. Index-Based Livestock Insurance (IBLI), a program piloted in Kenya, provides automated, preemptive payouts to pastoralists affected by droughts. Combining variation in rainfall and the staggered rollout of IBLI in Kenya over 2000–2020, we find that IBLI strongly reduces drought-induced conflict. Key mechanisms include a reduction in herd sizes, as well as income smoothing and asset price stabilization, contributing to an overall reduced migratory pressure for pastoralists. Our study suggests that market-based solutions are a scalable, cost-effective pathway to mitigate conflict, complementing political solutions such as power-sharing agreements and institutional reforms.
title_cn: 为和平提供保险：指数型牲畜保险、干旱与冲突
abstract_cn: 我们提供了准实验证据，说明一项利用遥感技术的创新性市场化方案如何缓解干旱引发的冲突。干旱是非洲冲突的主要驱动因素，尤其是游牧牧民与定居农民之间的冲突。指数型牲畜保险（IBLI）是一项在肯尼亚试点实施的项目，向受干旱影响的牧民提供自动化、预防性的赔付。结合降雨变化与2000—2020年间IBLI在肯尼亚的交错推广，我们发现IBLI显著减少了干旱引发的冲突。关键机制包括牲畜规模缩小，以及收入平滑和资产价格稳定，从而总体上降低了牧民的迁移压力。我们的研究表明，市场化方案是缓解冲突的一条可扩展、成本有效的路径，可补充权力分享协议和制度改革等政治解决方案。

title: Gender Differences in Economics Seminars
abstract: We assess whether men and women are treated differently when presenting their economics research. We collected data across thousands of seminars, job market talks, and conference presentations, leveraging human judgment and audio-processing algorithms to measure the number, tone, and type of interruptions. Within a seminar series, women are interrupted more than men. This holds when controlling for characteristics of the presenter, paper, and audience. Interruptions that are negative in tenor or tone or cut off the presenter mid-sentence increase for women presenters. We also find greater engagement of female audience members with female presenters, suggesting a potential role model effect. (JEL A11, C45, J16, J44)
title_cn: 经济学研讨会中的性别差异
abstract_cn: 我们评估男性和女性在展示其经济学研究时是否受到不同对待。我们收集了数千场研讨会、求职报告和会议报告的数据，利用人工判断和音频处理算法测量打断的次数、语气和类型。在同一系列研讨会中，女性比男性被更频繁地打断。在控制报告人、论文和听众特征后，这一结果依然成立。对于女性报告人，语气或语调为负面、或在句子中途打断报告人的打断行为有所增加。我们还发现女性听众对女性报告人的参与度更高，提示可能存在榜样效应。（JEL A11, C45, J16, J44）

title: A Theory of Supply Function Choice and Aggregate Supply
abstract: Modern theories of aggregate supply are built on the foundation that firms set prices and commit to producing whatever the market demands. We remove this strategic restriction and allow firms to choose supply functions, mappings that describe the prices charged at each quantity of production. Theoretically, we characterize firms’ optimal supply function choices in general equilibrium and study the resulting implications for aggregate supply. Aggregate supply flattens under lower inflation uncertainty, higher idiosyncratic demand uncertainty, and less elastic demand. Quantitatively, our theory can rationalize the flattening of aggregate supply during the Great Moderation and steepening during the 1970s and 2020s. (JEL D21, D43, E13, E23, E31, E32)
title_cn: 供给函数选择与总供给的理论
abstract_cn: 现代总供给理论建立在一个基础之上：企业设定价格并承诺按市场需求生产任意数量。我们取消这一策略性限制，允许企业选择供给函数，即描述每一产量水平上所收取价格的映射。在理论上，我们在一般均衡中刻画了企业最优供给函数的选择，并研究了其对总供给的含义。在通胀不确定性较低、个体特异性需求不确定性较高以及需求弹性较低时，总供给曲线趋于平坦。在定量上，我们的理论能够解释大稳健时期总供给的平坦化以及20世纪70年代和2020年代的陡峭化。（JEL D21, D43, E13, E23, E31, E32）

title: Work from Home and the Office Real Estate Apocalypse
abstract: We show remote work led to large drops in lease revenues, occupancy, and market rents in the commercial office sector. We revalue New York City office buildings, taking into account both the cash flow and discount rate implications of these shocks, and find a 46 percent decline in long-run value. For all US office markets combined, we find a $556.8 billion value destruction. Higher-quality buildings were buffered against these trends due to a flight to quality, while lower-quality offices are at risk of becoming a stranded asset. These valuation changes have repercussions for financial stability and local public finances. (JEL E31, E32, G12, J22, M51, R33)
title_cn: 居家办公与写字楼房地产的末日
abstract_cn: 我们表明，远程办公导致商业办公部门的租赁收入、入住率和市场租金大幅下降。我们对纽约市办公楼进行重新估值，同时考虑这些冲击对现金流和折现率的影响，发现长期价值下降46%。对于美国所有办公市场合计，我们发现价值毁损达5568亿美元。由于“向优质资产转移”，较高质量的建筑受到缓冲，而较低质量的办公楼则面临成为搁浅资产的风险。这些估值变化对金融稳定和地方公共财政具有影响。(JEL E31, E32, G12, J22, M51, R33)

title: Consumer Credit and the Incidence of Tariffs: Evidence from the Auto Industry
abstract: Captive finance subsidiaries create a channel for trade policy to affect consumer credit. Examining the impact of the Trump administration’s metal tariffs on captive automobile lenders, we find that consumers received higher interest rates from captive lenders after the tariffs relative to unaffected noncaptive lenders. Further, we document a disparate impact on low-income borrowers and in areas with less lending competition. Our results suggest that tariffs may impact not only the price of goods but also the financing terms of purchases. Thus, focusing solely on directly affected product prices may underestimate tariff pass-through significantly. (JEL F13, F14, G21, L22, L61, L62)
title_cn: 消费者信贷与关税的归宿：来自汽车行业的证据
abstract_cn: 专属金融子公司为贸易政策影响消费者信贷创造了一个渠道。通过考察特朗普政府金属关税对汽车专属贷款机构的影响，我们发现，相对于未受影响的非专属贷款机构，消费者在关税实施后从专属贷款机构获得了更高的利率。此外，我们记录了其对低收入借款人和贷款竞争较弱地区的不成比例影响。我们的结果表明，关税可能不仅影响商品价格，还影响购买的融资条件。因此，仅关注直接受影响的产品价格可能显著低估关税传导。（JEL F13, F14, G21, L22, L61, L62）

title: Take the Goods and Run: Contracting Frictions and Market Power in Supply Chains
abstract: This paper studies the efficiency of self-enforced relational agreements, a common solution to contracting frictions, when sellers have market power and contracts cannot be externally enforced. To this end, I develop a dynamic contracting model with limited enforcement in which buyers can default on their trade credit debt and estimate it using a novel dataset from the Ecuadorian manufacturing supply chain. The key empirical finding is that bilateral trade is inefficiently low in early periods of the relationship, but converges toward efficiency over time, despite sellers’ market power. Counterfactual simulations imply that both market power and enforcement contribute to inefficiencies in trade. (JEL D86, G32, K12, L14, L60, O14)
title_cn: 带着货物跑路：供应链中的合同摩擦与市场势力
abstract_cn: 本文研究自我实施的关系型协议的效率，此类协议是契约摩擦的一种常见解决方案，研究情形为卖方具有市场势力且契约无法由外部强制执行。为此，我构建了一个带有有限执行力的动态契约模型，其中买方可以对其贸易信贷债务违约，并使用来自厄瓜多尔制造业供应链的一个新数据集对该模型进行估计。关键的经验发现是，在关系的早期阶段，双边贸易低效地偏低，但尽管卖方具有市场势力，贸易随时间推移会趋近于效率水平。反事实模拟表明，市场势力和执行力都会导致贸易中的低效率。（JEL D86、G32、K12、L14、L60、O14）

title: Competition under Incomplete Contracts and the Design of Procurement Policies
abstract: We study the effects of intensifying competition for contracts in the context of US Defense procurement. Leveraging a discontinuous regulation that mandates agencies to publicize certain contract opportunities, we document that expanding the set of bidders reduces award prices but deteriorates post-award performance in terms of cost overruns and delays. We develop and estimate an auction model with endogenous entry and stochastic execution performance, in which the buyer endogenously chooses the intensity of competition. Model estimates indicate substantial heterogeneity in performance across contractors and show that simple adjustments to the current regulation could provide significant savings in procurement spending. (JEL D22, D24, D44, D82, D86, H56, H57)
title_cn: 不完全合同下的竞争与采购政策设计
abstract_cn: 我们研究美国国防采购中合同竞争加剧的影响。利用一项要求机构公开某些合同机会的不连续监管规定，我们发现，扩大投标人集合会降低授标价格，但会恶化授标后的履约表现，具体体现为成本超支和延迟。我们构建并估计了一个包含内生进入和随机履约表现的拍卖模型，其中买方内生选择竞争强度。模型估计表明，承包商之间的履约表现存在显著异质性，并显示对现行监管规定作简单调整即可在采购支出上带来显著节约。（JEL D22, D24, D44, D82, D86, H56, H57）

title: “Potential” and the Gender Promotion Gap
abstract: We show that subjective assessments of employee “potential” contribute to gender gaps in promotion and pay. Using data on 29,809 management-track employees from a large retail chain, we find that women receive substantially lower potential ratings despite receiving higher performance ratings. Differences in potential ratings account for approximately half of the gender promotion gap. Women’s lower potential ratings do not reflect accurate forecasts of future performance: Women subsequently outperform male colleagues, both on average and on the margin of promotion. We highlight two mechanisms driving the gender potential gap: strategic retention and stereotyping. (JEL J16, J31, J71, L81, M12, M51)
title_cn: “潜力”与性别晋升差距
abstract_cn: 我们表明，对员工“潜力”的主观评估会加剧晋升和薪酬中的性别差距。利用一家大型零售连锁企业29,809名管理通道员工的数据，我们发现，尽管女性的绩效评分更高，但其潜力评分却显著更低。潜力评分的差异大约解释了性别晋升差距的一半。女性较低的潜力评分并不反映对未来绩效的准确预测：女性随后在平均意义上以及在晋升边际上都优于男性同事。我们强调驱动性别潜力差距的两个机制：策略性留任与刻板印象。(JEL J16, J31, J71, L81, M12, M51)

title: Raising the Stakes: Physician Facility Investments and Provider Agency
abstract: Principal-agent problems often extend beyond what can be directly addressed through conventional incentive arrangements. We examine a context where physicians are likely under-incentivized to minimize total medical costs until their private financial interests align with those of patients. Leveraging novel data on physician ownership of ambulatory surgery centers——that is, same-day facilities——we show that these equity holdings cause a substitution away from higher cost, rival settings that lowers Medicare spending by 10–40 percent per physician. We find no clear evidence of perverse behavior following these investments. Instead, our findings demonstrate how entrepreneurial activity can indirectly limit principal-agent problems and improve efficiency. (JEL D82, D91, G51, I11, I18, L84)
title_cn: 提高赌注：医生设施投资与医疗服务提供者代理
abstract_cn: 委托—代理问题往往超出传统激励机制安排所能直接解决的范围。我们考察了这样一个情境：在医生的私人财务利益与患者利益一致之前，医生可能缺乏足够激励去最小化医疗总成本。利用关于医生持有门诊手术中心——即当日手术设施——所有权的新颖数据，我们表明这些股权持有导致从成本更高的竞争性场所转向，从而使每位医生的 Medicare 支出降低 10%–40%。我们未发现这些投资之后出现不当行为的确凿证据。相反，我们的发现表明，创业活动可以间接限制委托—代理问题并提高效率。（JEL D82, D91, G51, I11, I18, L84）

title: Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility
abstract: We argue that consumer credit spreads matter for household choices and that time-varying spreads have important distributional consequences. Studying Danish household data, we show that consumer credit spreads have heterogeneous impact on asset dynamics and consumption choices across the wealth distribution and that time-varying spreads induce a countercyclical marginal propensity to consume. We study a HANK model where banks provide consumer credit and corporate loans. Through countercyclical credit spreads, frictional finance amplifies aggregate shocks and induces consumption inequality. Economies with less leveraged banks experience reduced aggregate volatility but may face higher volatility and lower welfare at the household level. (JEL D12, D31, E12, E21, E32, E52, G51)
title_cn: 金融摩擦：微观波动与宏观波动
abstract_cn: 我们认为，消费信贷利差会影响家庭选择，而随时间变化的利差具有重要的分配后果。基于丹麦家庭数据，我们表明消费信贷利差对资产动态和消费选择的影响在财富分布上具有异质性，且随时间变化的利差会引致逆周期的边际消费倾向。我们研究了一个由银行提供消费信贷和企业贷款的HANK模型。通过逆周期信贷利差，摩擦性金融放大了总量冲击并引致消费不平等。银行杠杆较低的经济体总量波动性降低，但可能在家庭层面面临更高的波动性和更低的福利。（JEL D12, D31, E12, E21, E32, E52, G51）

title: Evaluating the Impact of Urban Transit Infrastructure: Evidence from Bogotá’s TransMilenio
abstract: This paper estimates the effects of improving public transit infrastructure on city structure and welfare. It develops a quantitative urban model with multiple worker groups and transit modes, and derives a special case yielding sufficient statistics for aggregate welfare in a broad class of models. The paper estimates reduced-form elasticities to implement the approach using data spanning construction of the world’s largest Bus Rapid Transit system in Bogotá, Colombia. This class of models explains observed adjustments in economic activity. Standard value-of-time calculations capture only 52 percent of welfare gains. Accounting for reallocation and general equilibrium effects, distributional impacts are modest. (JEL H76, L92, L98, O18, R42, R53)
title_cn: 评估城市公共交通基础设施的影响：来自波哥大TransMilenio的证据
abstract_cn: 本文估计了改善公共交通基础设施对城市结构与福利的影响。本文构建了一个包含多个劳动者群体和多种交通方式的量化城市模型，并推导出一个特殊情形，该情形可为一大类模型中的总量福利提供充分统计量。本文利用哥伦比亚波哥大建设全球最大快速公交系统期间的数据，估计简约式弹性以实施该方法。这一类模型能够解释所观测到的经济活动调整。标准的统计生命价值计算仅捕捉到福利收益的52%。在考虑重新配置和一般均衡效应后，分配影响较为有限。(JEL H76, L92, L98, O18, R42, R53)

title: Dynamic Regulation with Firm Linkages: Evidence from Texas
abstract: We evaluate the efficiency of dynamic linked environmental regulation. Linked regulation allows inspectors who uncover violations at one plant to increase future enforcement at other plants that share a common owner. When compliance costs are correlated, regulators can then target scarce enforcement resources towards bad actors without inspecting everyone. We develop an empirical framework of dynamic moral hazard under linked regulation that allows for large portfolios of plants and for choices to be interdependent within the portfolio of plants and across time. Using the framework we evaluate a linked regulation scheme in Texas and find that linked regulation performs substantially better than both unlinked regulation and untargeted regulation. We test two alternative theoretical mechanisms that underpin the benefit—a “firm-wide moral hazard mechanism” and a “correlated targeting mechanism”—and find that a large share of the value of linked regulation is due to the former.
title_cn: 具有企业关联的动态监管：来自得克萨斯的证据
abstract_cn: 我们评估动态关联环境监管的效率。关联监管允许在一家工厂发现违规行为的检查员加强对同一所有者名下其他工厂的未来执法。当合规成本相关时，监管者便可无需检查所有工厂，而将稀缺的执法资源集中于违规主体。我们构建了一个关联监管下动态道德风险的经验框架，该框架允许工厂组合规模较大，并允许工厂组合内部以及跨期的选择相互依赖。利用该框架，我们评估了得克萨斯州的一项关联监管方案，发现关联监管的表现显著优于非关联监管和无针对性监管。我们检验了支撑其收益的两种替代性理论机制——“全企业道德风险机制”和“相关 targeting 机制”——并发现关联监管价值的很大一部分来自前者。

title: A Theory of How Workers Keep up with Inflation
abstract: We develop a model that integrates modern theories of labor market flows with nominal wage rigidities to study the consequences of inflation on the labor market. Nominal wage stickiness incentivizes workers to engage in job-to-job transitions after an unexpected increase in the price level. Such dynamics lead to a rise in aggregate vacancies associating a seemingly tight labor market with lower real wages—two facts observed during the recent inflation period. The calibrated model jointly matches aggregate and cross-sectional trends in worker flows and wages during the 2021–2024 period. Using historical data, we show that prior periods of high inflation were also associated with increasing vacancies and upward shifts in the Beveridge curve. Our results suggest that policy makers and academics should be cautious about viewing the rise in the vacancy-to-unemployment rate as a sign of a tight labor market during inflationary periods without holistically looking at other labor market indicators.
title_cn: 工人如何跟上通胀的理论
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，将现代劳动力市场流动理论与名义工资刚性相结合，以研究通胀对劳动力市场的影响。名义工资粘性会激励劳动者在价格水平意外上升后从事工作间转换。这种动态导致总职位空缺上升，使看似紧张的劳动力市场与更低的实际工资并存——这是近期通胀时期观察到的两个事实。校准后的模型能够同时匹配2021—2024年期间劳动者流动和工资的总量与横截面趋势。利用历史数据，我们表明此前的高通胀时期同样伴随着职位空缺增加和贝弗里奇曲线的上移。我们的结果表明，政策制定者和学者在通胀时期不应将职位空缺与失业率之比上升视为劳动力市场紧张的信号，而不综合考虑其他劳动力市场指标。

title: Automation and Rent Dissipation: Implications for Wages, Inequality, and Productivity
abstract: This article studies the effects of automation in a task-based economy in which some jobs pay workers rents—wages above workers' outside options. We show that automation targets high-rent tasks, dissipating rents, amplifying wage losses, and reducing within-group wage dispersion in exposed groups. This form of rent dissipation is inefficient and offsets the productivity gains from automation. Using U.S. data from 1980 to 2016, we find evidence of sizable rent dissipation and reduced within-group wage dispersion due to automation. Automation accounts for 52% of the increase in between-group inequality since 1980, with rent dissipation explaining one-fifth of this total. Our estimates imply that inefficient rent dissipation has offset 60%–90% of the productivity gains from automation over this period.
title_cn: 自动化与租金耗散：对工资、不平等和生产率的影响
abstract_cn: 本文研究任务型经济中的自动化效应，其中部分岗位向劳动者支付租金，即高于劳动者外部选项的工资。我们表明，自动化瞄准高租金任务，消散租金，放大工资损失，并降低受影响群体内部的工资离散度。这种形式的租金消散是无效率的，并抵消了自动化带来的生产率收益。利用美国1980年至2016年的数据，我们发现了租金消散规模可观以及自动化导致群体内工资离散度下降的证据。自动化解释了1980年以来群体间不平等上升的52%，其中租金消散解释了这一总量的五分之一。我们的估计意味着，无效率的租金消散在此期间抵消了自动化带来的生产率收益的60%–90%。

title: Education and the Margins of Cyclical Adjustment in the Labour Market
abstract: Allocative wages—the labour costs considered when deciding to form or dissolve a long-term employment relationship—are more sensitive to cyclical conditions for more educated workers. Specifically, college-educated workers’ allocative wages are highly pro-cyclical, while high school dropouts’ wages exhibit only moderate cyclicality. Further, as education increases, an increasing share of the sensitivity of allocative wages is driven by the persistent scarring effects of the cyclical position at the time of hiring on the wages associated with higher levels of tenure, amounting to more than a third of the overall sensitivity for the college educated. The greater job stability of the more educated—and therefore the exposure to scarring—contributes to these differences. In addition, more significant scarring at each horizon of tenure amplifies the effect. In service of documenting these facts, I develop new methods for inferring the sensitivity of labour costs to shocks when agents are forward-looking and wages may be intertemporally smoothed.
title_cn: 教育与劳动力市场周期性调整的边际
abstract_cn: 配置工资——即在决定建立或解除长期雇佣关系时考虑的劳动成本——对周期性状况的敏感度在受教育程度更高的劳动者中更强。具体而言，大学学历劳动者的配置工资具有高度顺周期性，而高中辍学者的工资仅表现出温和的周期性。此外，随着受教育程度提高，配置工资敏感度中越来越大的份额由以下因素驱动：招聘时的周期性状况对更高任职工资水平产生的持续性创伤效应，这一部分在大学学历劳动者中占总体敏感度的三分之一以上。受教育程度更高者更强的工作稳定性——从而对创伤效应的暴露程度——促成了这些差异。此外，在每个任职期限内更显著的创伤效应放大了这一效应。为记录这些事实，我开发了新的方法，用于在经济主体具有前瞻性且工资可能跨期平滑的情况下推断劳动成本对冲击的敏感度。

title: Investing in Influence: Investors, Portfolio Firms, and Political Giving
abstract: We examine how the rise of institutional ownership has influenced firms’ political activities. We find that, after the acquisition of a large stake, a firm’s political action committee giving mirrors more closely that of the acquiring investor. Consistent with a causal interpretation, this pattern is also observed for acquisitions driven by new index inclusions. The pattern is stronger when firms’ management faces contentious proposals in shareholder meetings and may thus need institutional investors’ support. We further show that firms’ giving shifts away from business-relevant politicians and is strongly aligned with the individual campaign donations of the institutional investors’ employees. These results, together with the finding that the effects are larger for more “partisan” and privately owned investors, suggest that the influence we uncover is driven by institutional investors’ own political views, rather than a profit-maximizing strategy for the portfolio firms.
title_cn: 投资于影响力：投资者、投资组合企业与政治献金
abstract_cn: 我们考察机构持股的兴起如何影响企业的政治活动。我们发现，在获得大额股份之后，企业的政治行动委员会（PAC）献金与收购该股份的投资者更为接近。与新纳入指数所驱动的收购也呈现这一模式，这与因果解释相一致。当企业管理层在股东大会上面对有争议的提案、因而可能需要机构投资者支持时，这一模式更强。我们进一步表明，企业的献金会偏离与业务相关的政客，并与机构投资者员工个人的竞选捐款高度一致。这些结果，连同效应在更“党派化”和私人所有的投资者中更大的发现，表明我们所揭示的影响是由机构投资者自身的政治观点驱动的，而非一种为投资组合企业追求利润最大化的策略。

title: Inference Based on Time-Varying SVARs Identified with Sign Restrictions
abstract: We propose an approach for Bayesian inference in time-varying structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) identified with sign restrictions. The linchpin of our approach is a class of rotation-invariant time-varying SVARs in which the prior and posterior densities of any sequence of structural parameters belonging to the class are invariant to orthogonal transformations of the sequence. Our methodology is new to the literature. In contrast to existing algorithms for inference based on sign restrictions, our algorithm is the first to draw from a uniform distribution over the sequences of orthogonal matrices given the reduced-form parameters. We illustrate our procedure for inference by analyzing the role played by monetary policy during the latest inflation surge.

abstract_cn: 我们提出一种用于具有符号约束识别、参数随时间变化的结构向量自回归（SVAR）的贝叶斯推断方法。该方法的核心是一类旋转不变时变 SVAR，其中属于该类的任一结构参数序列的先验密度和后验密度均对该序列的正交变换保持不变。我们的方法在文献中尚属首次。与现有基于符号约束的推断算法不同，我们的算法首次实现了在给定简化型参数的条件下，从正交矩阵序列上的均匀分布中抽样。我们通过分析最近一轮通胀飙升期间货币政策所发挥的作用，来展示我们的推断程序。

title: Destabilizing Capital Flows amid Global Inflation
abstract: Over the latest monetary policy tightening cycle, capital has been flowing from low-inflation countries to high-inflation countries. This pattern of capital flows is consistent with the predictions of an open-economy model with nominal rigidities where cost-push shocks generate an inflationary episode and capital flows freely across countries. Yet, by raising demand for domestic non-tradable goods and services, capital inflows cause unwelcome upward pressure on firms’ costs in countries most severely hit by these shocks. We find that a reverse pattern of capital flows would have improved the output-inflation trade-off globally, hence requiring a less aggressive monetary tightening in the most severely hit countries and delivering overall welfare gains.
title_cn: 全球通胀下资本流动的 destabilizing（ destabilizing 资本流动）
abstract_cn: 在最近一轮货币政策紧缩周期中，资本从低通胀国家流向高通胀国家。这一资本流动模式与一个具有名义刚性、成本推动冲击引发通胀性经济过程且资本可自由跨国流动的开放经济模型的预测相一致。然而，资本流入通过提高对国内不可贸易商品和服务的需求，在受这些冲击最严重的国家对企业成本造成不受欢迎的上行压力。我们发现，反向的资本流动模式本会在全球范围内改善产出—通胀权衡，从而在最严重受冲击国家需要更不激进的货币紧缩，并带来总体福利收益。

title: How Do You Identify a Good Manager?
abstract: We introduce and validate a novel approach to identifying good managers. In a preregistered lab experiment, we causally identify managerial contributions by randomly assigning managers to teams and controlling for individual skill. We find that manager contributions are crucial for team success, and that people who self-select into management roles perform worse than randomly assigned managers. Managerial performance is strongly predicted by economic decision-making skill but not by demographic characteristics. Two validation studies support our experimental results. Participants who succeed in the lab receive more real-world promotions and, in a separate study of retail store managers, skill measures strongly predict store sales. A one standard deviation increase in manager quality increases annual per store sales by US$4.1 million (25% increase). Selecting managers on skills rather than demographic characteristics or the desire to lead could substantially improve organizational performance.
title_cn: 如何识别一位优秀的管理者？
abstract_cn: 我们提出并验证了一种识别优秀管理者的新方法。在一项预注册的实验室实验中，我们通过将管理者随机分配到团队并控制个体技能，因果性地识别管理者的贡献。我们发现，管理者贡献对团队成功至关重要，而自我选择进入管理岗位的人表现不如随机分配的管理者。管理绩效可由经济决策技能强烈预测，但不受人口统计学特征预测。两项验证研究支持我们的实验结果。在实验室中取得成功的参与者获得了更多现实世界中的晋升；在一项针对零售店管理者的独立研究中，技能指标强烈预测门店销售额。管理者质量提高一个标准差，每家门店的年销售额增加 410 万美元（增长 25%）。基于技能而非人口统计学特征或领导意愿来选拔管理者，可以显著改善组织绩效。

title: (Not) Thinking About the Future: Financial Information and Maternal Labor Supply
abstract: Does information about the long-run financial costs of reduced labor supply increase mothers’ working hours? We document descriptively that long-term financial factors are not top of mind when mothers decide on their employment level. Moreover, a substantial share of women holds overly optimistic expectations about pension receipt and wage growth under part-time work. In a large-scale field experiment in Switzerland, we randomly assign mothers working part-time as teachers to receive objective information about the long-run costs of reduced labor supply. The treatment increases both demand for financial information and future labor supply plans, in particular among women who underestimate the costs of part-time work. Leveraging linked employer administrative data one year post-intervention, we find that this group of mothers increases working hours by 7%. These findings underscore that policies reducing information frictions in labor supply decisions may help address remaining gender gaps in the labor market.
title_cn: （不）思考未来：财务信息与母亲劳动力供给
abstract_cn: 关于劳动力供给减少的长期财务成本的信息，是否会提高母亲的工作时长？我们通过描述性分析记录到，当母亲决定其就业水平时，长期财务因素并非其首要考虑。此外，相当一部分女性对兼职工作下的养老金领取和工资增长持有过于乐观的预期。在瑞士开展的一项大规模田野实验中，我们将兼职工作的教师母亲随机分配至接收关于劳动力供给减少的长期成本的客观信息。该干预既提高了对财务信息的需求，也提高了未来劳动力供给计划，尤其是在低估兼职工作成本的女性中。利用干预一年后的关联雇主行政数据，我们发现这一组母亲的工作时长增加了7%。这些发现强调，减少劳动力供给决策中信息摩擦的政策，可能有助于弥合劳动力市场中尚存的性别差距。

title: Patent Term, Innovation, and the Role of Technology Disclosure Externalities
abstract: I examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. Despite a general increase in average patent term, in most fields innovators faced a considerable probability of patent term reduction for future innovations. Three key findings emerge: (1) R&D and innovation accelerate more in fields with a higher probability of patent term reduction, i.e. a shorter average patent term extension, before implementation. (2) This heightened activity persists for at least 5 years postimplementation, driven by indirect effects where the news-related acceleration fosters further innovation through technological externalities linked to cumulative knowledge creation. (3) Conversely, the direct effect of a shorter extension in patent term would stimulate relatively less innovation, absent the indirect effects of anticipation.
title_cn: 专利期限、创新与技术披露外部性的作用
abstract_cn: 我考察在存在政策预期（这在现实环境中很常见）的情况下，专利期限对研发与创新的影响。采用双重差分设计，我利用1995年TRIPs协定批准所导致的美国专利期限在不同技术领域间的准实验变异。尽管平均专利期限总体延长，但在大多数领域中，创新者对未来创新面临专利期限缩短的相当概率。由此得到三个主要发现：（1）在实施之前，专利期限缩短概率更高（即平均专利期限延长幅度更短）的领域中，研发与创新加速更多。（2）这种增强的活动在实施后至少持续5年，其驱动机制是间接效应：与消息相关的加速通过与技术外部性相联系的累积性知识创造，进一步促进创新。（3）相反，若不存在预期的间接效应，专利期限延长幅度较短所带来的直接效应将刺激相对较少的创新。

title: The Future in Mind: Aspirations and Long-Term Outcomes in Rural Ethiopia
abstract: Aspirations may condition the future-oriented choices of individuals and thus may play a role in the persistence of poverty or the effort to break out of it. We run a randomized controlled trial in remote, rural Ethiopia to explore this and evaluate an intervention that aims to change how poor people perceive their future opportunities, alter their aspirations, and through that, modify their investment decisions. A treatment group was shown video documentaries featuring individuals from similar communities who escaped poverty through their own efforts and who serve as relatable role models. Five years after the screening took place, the treated households had increased future-oriented investments in agriculture, children’s education, and assets. The results can be explained by an increase in aspirations in terms of lifetime goals. Overall, this research uniquely provides evidence that a light-touch behavioural intervention can have persistent economic impacts on a poor population.
title_cn: 心中的未来：埃塞俄比亚农村的志向与长期结果
abstract_cn: 抱负可能影响个体面向未来的选择，进而可能在贫困的持续或脱贫努力中发挥作用。我们在埃塞俄比亚偏远的农村地区开展了一项随机对照试验来探讨这一问题，并评估一项旨在改变贫困人口对未来机会的认知、改变其抱负并借此调整其投资决策的干预措施。一个处理组观看了纪录片视频，片中人物来自相似社区，通过自身努力摆脱了贫困，并作为可产生共鸣的榜样。在放映五年后，受处理的家庭增加了对农业、子女教育和资产等面向未来的投资。这一结果可以用终身目标意义上的抱负提升来解释。总体而言，本研究独特地提供了证据，表明一项轻触式行为干预能够对贫困人口产生持续的经济影响。

title: The Illiquidity of Water Markets
abstract: We investigate the efficiency of a market relative to a non-market institution—an auction relative to a quota—as allocation mechanisms in the presence of frictions. We use data from water markets in southeastern Spain and explore a specific change in the institutions to allocate water. On the one hand, frictions arose because poor farmers were liquidity constrained. On the other hand, farmers who were part of the wealthy elite were not liquidity constrained. We estimate a structural dynamic demand model by taking advantage of the fact that water demand for both types of farmers is determined by the technological constraint imposed by the crop’s production function. This approach allows us to differentiate liquidity constraints from unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the institutional change from an auction to a quota increased total efficiency for the farmers considered. Welfare increased by 23.4 real pesetas per farmer per tree, a 6 % increase in total production relative to the market.
title_cn: 水市场的非流动性

title: Leveraging Virtual Contact and Social Networks to Foster Interethnic Harmony
abstract: This article investigates whether virtual contact, initiated through a documentary film, can promote interethnic harmony. We carried out a cluster-randomized field experiment involving over 3,300 households across 121 multiethnic villages in Bangladesh. We find that a documentary film, designed to humanize the ethnic-minority Santals and evoke empathy among the ethnic majority Bengalis, increased the ethnic majority’s prosociality toward minorities, though the strength of the evidence varies by treatment arm and outcome. Using emotion-detecting software to analyze facial expressions during the film viewing suggests that the documentary elicited emotional responses consistent with empathy. We do not find evidence that the intervention reduced the prevalence of negative stereotypes and discriminatory opinions toward minorities. In villages assigned to target network-central people, we find positive behavioral effects on untreated individuals, including Santals, and village-level administrative data suggest a reduction in police complaints in those villages. About five months after the intervention, we conducted a casual-work field experiment involving 720 participants from the main intervention. In this task, pairs of ethnic-majority and minority participants jointly produced paper bags for a local supplier under a piece-rate compensation scheme. We find positive treatment effects on productivity for both ethnic groups, with effects concentrated in villages where network-central people were treated. For the ethnic majority, increased prosociality, and for the ethnic minority, reciprocity or peer pressure may have contributed to increased productivity. Overall, our findings suggest that virtual contact and social networks may help promote harmony in multiethnic communities.
title_cn: 利用虚拟接触与社会网络促进族群和谐
abstract_cn: 本文考察通过纪录片发起的虚拟接触能否促进族群间和谐。我们在孟加拉国121个多族群村庄开展了覆盖3300余户家庭的整群随机田野实验。我们发现，一部旨在将少数民族Santal人予以人性化呈现并唤起多数族群Bengali人共情的纪录片，提高了多数族群对少数群体的亲社会性，尽管证据强度因处理组和结果变量而异。使用情绪识别软件分析观影过程中的面部表情表明，该纪录片引发了与共情一致的情绪反应。我们未发现该干预降低了针对少数群体的负面刻板印象和歧视性观点的普遍程度。在被分配以网络中心人物为干预对象的村庄中，我们发现对未受干预个体（包括Santal人）产生了积极的行为效应，村庄层面的行政数据表明这些村庄的警方投诉有所减少。干预约五个月后，我们开展了一项涉及主干预中720名参与者的零工田野实验。在该任务中，多数族群与少数族群参与者配对，在计件报酬方案下为当地供应商共同制作纸袋。我们发现对两个族群的生产率均存在正向处理效应，且效应集中在网络中心人物受到干预的村庄。对多数族群而言，亲社会性上升可能促进了生产率提高；对少数族群而言，互惠或同伴压力可能发挥了作用。总体而言，我们的发现表明，虚拟接触和社会网络可能有助于促进多族群社区的和谐。

title: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
abstract: We study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagation.
title_cn: 不可逆性的宏观经济学

title: Growth Experiences and Trust in Government
abstract: This article explores the relationship between economic growth and trust in government using variation in GDP growth experienced over a lifetime since birth. We assemble a newly harmonized global data set across 11 major opinion surveys, comprising 3.3 million respondents in 166 countries since 1990. Exploiting cohort-level variation, we find that people who have experienced higher GDP growth are more prone to trust their governments, with larger effects found in democracies. Higher-growth experiences are also associated with improved perceptions of government performance and living standards. We find no similar channel between growth experience and interpersonal trust. Second, more recent growth experiences appear to matter most for trust in government, with no detectable effect of growth experienced during one’s formative years, closer to birth, or before birth. Third, we find evidence of a “trust paradox” whereby average trust in government is lower in democracies than in autocracies. Our results are robust to a range of falsification exercises, robustness checks, and single-country evidence using the American National Election Studies and the Swiss Household Panel.
title_cn: 增长经历与政府信任
abstract_cn: 本文利用个体自出生以来一生中所经历的 GDP 增长差异，考察经济增长与政府信任之间的关系。我们整合了一个新近协调的全球数据集，涵盖 1990 年以来 11 项主要民意调查、166 个国家的 330 万名受访者。利用队列层面的变异，我们发现，经历过更高 GDP 增长的人更倾向于信任政府，且在民主国家中效应更大。更高的增长经历还与对政府绩效和生活水平改善的感知相关。我们未发现增长经历与人际信任之间存在类似渠道。其次，较近期的增长经历似乎对政府信任最为重要，而个体成长关键期、接近出生时或出生前的增长经历未检测到可识别的影响。第三，我们发现了“信任悖论”的证据，即民主国家的平均政府信任水平低于专制国家。我们的结果在一系列证伪检验、稳健性检验以及使用美国全国选举研究（American National Election Studies）和瑞士家庭面板（Swiss Household Panel）的单一国家证据下均保持稳健。

title: Changing Opportunity: Sociological Mechanisms Underlying Growing Class Gaps and Shrinking Race Gaps in Economic Mobility
abstract: We show that intergenerational mobility changed rapidly by race and class in recent decades in the United States and study the causal mechanisms underlying those changes. Between the 1978 and 1992 birth cohorts, earnings increased for white children from high-income families relative to white children from low-income families, increasing earnings gaps by parental income (class) by 30%. Earnings increased for Black children at all parental income levels, reducing white-Black earnings gaps for children from low-income families by 30%. Class gaps grew and race gaps shrank similarly for nonmonetary outcomes such as educational attainment, standardized test scores, and mortality rates. Using a quasi-experimental design, we show that the divergent trends in economic mobility were caused by differential changes in childhood environments, as proxied by parental employment rates, in local communities defined by race, class, and childhood county. Outcomes improve across birth cohorts for children who grow up in communities with increasing parental employment rates, with larger effects for children who move to such communities at younger ages. Children’s outcomes are most strongly related to the parental employment rates of peers they are more likely to interact with, such as those in their own birth cohort, suggesting that the relationship between children’s outcomes and parental employment rates is mediated by social interaction.
title_cn: 变化中的机会：经济流动性中不断扩大的阶层差距与不断缩小的种族差距背后的社会学机制
abstract_cn: 我们表明，近几十年来美国按种族和阶层划分的代际流动性发生了迅速变化，并研究了这些变化背后的因果机制。在1978年与1992年出生队列之间，高收入家庭白人子女的 earnings 相对于低收入家庭白人子女有所提高，使按父母收入（阶层）衡量的 earnings 差距扩大了30%。所有父母收入水平的黑人子女的 earnings 均有所提高，使低收入家庭子女的白人—黑人 earnings 差距缩小了30%。对于教育 attainment、标准化考试成绩和死亡率等非货币结果，阶层差距同样扩大、种族差距同样缩小。利用准实验设计，我们表明经济流动性的分化趋势是由童年环境的差异性变化所导致的，童年环境以父母就业率作为代理变量，并在按种族、阶层和童年所在县定义的本地社区中加以衡量。对于在父母就业率不断上升的社区中长大的子女，其结果在不同出生队列之间有所改善，且对在更年幼时迁入此类社区的子女效应更大。子女结果与其更可能互动的同伴（例如同一出生队列中的同伴）的父母就业率关系最强，这表明子女结果与父母就业率之间的关系由社会互动所中介。

title: Financial Aid and Upward Mobility: Evidence from Colombia’s Ser Pilo Paga
abstract: We study the impact of financial aid on upward mobility. We estimate the causal impacts of a Colombian policy targeting high-achieving, low-socioeconomic-status students on later-life educational and labor market outcomes. Using regression discontinuity design, difference-in-differences, and population-wide administrative microdata, we find that the policy boosted attendance and completion at high-value-added colleges, particularly in STEM fields. Improved college quality led to greater skill development. Nine years later, recipients earn 18 log points more and are more likely to reach the top 1%. The policy narrowed socioeconomic gaps in college quality, attainment, skill development, earnings, and returns to ability, improving equity and efficiency.

abstract_cn: 我们研究财政援助对向上流动的影响。我们估计了哥伦比亚一项针对成绩优异、社会经济地位较低学生的政策对日后教育和劳动力市场结果的因果影响。利用断点回归设计、双重差分以及覆盖全体人口的行政微观数据，我们发现该政策提高了高附加值大学的入学率和完成率，尤其是在 STEM 领域。大学质量的改善带来了更大的技能发展。九年后，受益者的收入高出 18 个对数点，且更有可能进入收入前 1%。该政策缩小了在大学质量、学业完成、技能发展、收入和能力回报方面的社会经济差距，改善了公平与效率。

title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
abstract: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
title_cn: 幼儿教育发展政策的宏观经济后果
abstract_cn: 为研究长期大规模幼儿教育政策，本文将对幼儿教育的投资纳入一个使用美国数据校准的一般均衡异质性经济主体世代交叠模型。模型中对一项短期小规模幼儿教育项目的随机对照试验评估所预测的儿童教育与收入效应，与经验证据相近。然而，长期大规模项目所带来的福利收益，即使考虑一般均衡与税收效应之后，仍超过短期小规模项目的两倍。造成这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升其自身技能，还为其后代创造了更好的祖先。

title: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
abstract: We state conditions under which choice data suffice to identify preferences when consumers may not be fully informed about attributes of goods. Our approach can be used to test for full information, forecast how consumers will respond to information, and conduct welfare analysis when consumers are imperfectly informed. In a lab experiment, we successfully forecast the average response to new information when consumers engage in costly search. In data from Expedia, our method identifies which attribute was not immediately visible to consumers in search results and allows us to compute the value of additional information.

title: Do Mergers and Acquisitions Improve Efficiency? Evidence from Power Plants
abstract: We analyze acquisitions in US power plants by using rich data on hourly productivity and thousands of ownership changes. We find a 2% average increase in efficiency for acquired plants, beginning 5 months after acquisition. Efficiency gains rise to 5% under direct ownership changes, with no significant change when only parent ownership changes. Investigating the mechanisms, three-quarters of the efficiency gain is attributed to increased productive efficiency, while the rest comes from dynamic efficiency through changes in production allocation. Our evidence suggests that high-productivity firms buy underperforming assets from low-productivity firms and make them as productive as their existing assets through operational improvements.
title_cn: 并购是否改善效率？来自发电厂的证据
abstract_cn: 我们利用关于小时生产率以及数千次所有权变更的丰富数据，分析美国发电厂的收购。我们发现，被收购电厂的平均效率提高 2%，这一提升在收购后 5 个月开始显现。在直接所有权变更下，效率提升达到 5%；而当仅母公司所有权发生变更时，效率没有显著变化。在机制方面，效率提升的四分之三归因于生产效率提高，其余部分来自通过改变生产配置实现的动态效率。我们的证据表明，高生产率企业从低生产率企业手中购买表现不佳的资产，并通过运营改善使其达到与自身现有资产相同的生产率水平。

title: Sleep: Educational Impact and Habit Formation
abstract: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.
title_cn: 睡眠：教育影响与习惯形成
abstract_cn: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励同时提高了睡眠和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施将就寝提醒与晨间反馈以及对工作日夜间至少睡满7小时的即时奖励相结合。在为期4周的处理期内，该干预使睡眠达到7小时以上的工作日夜间占比提高26%，平均睡眠时间增加19分钟，处理后的效应为8分钟。即时激励在处理期内优于延迟激励以及仅提供提醒/反馈，但在处理后没有可区分的影響。主要干预使学期课程平均成绩提高0.075–0.089个绩点，相当于提高0.10–0.11个标准差。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励可以成为改善教育结果的一种成本有效方法。

title: The Zero-Beta Interest Rate
abstract: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.
title_cn: 零贝塔利率
abstract_cn: 我们利用股票收益率构造零贝塔利率的时变度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票组合的预期收益率。与安全利率不同，零贝塔利率无论无条件还是在以货币政策冲击为条件时，都能很好地拟合总量消费欧拉方程，并且其水平足够高、波动足够大、持续性足够强，从而能够解释市场组合的平均收益率及其大部分波动率。真正的谜题在于，安全利率为何如此之低、如此稳定，并且与消费和零贝塔利率都脱节。

title: Training, Communications Patterns, and Spillovers inside Organizations
abstract: This paper examines how training a ects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers' output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks { particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchies shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program's total benefi ts, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
title_cn: 培训、沟通模式与组织内部的溢出效应
abstract_cn: 本文考察培训如何影响组织内部各层级的生产率。在一家政府机构对一线员工实施随机培训项目后，受训员工的产出增加，而其向管理层寻求协助的请求减少。这使管理者得以专注于战略性任务，尤其是与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。一个组织层级结构模型表明，对管理者的溢出效应约占该项目总收益的45%，这说明仅聚焦于个体受训者的评估可能大幅低估培训投资的全部价值。

title: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
abstract: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
title_cn: 天然气陷阱：在竞争中胜过煤炭还是可再生能源
abstract_cn: 我们分析关注气候的天然气生产商面临的一个根本性两难与时间不一致问题。短期内，多生产以在竞争中压过煤炭颇具吸引力。然而，当这一政策被预期到时，对可再生能源的投资会下降，排放最终可能反而增加。当天然气生产商无法预先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。一个应用于欧洲的模拟版本验证了天然气陷阱在数量上具有重要意义。我们讨论这一结果的稳健性以及可能的解决方案，从直接投资于可再生能源到对天然气的勘探与寻找征税。

title: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection
abstract: Recent advances have substantially improved our ability to predict disease risk with genetic data. In response, many countries have banned insurers from using genetic data, despite concerns about adverse selection. This paper measures adverse selection in a market where insurers can underwrite only on nongenetic information while consumers also have access to genetic information. We do so by combining methods from quantitative genetics, selection measures from economic theory, and genetic and electronic health record data on nearly 500,000 individuals in the UK Biobank. We focus on the critical illness insurance market and consider scenarios in which consumers have access to current or expected future genetic prediction technology. We find noticeable levels of selection with current prediction technology, and potentially crippling selection with expected future technology.
title_cn: 基因预测与逆向选择
abstract_cn: 近期进展显著提升了我们利用遗传数据预测疾病风险的能力。对此，许多国家已禁止保险公司使用遗传数据，尽管存在对逆向选择的担忧。本文在一个保险公司只能依据非遗传信息进行承保、而消费者同时可以获得遗传信息的市场中，测度逆向选择。为此，我们结合了数量遗传学方法、经济理论中的选择度量，以及英国生物样本库（UK Biobank）中近50万人的遗传与电子健康记录数据。我们聚焦重大疾病保险市场，并考察消费者能够获得当前或预期未来遗传预测技术的各种情景。我们发现，在当前预测技术下存在明显的选择，而在预期未来技术下则可能出现具有潜在破坏性的选择。

title: Existence of Myopic‐Farsighted Stable Sets in Matching Markets
abstract: In the context of one‐to‐one matching markets, we study myopic‐farsighted stable sets , which are internally and externally stable when myopic agents consider immediate payoffs from their deviations, while farsighted agents anticipate counter‐deviations and consider final payoffs. We constructively prove the existence of a (rational expectations) myopic‐farsighted stable set, in which farsighted agents receive a single payoff while myopic agents may receive multiple payoffs. Our existence result extends to settings with enforcing coalitions of arbitrary size, yielding coalitional myopic‐farsighted stable sets , and to settings where not all members of an enforcing coalition must strictly gain, yielding myopic‐farsighted weakly stable sets . When all farsighted agents have unit demand, our results also extend to many‐to‐one matching markets. As a key corollary, we provide a foundation for the efficiency‐adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm by showing that its outcome constitutes a singleton myopic‐farsighted stable set when one side is farsighted and the other is myopic.
title_cn: 匹配市场中短视-远见稳定集的存在性
abstract_cn: 在一对一匹配市场的情境中，我们研究短视-远见稳定集：当短视经济主体只考虑其偏离带来的即时收益，而远见经济主体预期反偏离并考虑最终收益时，该稳定集在内部和外部均稳定。我们以构造性方式证明（理性预期）短视-远见稳定集的存在性，其中远见经济主体获得单一收益，而短视经济主体可能获得多重收益。我们的存在性结果可推广至具有任意规模执行联盟的设定，得到联盟短视-远见稳定集；也可推广至执行联盟并非所有成员都必须严格获益的设定，得到短视-远见弱稳定集。当所有远见经济主体均具有单位需求时，我们的结果还可推广至多对一匹配市场。作为一个关键推论，我们为效率调整的延迟接受算法提供了基础，证明当一方为远见型、另一方为短视型时，该算法的结果构成一个单点短视-远见稳定集。

title: Causal Inference With Noisy Covariates: Heteroscedastic Measurement Error and Differential Privacy
abstract: We study causal inference with high‐dimensional covariates, observed with various types of heteroscedastic noise. Our main assumption is that the true covariates are low rank, which we empirically evaluate with plots and interpret as approximate repeated measurements. This assumption delivers semiparametric inference on the causal parameter, as precisely as if the true covariates were available. A methodological contribution is to introduce an error‐in‐variable balancing weight for estimation and inference on cross‐sectional causal parameters with heterogeneous effects.
title_cn: 带有噪声协变量的因果推断：异方差测量误差与差分隐私
abstract_cn: 我们研究高维协变量的因果推断，这些协变量以各类异方差噪声形式被观测到。我们的主要假设是真实协变量为低秩，我们通过图形对其进行经验评估，并将其解释为近似重复测量。该假设使得对因果参数的半参数推断能够达到与真实协变量可得时同样精确的程度。方法上的贡献在于引入一种变量误差平衡权重，用于对具有异质效应的横截面因果参数进行估计与推断。

title: Why Do Workers Dislike Inflation? Wage Erosion and Conflict Costs
abstract: How costly is inflation to workers? Answers to this question have focused on the path of real wages during inflationary periods. We argue that workers must take costly actions (“conflict”) to have nominal wages catch up with inflation, meaning there are welfare costs even if real wages do not fall as inflation rises. We study a menu‐cost style model, where workers choose whether to engage in conflict with employers to secure a wage increase. We show that, following a rise in inflation, wage catch‐up resulting from more frequent conflict does not raise welfare. Instead, the impact of inflation on worker welfare is determined by what we call “wage erosion”—how inflation would lower real wages if workers' conflict decisions did not respond to inflation. As a result, using observed wage growth to measure worker welfare understates the costs of inflation. We conduct a survey showing that workers are willing to sacrifice around 1.75% of their wages to avoid conflict. Calibrating the model to survey data, we find that incorporating conflict significantly raises the costs of inflation for workers.
title_cn: 工人为何厌恶通胀？工资侵蚀与冲突成本
abstract_cn: 通货膨胀对劳动者而言成本有多高？对这一问题的回答主要集中于通胀期间实际工资的路径。我们认为，劳动者必须采取有成本的行动（“冲突”）才能让名义工资赶上通胀，这意味着即使实际工资并未随通胀上升而下降，也存在福利成本。我们研究一个菜单成本式模型，其中劳动者选择是否与雇主发生冲突以确保工资上涨。我们表明，在通胀上升之后，由更频繁冲突带来的工资追赶并不会提高福利。相反，通胀对劳动者福利的影响取决于我们所称的“工资侵蚀”——即如果劳动者的冲突决策不对通胀作出反应，通胀将如何降低实际工资。因此，用观测到的工资增长来衡量劳动者福利会低估通胀的成本。我们开展了一项调查，显示劳动者愿意牺牲约1.75%的工资以避免冲突。将模型校准至调查数据，我们发现纳入冲突会显著提高通胀对劳动者的成本。

title: Continuity of the Distribution Function of the argmax of a Gaussian Process
abstract: Certain extremum estimators have asymptotic distributions that are non‐Gaussian, yet characterizable as the distribution of the arg max of a Gaussian process. This paper presents high‐level sufficient conditions under which such asymptotic distributions admit a continuous distribution function. The plausibility of the sufficient conditions is demonstrated by verifying them in three examples, namely, maximum score estimation, empirical risk minimization, and threshold regression estimation. In turn, the continuity result buttresses several recently proposed inference procedures whose validity seems to require a result of the kind established herein. A notable feature of the high‐level assumptions is that one of them is designed to enable us to employ the Cameron–Martin theorem. In a leading special case, the assumption in question is demonstrably weak and appears to be close to minimal.
title_cn: 高斯过程argmax分布函数的连续性

title: Monotonicity and Robust Implementation Under Forward‐Induction Reasoning
abstract: In sequential games, the set of paths consistent with rationality and forward‐induction reasoning may change nonmonotonically when adding transparent restrictions on players' beliefs. Yet, we prove that—in an incomplete‐information environment—predictions become sharper when the restrictions only concern initial beliefs about types. Thus, strong rationalizability for games with payoff uncertainty characterizes the path predictions of forward‐induction reasoning across all possible restrictions on players' hierarchies of exogenous beliefs. With this, we can solve an open problem: the implementation of social choice functions through sequential mechanisms under forward‐induction reasoning—which considerably expands the realm of implementable functions compared with simultaneous mechanisms (Müller (2016))—is indeed robust in the sense of Bergemann and Morris (2009).
title_cn: 单调性与前向归纳推理下的稳健实施
abstract_cn: 在序贯博弈中，当对参与人信念施加透明限制时，与理性和前向归纳推理相一致的路径集合可能会非单调地变化。然而，我们证明，在不完全信息环境中，当这些限制仅涉及关于类型的初始信念时，预测会变得更加精确。因此，对于存在支付不确定性的博弈，强可理性化刻画了前向归纳推理在所有可能的外生信念层级限制下的路径预测。据此，我们可以解决一个开放问题：在前向归纳推理下通过序贯机制实施社会选择函数——与同时机制相比，这大大扩展了可实施函数的范围（Müller（2016））——确实在 Bergemann 和 Morris（2009）的意义上是稳健的。

title: Multidimensional Screening With Precise Seller Information
abstract: A multi‐product monopolist faces a buyer who is privately informed about his valuations for the goods. As is well known, optimal mechanisms are in general complicated, while simple mechanisms—such as pure bundling or separate sales—can be far from optimal and do not admit clear‐cut comparisons. We show that this changes if the monopolist has sufficiently precise information about the buyer's valuations: Now, pure bundling always outperforms separate sales; moreover, there is a sense in which pure bundling performs essentially as well as the optimal mechanism. To formalize this, we characterize how fast the corresponding revenues converge to the first‐best revenue as the monopolist's information grows precise: Pure bundling achieves the same convergence rate to the first‐best as optimal mechanisms; in contrast, the convergence rate under separate sales is suboptimal.
title_cn: 具有精确卖方信息的多维筛选
abstract_cn: 一个多产品垄断者面对一名对其商品估值拥有私人信息的买方。众所周知，最优机制一般而言较为复杂，而简单机制——例如纯捆绑销售或分开销售——可能远非最优，且二者之间无法进行明确比较。我们表明，如果垄断者拥有关于买方估值的足够精确的信息，这一情形会发生变化：此时，纯捆绑销售总是优于分开销售；此外，在某种意义上，纯捆绑销售的表现在本质上与最优机制一样好。为将这一点形式化，我们刻画了随着垄断者信息变得更为精确，相应收入以多快的速度收敛至第一最优收入：纯捆绑销售达到与最优机制相同的向第一最优收敛的速度；相比之下，分开销售下的收敛速度则是次优的。

title: The Economics of Partisan Gerrymandering
abstract: We study the problem of a partisan gerrymanderer who assigns voters to equipopulous districts to maximize his party's expected seat share. The designer faces both aggregate, district‐level uncertainty (how many votes his party will receive) and idiosyncratic, voter‐level uncertainty (which voters will vote for his party). Segregate‐pair districting , where weaker districts contain one type of voter, while stronger districts contain two, is optimal for the gerrymanderer. The optimal form of segregate‐pair districting depends on the designer's popularity and the relative amounts of aggregate and idiosyncratic uncertainty. When idiosyncratic uncertainty dominates, a designer with majority support pairs all voters, while a designer with minority support segregates opposing voters and pairs more favorable voters; these plans resemble uniform districting and “packing‐and‐cracking,” respectively. When aggregate uncertainty dominates, the designer segregates moderate voters and pairs extreme voters; this “matching slices” plan has received some attention in the literature. Estimating the model using precinct‐level returns from recent U.S. House elections shows that, in practice, idiosyncratic uncertainty dominates. We discuss implications for redistricting reform, political polarization, and detecting gerrymandering. Methodologically, we exploit a formal connection between gerrymandering—partitioning voters into districts—and information design—partitioning states of the world into signals.
title_cn: 党派杰利蝾螈划分的经济学分析
abstract_cn: 我们研究一个党派性不公正划分选区者的问题：该设计者将选民分配到人口相等的选区中，以最大化其所在政党的预期席位份额。设计者同时面临总量层面、选区层面的不确定性（其政党将获得多少选票）以及个体层面、选民层面的不确定性（哪些选民会投票支持其政党）。分离—配对式选区划分——即较弱选区包含一类选民，而较强选区包含两类选民——对于不公正划分选区者而言是最优的。分离—配对式选区划分的最优形式取决于设计者的受欢迎程度以及总量不确定性与个体特异性不确定性的相对大小。当个体特异性不确定性占主导时，拥有多数支持的设计者会将所有选民配对，而拥有少数支持的设计者则会将反对派选民分离，并将更有利的选民配对；这些方案分别类似于统一选区划分和“打包—拆散”。当总量不确定性占主导时，设计者会将温和选民分离，并将极端选民配对；这种“匹配切片”方案在文献中已受到一定关注。利用近期美国众议院选举的选区级投票结果对该模型进行估计表明，在实践中个体特异性不确定性占主导。我们讨论了对选区重划改革、政治极化以及识别不公正划分选区的启示。在方法上，我们利用了不公正划分选区——将选民划分为选区——与信息设计——将世界状态划分为信号——之间的形式联系。

title: Dynamic Incentives in Incompletely Specified Environments
abstract: Consider a repeated interaction where it is unknown which of various stage games will be played each period. This framework separates the basic logic of intertemporal incentives from the requirement that any given strategy profile yields a well‐defined payoff vector. A natural solution concept is ex post perfect equilibrium: strategies must form a subgame‐perfect equilibrium for any realization of the sequence of stage games. When there is one long‐run player and others are short‐run, and public randomization is available, we can adapt the standard recursive approach to determine the maximum feasible gap between reward and punishment for the long‐run player. This allows us to identify which actions can be played in equilibrium and, assuming perfect monitoring, to fully characterize what outcome paths can arise. With multiple long‐run players or no public randomization, the approach fails; a diagnostic of this failure is that optimal penal codes may no longer exist.
title_cn: 不完全设定环境中的动态激励
abstract_cn: 考虑一个重复互动情形，其中每一期将进行多种阶段博弈中的哪一种并不为参与人所知。该框架将跨期激励的基本逻辑与“任一给定策略组合都产生定义良好的支付向量”这一要求区分开来。一个自然的解概念是事后完美均衡：策略必须对阶段博弈序列的任意实现构成子博弈完美均衡。当存在一个长期参与人、其余为短期参与人且可获得公共随机化时，我们可以调整标准的递归方法，以确定长期参与人可获得的奖励与惩罚之间最大可行差距。这使我们能够识别哪些行动可以在均衡中被实施，并在完美监督假设下完整刻画可能出现的结果路径。当存在多个长期参与人或没有公共随机化时，该方法失效；这种失效的一个诊断特征是，最优惩罚码可能不再存在。

title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
abstract: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.
title_cn: 职业发展中的阶层差距：来自美国学术界的证据
abstract_cn: 与性别或种族不同，阶层背景很少成为职业发展研究的焦点，也很少成为精英职业中 DEI 工作的重点。它应当成为焦点吗？本文以父母受教育程度作为阶层背景的代理变量，记录了美国终身轨学术界这一职业中职业发展的巨大阶层差距。与父母一方拥有非博士研究生学位的昔日博士同学（来自同一机构和同一领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在 R1 高校获得终身教职的可能性低 10%，获得终身教职的机构排名低 11%，收入低 3%，工作满意度低 5%。无论是退出学术界的选择性，还是不同的偏好，都无法解释这一差距；研究生产率的差异也作用甚微。相反，可能的驱动因素是文化资本和社会资本的差异。我们还发现，在产业界工作的博士同样存在职业发展的阶层差距，这表明该现象可能推广至学术界之外。

title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
abstract: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
title_cn: 局部投影的双稳健性与一些令人不快的VARithmetic
abstract_cn: 我们考虑局部错误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中的脉冲响应推断。即使错误设定大到能以趋于 1 的概率被检测出来，传统局部投影（LP）置信区间仍具有正确的覆盖概率。这一结果源于一种“双重稳健”性质，类似于流行的部分线性回归估计量的相应性质。相比之下，当错误设定较小、在统计上难以检测且无法依据经济理论排除时，滞后阶数较短至中等的传统 VAR 置信区间可能严重覆盖不足。VAR 置信区间具有稳健覆盖概率，当且仅当滞后阶数大到使该区间与 LP 区间一样宽。

title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
abstract: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
title_cn: 信念更新中的推断—预测差距
abstract_cn: 来自实验室和田野的证据均发现，人们对新信息既存在反应不足，也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在同一信息环境中如何进行推断和修正预测，为反应不足与反应过度的内在机制提供了新的实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断—预测缺口”。我们表明，这一缺口在很大程度上由两种任务中所使用的不同简化启发式所驱动。额外的干预实验表明，启发式的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引出的统计量之间相似性的影响。

title: Locally Robust Semiparametrically Efficient Bayesian Inference
abstract: We propose a framework for making Bayesian parametric models robust to local misspecification. Suppose in a baseline parametric model, a parameter of interest has an interpretation in an encompassing semiparametric model. Bayesian and maximum likelihood estimators are generally biased under local misspecification. We propose to augment the baseline likelihood by a multiplicative factor that involves scores for the baseline model, the efficient scores for the encompassing semiparametric model, and an auxiliary parameter that has the same dimension as the parameter of interest. We show that the marginal posterior for the parameter of interest in the augmented model is asymptotically normal with mean equal to the semiparametrically efficient estimator and variance equal to the semiparametric efficiency bound. The suggested augmentation robustifies the baseline parametric model to local misspecification, while preserving the appeal of Bayesian inference. We develop an MCMC algorithm for the augmented model and illustrate the approach in applications.
title_cn: 局部稳健的半参数有效贝叶斯推断
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个使贝叶斯参数模型对局部错误设定具有稳健性的框架。假设在一个基准参数模型中，一个感兴趣的参数在一个涵盖半参数模型中具有解释。贝叶斯估计量和最大似然估计量在局部错误设定下通常是有偏的。我们提出通过一个乘性因子来增广基准似然，该因子涉及基准模型的得分、涵盖半参数模型的有效得分，以及一个与感兴趣参数具有相同维度的辅助参数。我们证明，增广模型中感兴趣参数的边际后验是渐近正态的，其均值等于半参数有效估计量，方差等于半参数有效性界。所建议的增广使基准参数模型对局部错误设定具有稳健性，同时保留贝叶斯推断的吸引力。我们为增广模型开发了一种 MCMC 算法，并在应用中说明了该方法。

title: The Random Priority Mechanism Is Uniquely Simple, Efficient, and Fair
abstract: Random Priority is a popular mechanism used to allocate a set of objects to a set of agents without the use of monetary transfers. Random Priority is appealing because it satisfies desirable efficiency, fairness, and incentive properties. Is it the only mechanism with these properties? We answer this long‐standing question in the positive: Random Priority is the unique mechanism that is Pareto efficient, symmetric, and obviously strategy‐proof.
title_cn: 随机优先机制在简单性、效率与公平性上是唯一兼具的
abstract_cn: 随机优先机制是一种常用的机制，用于在不使用货币转移的情况下将一组对象分配给一组经济主体。随机优先机制之所以有吸引力，是因为它满足理想的效率、公平和激励性质。它是否是唯一具备这些性质的机制？我们对这一长期存在的问题给出肯定回答：随机优先机制是唯一同时满足帕累托有效、对称和显然策略-proof的机制。

title: A Framework for Geoeconomics
abstract: Governments use their countries' economic strength from financial and trade relationships to achieve geopolitical and economic goals. We provide a model of the sources of geoeconomic power and how it is wielded. The source of this power is the ability of a hegemonic country to coordinate threats across disparate economic relationships as a means of enforcement on foreign entities. The hegemon wields this power to demand costly actions out of the targeted entities, including mark‐ups, import restrictions, tariffs, and political concessions. The hegemon uses its power to change targeted entities' activities to manipulate the global equilibrium in its favor and increase its power. A sector is strategic either in helping the hegemon form threats or in manipulating the world equilibrium via input‐output amplification. The hegemon acts a global enforcer, thus adding value to the world economy, but destroys value by distorting the equilibrium in its favor.
title_cn: 地缘经济学的分析框架
abstract_cn: 政府利用本国在金融和贸易关系中的经济实力来实现地缘政治与经济目标。我们构建了一个模型，刻画地缘经济权力的来源及其运用方式。这种权力的来源在于，霸权国家能够跨越彼此不同的经济关系来协调威胁，以此作为对外国实体实施强制执行的手段。霸权国运用这一权力要求目标实体采取代价高昂的行动，包括加价、进口限制、关税和政治让步。霸权国利用其权力改变目标实体的活动，以操纵全球均衡使之有利于自身，并增强自身权力。一个部门之所以具有战略性，要么是因为它有助于霸权国形成威胁，要么是因为它通过投入—产出放大效应操纵世界均衡。霸权国充当全球强制执行者，从而为世界经济增加价值，但通过扭曲均衡使之有利于自身而破坏价值。

title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
abstract: We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.
title_cn: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie Kappa 的核心作用
abstract_cn: 我们研究满足以下特征的工具变量模型：(i) 由潜在结果和响应类型构成的不可观测异质性，其中响应类型刻画工具变量如何决定处理选择；(ii) 工具变量与不可观测异质性之间的条件独立性；(iii) 对不可观测异质性分布的凸约束。我们证明，在这些模型中，某些因果参数可被识别，当且仅当存在 Abadie（2003）的 kappa 的某一版本。我们的识别结果是构造性的，可给出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要的特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本，构建了渐近正态估计量。

title: Food Policy in a Warming World
abstract: This paper studies how governments intervene in agricultural markets to reshape the economic consequences of climate extremes. We construct a global dataset of agricultural policies and extreme heat exposure by country and crop since 1980. Extreme heat shocks to domestic production lead to policies that assist consumers by lowering domestic food prices. This effect is persistent, primarily implemented via border policies, and stronger during election years. Shocks to foreign production induce the opposite response: policies that assist producers by raising prices. These findings can be rationalized by a model in which governments use agricultural policy to redistribute among domestic interest groups. Our estimates imply that policy responses shield domestic consumers, while exacerbating losses for domestic producers and foreign consumers. Policy responses have regressive consequences globally, disproportionately harming poor and heat‐exposed countries.
title_cn: 变暖世界中的粮食政策
abstract_cn: 本文研究政府如何干预农产品市场以重塑气候极端事件的经济后果。我们构建了自1980年以来按国家和作物划分的农业政策与极端高温暴露的全球数据集。对国内生产的极端高温冲击会引致旨在通过降低国内食品价格来帮助消费者的政策。这一效应具有持续性，主要通过边境政策实施，且在选举年份更强。对国外生产的冲击则引致相反的反应：通过提高价格来帮助生产者的政策。这些发现可以由一个模型加以合理解释，在该模型中，政府利用农业政策在国内利益集团之间进行再分配。我们的估计表明，政策反应保护了国内消费者，同时加剧了国内生产者和国外消费者的损失。政策反应在全球范围内具有累退性后果，对贫穷国家和高温暴露国家的损害尤为严重。

title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
abstract: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.

title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
abstract: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
title_cn: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应
abstract_cn: 美国最高法院2010年在Citizens United诉联邦选举委员会案中的裁决放松了竞选财务监管，促成了新型政治行动委员会（Super PAC）的兴起，使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估Super PAC的影响，我使用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。我发现，两方的Super PAC支出都会引发相互抵消的反应，导致净均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，Super PAC仍有可能重塑选举格局。
