title: The Complexity of Multidimensional Learning in Agriculture
abstract: Studies on agricultural technology adoption often focus on one input, practice, or package, which is analytically useful, but may overlook the complexities involved with multidimensional learning needed for a lot of agricultural decisions. In Kenya, we study farmers' dynamic learning (from oneself and others) and adoption decisions over six seasons after randomly inviting them to participate in agronomic research trials, comparing different combinations of inputs during three consecutive seasons. As a response to the trials, adoption increases steadily despite the absence of positive profits multiple seasons after exposure to the trials. Know‐how increases rapidly and faster for high skill farmers who experiment the most, at the cost of making new mistakes. The findings are consistent with a theoretical model with multidimensionality of input and practice decisions and differential learning from one's own experience by skills, where complementarities imply that adoption of an input requires finding how to re‐optimize other dimensions, which adds to the cost of adoption.
title_cn: 农业中多维学习的复杂性
abstract_cn: 关于农业技术采纳的研究往往聚焦于单一投入、单一做法或单一技术组合，这在分析上有其用处，但可能忽视了许多农业决策所需的多维学习所涉及的复杂性。在肯尼亚，我们研究了农民在六个种植季中的动态学习（向自身经验学习和向他人学习）与采纳决策：我们随机邀请农民参加农艺研究试验，并在连续三个种植季中比较不同的投入组合。作为对试验的响应，尽管在接触试验后的多个种植季中并未出现正利润，采纳率仍稳步上升。技能水平高的农民试验最多，其诀窍知识增长迅速且快于他人，但代价是犯下新的错误。这些发现与一个理论模型相一致：该模型包含投入与做法决策的多维性，以及不同技能者从自身经验中学习的差异；其中，互补性意味着采纳某一投入需要找到如何重新优化其他维度的方法，这增加了采纳成本。

title: Empirical Bayes When Estimation Precision Predicts Parameters
abstract: Gaussian empirical Bayes methods usually maintain a precision independence assumption: The unknown parameters of interest are independent from the known standard errors of the estimates. This assumption is often theoretically questionable and empirically rejected. This paper proposes to model the conditional distribution of the parameter given the standard errors as a flexibly parameterized location‐scale family of distributions, leading to a family of methods that we call close . The close framework unifies and generalizes several proposals under precision dependence. We argue that the most flexible member of the close family is a minimalist and computationally efficient default for accounting for precision dependence. We analyze this method and show that it is competitive in terms of the regret of subsequent decision rules. Empirically, using close leads to sizable gains for selecting high‐mobility Census tracts.
title_cn: 当估计精度预测参数时的经验贝叶斯
abstract_cn: 高斯经验贝叶斯方法通常维持一个精度独立性假设：待估的未知参数与已知的估计标准误相互独立。这一假设在理论上常常值得怀疑，在经验上也遭到拒绝。本文提出将参数在给定标准误下的条件分布建模为一个灵活参数化的位置—尺度分布族，由此得到一族我们称为 close 的方法。close 框架统一并推广了精度依赖下的若干方案。我们认为，close 族中最灵活的成员是处理精度依赖的一种极简且计算高效的默认方法。我们分析了该方法，并表明其在后续决策规则的遗憾值方面具有竞争力。在经验上，使用 close 在选择高流动性普查 tract 方面带来了可观的收益。

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Markup Estimation: Assessing Estimates From Financial Data
abstract: Macroeconomic outcomes depend on the distribution of markups across firms and over time, making firm‐level markup estimates key for macroeconomic analysis. Methods to obtain these estimates require data on the prices that firms charge. Firm‐level data with wide coverage, however, primarily come from financial statements, which lack information on prices. We use an analytical framework to show that trends in markups over time or the dispersion of markups across firms can still be well‐measured with such data. Measuring the average level of the markup does require pricing data, and we propose a consistent estimator for such settings. We validate the analytical results using simulations of a quantitative macroeconomic model and offer supporting evidence from firm‐level administrative production and pricing data. Our analysis supports the use of financial data to measure trends in aggregate markups.

title: Communicating Scientific Uncertainty via Approximate Posteriors
abstract: We cast the problem of communicating scientific uncertainty as one of reporting a posterior distribution on an unknown parameter to an audience of Bayesian decision‐makers. We establish novel bounds on the audience's regret when the analyst reports an approximation to a posterior that the audience treats as exact. Under a palatable restriction on the audience's decision problems, the bounds take an especially convenient form. Under a further restriction on the audience's priors, a bootstrap distribution can be used as a stand‐in posterior. We propose a practical recipe for checking whether a conventional statistical report (say, a normal parameterized by a point estimate and standard error) is a good approximation, and for improving the report if it is not. We illustrate our proposals using the articles in the 2021 American Economic Review that use a bootstrap for inference.
title_cn: 通过近似后验传达科学不确定性
abstract_cn: 我们将科学不确定性的沟通问题设定为：向作为贝叶斯决策者的受众报告未知参数的后验分布。我们建立了新的界，用于刻画当分析者报告的是后验分布的近似值、而受众将其视为精确值时受众所承受的后悔。在对受众决策问题的一项合理限制下，这些界呈现出特别便利的形式。在对受众先验的进一步限制下，自助分布（bootstrap distribution）可作为后验分布的替代。我们提出一套实用方法，用于检验常规统计报告（例如由点估计和标准误参数化的正态分布）是否为良好近似，并在其并非良好近似时改进该报告。我们利用2021年《American Economic Review》中使用自助法进行推断的文章来说明我们的建议。

title: Equilibrium Existence in First‐Price Auctions With Private Values
abstract: We provide sufficient conditions for equilibrium existence in first‐price auctions with private values that accommodate non quasi‐linear utilities and value‐distributions that contain atoms and exhibit positive or negative correlation. These conditions show that equilibrium existence often turns on properties of a single statistic of the joint distribution of values, namely, the minimum value in the support of the high‐value distribution (the mHV). We also show that modifying the standard tie‐breaking rule only at the mHV is enough to guarantee equilibrium existence without our sufficient conditions. Our results also apply to Bertrand price competition when each firm's constant marginal cost is private information.
title_cn: 私人价值第一价格拍卖中的均衡存在性
abstract_cn: 我们给出了私人价值首价拍卖中均衡存在的充分条件，这些条件允许非拟线性效用以及包含原子并呈现正相关或负相关的价值分布。这些条件表明，均衡存在往往取决于价值联合分布的一个单一统计量的性质，即高价值分布支撑中的最小值（mHV）。我们还表明，仅在高价值分布支撑中的最小值处修改标准平局规则，就足以在无需我们的充分条件的情况下保证均衡存在。当每家企业的不变边际成本为私人信息时，我们的结果也适用于伯特兰价格竞争。

title: Firm Accommodation After Workplace Disability: Labor Market Impacts and Implications for Subsidy Design
abstract: This paper studies the labor market impacts of firm accommodation decisions after workplace disability and assesses implications for the design of firm subsidies. We leverage a workers' compensation (WC) program in Oregon that provides wage subsidies to firms for accommodating workers with workplace disabilities. Leveraging rich administrative data and a policy change to the wage subsidy, we show that accommodation rates respond to the subsidy rate and that receipt of accommodation leads to a significant increase in employment and earnings a year later. To explore welfare implications, we develop and estimate a frictional labor market model of accommodation as a form of human capital investment. Worker turnover and imperfect experience rating in WC lead to underaccommodation and inefficient labor market outcomes after workplace disability. Counterfactual simulations show that subsidizing accommodation not only improves long‐run labor market outcomes of workers experiencing work‐related disability but also yields welfare gains for most workers.
title_cn: 工作场所残疾后的企业便利安排：劳动力市场影响及对补贴设计的启示

title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
abstract: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.
title_cn: 一般均衡中的工作阶梯与财富动态
abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，将不完全市场世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业劳动者内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的岗位阶梯相结合。借助这些要素，我们的模型为总量生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型能够较好地拟合搜寻活动、求职率、工资和储蓄的年龄经验剖面。我们运用该模型，通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道，分析税收与转移支付政策对劳动力市场动态和总量经济活动的影响。降低失业保险金和降低累进性的税制会给新进入劳动力市场的劳动者带来福利损失，这些损失主要由更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力所驱动；这两项政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上均具有差异化效应。

title: Curtailing False News, Amplifying Truth
abstract: We develop a comprehensive framework to evaluate policy interventions aimed at curbing false news dissemination on social media. Using a randomized experiment on Twitter and X during the 2022 and 2024 U.S. elections, we assess priming for misinformation awareness, fact‐checking, confirmation clicks, and content consideration prompts. Priming proves most effective in reducing false‐news sharing while preserving true news dissemination. We build and structurally estimate a model of sharing, motivated by partisan persuasion, partisan signaling, and reputational concerns. We identify three channels through which policies influence sharing: (i) updating perceived veracity and partisanship of content, (ii) raising salience of reputation, and (iii) increasing engagement costs. Differences in the effects of policies are explained by the salience and cost channels. Content‐neutral priming is best at enhancing salience of reputation at minimal cost and almost as effective as fact‐checking in updating veracity. Salience channel is stronger when users encounter uncontroversially true content.
title_cn: 遏制虚假新闻，放大真相

title: Optimally‐Transported Generalized Method of Moments
abstract: We propose a novel optimal transport‐based version of the Generalized Method of Moment (GMM). Instead of handling overidentification by reweighting the data to satisfy the moment conditions (as in Generalized Empirical Likelihood methods), this method proceeds by allowing for errors in the variables of the least mean‐square magnitude necessary to simultaneously satisfy all moment conditions. This approach, based on the notions of optimal transport and Wasserstein metric, aims to address the problem of assigning a logical interpretation to GMM results even when overidentification tests reject the null, a situation that cannot always be avoided in applications. We illustrate the method by revisiting Duranton, Morrow and Turner's (2014) study of the relationship between a city's exports and the extent of its transportation infrastructure. Our results corroborate theirs under weaker assumptions and provide insight into the error structure of the variables.
title_cn: 最优传输广义矩方法

title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
abstract: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.

title: Optimal Shrinkage Estimation of Fixed Effects in Linear Panel Data Models
abstract: Shrinkage methods are frequently used to improve the precision of least squares estimators of fixed effects. However, widely used shrinkage estimators guarantee improved precision only under strong distributional assumptions. I develop an estimator for the fixed effects that obtains the best possible mean squared error within a class of shrinkage estimators. This class includes conventional shrinkage estimators and the optimality does not require distributional assumptions. The estimator has an intuitive form and is easy to implement. Moreover, the fixed effects are allowed to vary with time and to be serially correlated, in which case the shrinkage optimally incorporates the underlying correlation structure. I also provide a method to forecast fixed effects one period ahead in this setting.
title_cn: 线性面板数据模型中固定效应的最优收缩估计
abstract_cn: 收缩方法常被用于提高固定效应最小二乘估计量的精度。然而，广泛使用的收缩估计量只有在较强的分布假设下才能保证精度改进。本文为固定效应开发了一个估计量，该估计量在一类收缩估计量中实现了尽可能最优的均方误差。这一类包括传统收缩估计量，且最优性不要求分布假设。该估计量形式直观且易于实施。此外，固定效应允许随时间变化并存在序列相关，在此情形下收缩最优地纳入了潜在的相关结构。本文还提供了一种在该设定下提前一期预测固定效应的方法。

title: Screening Property Rights for Innovation
abstract: We develop a dynamic structural model of patent screening incorporating incentives, intrinsic motivation, and multiround negotiation. We use natural language processing to create a measure of patent distance, which together with detailed data on examiner decisions, enables us to estimate the model and study strategic decisions by applicants and examiners. Using the estimated model, we quantify the effectiveness of the U.S. Patent Office and evaluate counterfactual policy reforms. We find that patent screening is moderately effective, given the existing standards for patentability. Examiners exhibit substantial intrinsic motivation that strongly improves screening quality. We quantify the annual social costs of patent screening at $15.38bn, equivalent to 5% of total private sector R&D in the U.S. and show that reforms limiting the number of rounds of negotiation significantly reduce social costs.
title_cn: 为创新筛选产权
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个专利审查的动态结构模型，纳入激励、内在动机与多轮谈判。我们使用自然语言处理构建专利距离的度量，并结合审查员决策的详细数据，使我们能够估计该模型并研究申请人与审查员的策略性决策。利用估计得到的模型，我们量化美国专利局的有效性并评估反事实政策改革。我们发现，在现行可专利性标准下，专利审查具有中等程度的效果。审查员表现出显著的内在动机，这大幅提高了审查质量。我们量化专利审查的年度社会成本为 153.8 亿美元，相当于美国私营部门 R&D 总投入的 5%，并表明限制谈判轮数的改革会显著降低社会成本。

title: An Experimental Evaluation of Deferred Acceptance: Evidence From Over 100 Army Officer Labor Markets
abstract: Internal labor markets are increasingly important for matching workers to jobs within organizations. We present evidence from a randomized trial that compares matching workers to jobs using the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm to the traditional manager‐directed matching process. Our setting is the U.S. Army's internal labor market, which matches over 14,000 officers to units annually. We find that DA reduces administrative burden and increases match quality as measured by reduced justified envy, increased truthful preference reporting, and officers' and units' preferences over their matches. The overall impact of DA on officer retention and performance in the two years after officers started their new jobs is limited by strategic preference coordination between officers and units. However, DA leads to significant improvements in officer retention and promotions in markets with inexperienced managers. Our findings suggest that cross‐market communication between agents in internal labor markets can attenuate the benefits of strategyproof matching algorithms.
title_cn: 延迟接受机制的实验评估：来自100多个陆军军官劳动力市场的证据
abstract_cn: 内部劳动力市场在将劳动者与组织内岗位进行匹配方面日益重要。我们提供了一项随机试验的证据，该试验比较了使用延迟接受（DA）算法将劳动者与岗位匹配和传统的管理者主导匹配过程。我们的研究场景是美国陆军的内部劳动力市场，该市场每年将超过14,000名军官与单位进行匹配。我们发现，DA减轻了行政负担，并提高了匹配质量，衡量指标包括合理化嫉妒减少、真实偏好报告增加，以及军官和单位对其匹配结果的偏好。DA对军官在新岗位开始后两年内的留任和绩效的总体影响，受到军官与单位之间策略性偏好协调的限制。然而，在管理者经验不足的市场中，DA显著改善了军官留任和晋升。我们的发现表明，内部劳动力市场中经济主体之间的跨市场沟通可能削弱策略防伪匹配算法的收益。

title: Subgroup Decomposition of the Gini Coefficient: A New Solution to an Old Problem
abstract: We derive a novel decomposition of the Gini coefficient into within‐ and between‐group inequality terms that sum to the aggregate Gini coefficient. This decomposition is derived from a set of axioms that ensure desirable behavior for the within‐ and between‐group inequality terms. The decomposition of the Gini coefficient is unique given our axioms, easy to compute, and can be interpreted geometrically.

title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
abstract: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
title_cn: 经济增长与大企业的兴起
abstract_cn: 我记录了企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展而系统性变厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜索模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有一条渐近平衡增长路径，沿该路径吉布拉特定律在每个时点均成立，且企业规模分布的右尾单调地趋近于齐普夫定律。该模型还意味着，偏向大企业的政策可以通过更好地利用思想搜索所产生的扩散外部性来提高福利。

title: Outside Options, Reputations, and the Partial Success of the Coase Conjecture
abstract: A buyer and seller bargain in continuous time over a good. Bargainers can be rational or committed to some fixed price. A rational buyer has a private value and outside option. If the set of buyer values and commitment types is rich and the probability of commitment vanishes, outcomes are partially consistent with the Coase conjecture: the seller chooses a price below the maximum of the lowest outside option and half the lowest value; the buyer immediately accepts or takes his outside option.
title_cn: 外部选项、声誉与科斯猜想的局部成功
abstract_cn: 买方与卖方在连续时间内就一种商品进行议价。议价者可以是理性的，也可以坚持某个固定价格。理性买方拥有私人价值和外部选项。如果买方价值与承诺类型的集合足够丰富，且承诺类型的概率趋于零，则结果与科斯猜想部分一致：卖方选择的价格低于最低外部选项与最低价值一半二者中的最大值；买方立即接受或选择其外部选项。

title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
abstract: Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.
title_cn: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励锻炼的实地实验
abstract_cn: 个性化政策在理论上可以提高其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测且政策制定者与个体的偏好并不一致时，个性化便难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报自身类型。机制设计提供了一种克服该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择为其类型所设计的方案。我们利用一项在印度城市 6,800 名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人中开展的、对运动激励进行个性化的田野实验表明，借助激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化，能够显著改善项目表现，相对于“一刀切”基准，使激励对运动的处理效应提高 80%，且不增加激励成本。提供选择所达到的效果与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化相近，但所需数据要求更低。

title: Rural Migrants and Urban Informality: Evidence From Brazil
abstract: This paper studies the economic effects of rural‐urban migration on Brazilian cities. Using a shift‐share IV design, we show that, over a decade, drought‐induced immigration reduces informality, has no effect on unemployment, and increases the number of formal firms and jobs. Downward formal wage adjustments play a key role, as these long‐run effects are weaker in regions with stronger wage rigidity. In the short run, when wage rigidity is strongest, we replicate the informality‐increasing effects documented in the literature. We develop and estimate a model of firm dynamics and informality that rationalizes these results. The counterfactuals reveal that, in the short run, the informal sector absorbs the expanding labor force and acts as a “stepping‐stone” to formality for firms and workers. In the long run, however, it reduces the aggregate benefits from immigration by allowing the least productive firms to survive.
title_cn: 农村移民与城市非正规性：来自巴西的证据
abstract_cn: 本文研究乡城迁移对巴西城市的经济影响。采用移动份额工具变量设计，我们表明，在十年间，干旱引致的移民降低了非正规性，对失业没有影响，并增加了正规企业数量和正规就业岗位数量。正规工资向下调整发挥了关键作用，因为在工资刚性较强的地区，这些长期效应较弱。在短期内，当工资刚性最强时，我们复现了文献中记录的非正规性上升效应。我们构建并估计了一个企业动态与非正规性的模型，以对这些结果作出合理解释。反事实分析表明，在短期内，非正规部门吸收了扩张的劳动力，并为企业与劳动者充当通向正规化的“踏脚石”。然而在长期内，它通过让生产率最低的企业得以存续，降低了移民带来的总量收益。

title: Work Hours Mismatch
abstract: We apply a revealed preference approach to administrative data from Washington to show that constraints on work hours are widespread: Workers have limited discretion over hours at a given employer, and there is substantial mismatch of workers who prefer long hours to employers that provide short hours. Voluntary job transitions imply a ratio of the marginal rate of substitution of earnings for hours to the wage rate of 0.5–0.6 for prime‐age workers. The average absolute deviation between observed and optimal hours is about 15%, and low‐wage workers face particularly acute constraints on hours. On average, observed hours tend to be less than preferred levels, and workers would require a 12% higher wage with their current employer to be as well off as with an employer offering ideal hours. These findings suggest that hour constraints are an equilibrium feature of the labor market because long‐hour jobs are costly to employers.
title_cn: 工作时间错配
abstract_cn: 我们利用华盛顿州行政数据，采用显示性偏好方法表明，工作时间约束普遍存在：劳动者在给定雇主处对工作时间的自主决定权有限，且偏好长工作时间的劳动者与提供短工作时间的雇主之间存在显著错配。自愿工作转换意味着，对于黄金年龄劳动者，收入对工作时间的边际替代率与工资率之比为 0.5—0.6。观测工作时间与最优工作时间之间的平均绝对偏差约为 15%，低工资劳动者面临的工作时间约束尤为严重。平均而言，观测工作时间往往低于偏好水平，劳动者需要在其当前雇主处获得高出 12% 的工资，才能与在提供理想工作时间的雇主处工作一样好。这些发现表明，工作时间约束是劳动力市场的一个均衡特征，因为长工作时间岗位对雇主而言成本较高。

title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
abstract: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
title_cn: 共同价值拍卖中的信息设计与道德风险：以OCS租赁拍卖为例
abstract_cn: 本文考察信息设计如何影响美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方的收入。在该拍卖中，拍卖结束后，中标者决定是否勘探所拍卖的地块，并须就其产值向政府支付权利金。我首先记录到，勘探率与公开观测到的未中标出价之间存在正相关。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的出价来推断其关于该地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标出价信息时的均衡出价策略。反事实模拟表明，替代性的出价披露政策显著提高了拍卖方收入。

title: Training Specificity and Occupational Mobility: Evidence From German Apprenticeships
abstract: Apprenticeships play a key role in enabling successful school‐to‐work transitions in many countries, but in the presence of imperfect information, the specificity of this type of training may entail important costs for those working outside their training fields. I study this issue in one of the most prominent training settings, the German apprenticeship system. Using administrative data and a broad occupational classification, I find that 40% of individuals work in occupations different from their training. I estimate the cost of mismatch using vacancy instruments and extend methodological approaches in high‐dimensional selection settings. Lacking training in one's occupation entails an average wage penalty of 14%, the equivalent of two years of work experience. The penalty increases with the task distance between training and occupation. My findings suggest that retraining is crucial to mitigate the adverse consequences from imperfect information in specialized training settings.
title_cn: 培训专用性与职业流动性：来自德国学徒制的证据
abstract_cn: 学徒制在许多国家是帮助青年成功实现从学校到工作过渡的重要机制，但在信息不完全的情况下，这类培训的专业性可能会给那些在所学领域之外工作的人带来显著成本。本文在最典型的培训制度之一——德国学徒制——中研究这一问题。利用行政数据和宽口径职业分类，我发现40%的个体从事与所受培训不同的职业。我使用空缺岗位工具变量估计错配成本，并拓展了高维选择情形下的方法。在所从事职业中缺乏相关培训，平均带来14%的工资惩罚，相当于两年工作经验的回报。该惩罚随培训与职业之间任务距离的增大而上升。我的发现表明，再培训对于缓解专业化培训环境中信息不完全所带来的不利后果至关重要。

title: Causal Inference for Spatial Treatments
abstract: Many events and policies (treatments) occur at specific spatial locations, with researchers interested in their effects on nearby units. I approach the spatial treatment setting from an experimental perspective: What ideal experiment would we design to estimate the causal effects of spatial treatments? This perspective motivates a comparison between units near realized treatment locations and units near counterfactual (unrealized) candidate locations, which differs from current empirical practice. I derive design‐based standard errors that are straightforward to compute. For observational data, I propose machine learning methods to find counterfactual candidate locations when observable characteristics, rather than potential outcomes, determine treatment probabilities. To accommodate methods for high‐dimensional data in the theory, I extend a double machine learning result to the design‐based framework with spatial correlations. I apply the proposed methods to study the causal effects of grocery stores on foot traffic to nearby businesses during COVID‐19 shelter‐in‐place policies, finding a large positive effect at very short distances, with no effect at larger distances.
title_cn: 空间干预的因果推断
abstract_cn: 许多事件和政策（干预）发生在特定的空间位置，研究者关注其对邻近单元的影响。我从实验设计的视角来处理空间干预设定：为估计空间干预的因果效应，我们会设计怎样的理想实验？这一视角促使我们将已实现干预位置附近的单元与反事实（未实现）候选位置附近的单元进行比较，这与当前实证做法不同。我推导了易于计算的基于设计的标准误。对于观测数据，当可观测特征而非潜在结果决定干预概率时，我提出机器学习方法来寻找反事实候选位置。为在理论中容纳高维数据方法，我将双重机器学习的一个结果推广到具有空间相关性的基于设计的框架。我将所提方法应用于研究COVID-19居家令期间杂货店对附近商家客流量的因果效应，发现在极短距离上存在较大的正效应，而在较大距离上没有效应。

title: Security Design Under Common‐Value Competition
abstract: This paper studies security design by bidders with dispersed information about a common‐value investment opportunity. Among a broad set of securities, bidders offer debt financing—the flattest securities. A first reason is that debt mitigates bidders' exposure to the winner's curse when there are two bidders. Second, the entrepreneur either has an informational advantage initially or gains one by inferring from the bids, and is more likely to select debt offers when optimistic about the project. While a bidder's choice of security also has a signaling effect, this effect is dominated by the winner's curse and informed‐selection effects, and does not affect the equilibrium outcome. These results contrast sharply with security design by a monopolistic investor, as well as with DeMarzo, Kremer, and Skrzypacz's (2005) results under private‐value competition. The entrepreneur's ability to commit to an ordered set of securities does not improve revenue.
title_cn: 共同价值竞争下的证券设计
abstract_cn: 本文研究竞标者在关于某一共同价值投资机会上拥有分散信息时的证券设计。在一大类证券中，竞标者提供债务融资——即最平坦的证券。第一个原因是，当存在两个竞标者时，债务能够缓解竞标者面临的赢家诅咒风险。第二，企业家最初要么具有信息优势，要么通过从出价中推断而获得信息优势，并且在对项目持乐观态度时更可能选择债务报价。尽管竞标者对证券的选择也具有信号效应，但该效应被赢家诅咒效应和知情选择效应所主导，并且不影响均衡结果。这些结果与垄断投资者的证券设计形成鲜明对比，也与 DeMarzo、Kremer 和 Skrzypacz（2005）在私人价值竞争下的结果形成鲜明对比。企业家承诺一组有序证券的能力并不能提高收入。

title: Choosing Who Chooses: Selection‐Driven Targeting in Energy Rebate Programs
abstract: We develop an optimal policy assignment rule that integrates two distinctive approaches commonly used in economics—targeting by observables and targeting through self‐selection . Our method can be used with experimental or quasi‐experimental data to identify who should be treated, be untreated, and self‐select to achieve a policymaker's objective. Applying this method to a randomized controlled trial on a residential energy rebate program, we find that targeting that optimally exploits both observable data and self‐selection outperforms conventional targeting. We use the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) framework (Imbens and Angrist (1994)) to investigate the mechanism in our approach. By estimating several key LATEs based on the random variation created by our experiment, we demonstrate how our method allows policymakers to identify whose self‐selection would be valuable and harmful to social welfare.
title_cn: 选择由谁选择：能源补贴项目中的选择驱动型目标定位
abstract_cn: 我们提出一种最优政策指派规则，该规则整合了经济学中常用的两种不同方法——基于可观测特征的目标定位与通过自我选择实现的目标定位。我们的方法可用于实验或准实验数据，以识别谁应接受处理、谁不应接受处理以及谁应自我选择，从而实现政策制定者的目标。将该方法应用于一项关于居民能源返利计划的随机对照试验，我们发现，同时最优利用可观测数据和自我选择的目标定位优于传统目标定位。我们使用局部平均处理效应（LATE）框架（Imbens and Angrist（1994））来考察我们方法中的机制。通过基于实验所产生的随机变异估计若干关键 LATE，我们展示了我们的方法如何使政策制定者识别出哪些人的自我选择对社会福利有价值、哪些人的自我选择对社会福利有害。

title: Assortative Matching on Income
abstract: We analyze marital matching on income using an extremely rich Dutch data set containing all income tax files over seven years. We develop a novel methodology that directly extends previous contributions to allow for highly flexible matching patterns. Investigating all marriages that took place between 2013 and 2019, we find that marital patterns are particularly intriguing. While a majority of couples match assortatively, a small but significant minority display negative assortative matching. We also show that standard approaches, which consider all married couples using current incomes (as opposed to pre‐marriage incomes used in our approach), may generate misleading conclusions.
title_cn: 收入上的同型匹配
abstract_cn: 我们利用一个包含七年全部所得税档案的极为丰富的荷兰数据集，分析基于收入的婚姻匹配。我们提出一种新方法，直接拓展了既有研究，以允许高度灵活的匹配模式。考察2013年至2019年间缔结的所有婚姻后，我们发现婚姻匹配模式尤为引人关注。尽管多数夫妇表现为同型匹配，但一个规模较小却显著的少数群体呈现负向同型匹配。我们还表明，采用当前收入（而非我们方法所使用的婚前收入）来考察所有已婚夫妇的标准方法，可能得出误导性结论。

title: Holding up Green Energy: Counterparty Risk in the Indian Solar Power Market
abstract: This paper studies how the risk of hold‐up affects procurement. I use data on the universe of solar power auctions in India. The Indian context allows clean estimates of counterparty risk, because solar plants set up in the same states, by the same firms, are procured in auctions intermediated by either risky states themselves or the trusted central government. I find that the counterparty risk of an average state increases solar prices by 10%. This risk premium sharply reduces investment, because demand for green energy is elastic. Contract intermediation by the central government eliminates the counterparty risk premium.
title_cn: 支撑绿色能源：印度太阳能市场中的交易对手风险
abstract_cn: 本文研究敲竹杠风险如何影响采购。我使用印度太阳能拍卖全样本数据。印度这一背景使得能够干净地估计交易对手风险，因为在同一邦、由同一企业建设的太阳能电站，其采购通过由有风险的邦政府本身或受信任的中央政府作为中介的拍卖进行。我发现，平均而言，一个邦的交易对手风险使太阳能价格上升10%。这一风险溢价大幅降低投资，因为绿色能源需求富有弹性。由中央政府进行合同中介可消除交易对手风险溢价。

title: Physician Behavior in the Presence of a Secondary Market: The Case of Prescription Opioids
abstract: This paper examines how drug diversion influences the prescribing practices of physicians and the equilibrium health impacts of prescription medications. Focusing on the case of prescription opioids, a commonly prescribed and frequently diverted medication at the heart of the worst drug crisis in U.S. history, I design and estimate a model of physician behavior in the presence of a secondary market with patient search. To access prescription opioids for medical purposes or misuse, patients search over physicians on the legal primary market or turn to an illegal secondary market. Physicians, who care both about their impact on population health and their revenue from office visits, take into account the possibility that patients might resell their prescriptions on the secondary market when prescribing. The model demonstrates that the potential for diversion will tend to make strict physicians more hesitant in their prescribing while leading lenient prescribers to loosen their prescription thresholds, thereby exacerbating prescribing differences between more and less lenient physicians. Estimates reveal that the presence of a secondary market induces most physicians to be more careful in their prescribing, which brings prescriptions closer to their optimal level, but also causes harm through the reallocation of prescriptions for abuse.
title_cn: 存在二级市场时的医生行为：以处方阿片类药物为例
abstract_cn: 本文考察毒品转移如何影响医生的处方行为以及处方药物的均衡健康影响。本文以处方阿片类药物为研究对象——这类药物被广泛开具且经常被转移，处于美国历史上最严重的毒品危机的核心——设计并估计了一个存在带有患者搜寻的二级市场时的医生行为模型。为获得用于医疗目的或滥用的处方阿片类药物，患者会在合法的初级市场上搜寻医生，或转向非法的二级市场。医生既关心其对人群健康的影响，也关心其来自门诊的收入，在开具处方时会考虑患者可能在二级市场上转售其处方的可能性。模型表明，转移的可能性往往会使严格的医生在开处方时更加犹豫，同时导致宽松的处方者放松其处方阈值，从而加剧较严格与较宽松医生之间的处方差异。估计结果显示，二级市场的存在促使大多数医生在开处方时更加谨慎，这使处方更接近其最优水平，但也通过将处方重新配置于滥用而造成损害。

title: Coordination and Commitment in International Climate Action: Evidence From Palm Oil
abstract: Weak environmental regulation has global consequences. When domestic regulation fails, the international community can target emitters with trade policy. I develop a dynamic empirical framework for evaluating trade policy as a substitute for domestic regulation, and I apply the framework to the market for palm oil, a major driver of deforestation and global CO 2 emissions. Relative to business as usual, a domestic production tax of 50% reduces CO 2 emissions by 7.4 Gt from 1988 to 2016, amounting to 0.26 Gt annually. Coordinated, committed import tariffs of similar magnitude reduce emissions by 5.4 Gt over the same period. The cost of these import tariffs is only $15 per ton of CO 2 , even accounting for compensating transfers that recognize welfare losses for producing countries. Without coordination and commitment, import tariffs have more limited effects. Alternative policies include domestic export taxes, which are fiscally appealing independent of emission concerns, and a carbon border adjustment mechanism, which encourages domestic regulation.
title_cn: 国际气候行动中的协调与承诺：来自棕榈油的证据
abstract_cn: 薄弱的环境监管会产生全球性后果。当国内监管失灵时，国际社会可以通过贸易政策针对排放者。我构建了一个动态实证框架，用于评估贸易政策作为国内监管替代手段的效果，并将该框架应用于棕榈油市场——棕榈油是森林砍伐和全球二氧化碳排放的主要驱动因素。与照常经营相比，50% 的国内生产税在 1988 年至 2016 年间使二氧化碳排放减少 7.4 Gt，年均减少 0.26 Gt。规模相近的协调且有承诺的进口关税在同一时期使排放减少 5.4 Gt。即使考虑到承认生产国福利损失的补偿性转移支付，这些进口关税的成本也仅为每吨二氧化碳 15 美元。若无协调与承诺，进口关税的效果则较为有限。替代政策包括国内出口税——无论是否出于排放关切，其在财政上都具吸引力——以及碳边境调节机制，后者会鼓励国内监管。

title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
abstract: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
title_cn: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

title: The Role of Trade in Premature Deindustrialization and Industry Polarization
abstract: We document two key patterns of structural change: premature deindustrialization and rising industry polarization. Using a dynamic open‐economy model with sector‐biased technological change (SBTC), we evaluate the role of trade in these shifts. Trade alone does not cause premature deindustrialization, but its interaction with SBTC—transmitting global technological change, amplifying the decline in manufacturing's relative price over time, and generating manufacturing trade imbalances across countries—deepens premature deindustrialization over time. Industry polarization, by contrast, emerges only through trade‐driven specialization, as countries diverge along lines of comparative advantage.
title_cn: 贸易在过早去工业化与产业极化中的作用
abstract_cn: 我们记录了结构变化的两个关键模式：过早去工业化和产业极化上升。我们使用一个包含部门偏向型技术变革（SBTC）的动态开放经济模型，评估贸易在这些变化中的作用。贸易本身不会导致过早去工业化，但其与 SBTC 的交互作用——传导全球技术变革、随时间放大制造业相对价格的下降，并在各国之间产生制造业贸易失衡——会随时间加深过早去工业化。相比之下，产业极化仅通过贸易驱动的专业化而出现，因为各国沿比较优势的路线分化。

title: Trade and Domestic Distortions: The Case of Informality
abstract: We examine the effects of international trade in the presence of a set of domestic distortions giving rise to informality, a prevalent phenomenon in developing countries. In our quantitative model, the informal sector arises from burdensome taxes and regulations that are imperfectly enforced by the government. In equilibrium, smaller, less productive firms face fewer distortions than larger, more productive ones, potentially leading to substantial misallocation. We show that in settings with a large informal sector, the gains from trade are significantly amplified, as reductions in trade barriers imply a reallocation of resources from initially less distorted to more distorted firms. We confirm findings from earlier reduced‐form studies that the informal sector mitigates the impact of negative labor demand shocks on unemployment. Nonetheless, the informal sector can exacerbate the adverse real income effects of economic downturns, amplifying misallocation. Last, our research sheds light on the relationship between trade openness and cross‐firm wage inequality.
title_cn: 贸易与国内扭曲：非正规就业的情形
abstract_cn: 我们考察在一组国内扭曲导致非正规现象（发展中国家普遍存在的一种现象）的情况下国际贸易的影响。在我们的定量模型中，非正规部门源于政府执行不力的繁重税收和监管。在均衡中，规模较小、生产率较低的企业面临的扭曲少于规模较大、生产率较高的企业，这可能导致严重的资源错配。我们表明，在非正规部门规模较大的环境中，贸易收益显著放大，因为贸易壁垒的降低意味着资源从最初扭曲较少的企业重新配置到扭曲较多的企业。我们证实了早期简约式研究的发现，即非正规部门缓解了负向劳动力需求冲击对失业的影响。尽管如此，非正规部门可能加剧经济下行对实际收入的不利影响，放大资源错配。最后，我们的研究揭示了贸易开放与跨企业工资不平等之间的关系。

title: Spatial Economics for Granular Settings
abstract: We examine the application of quantitative spatial models to the growing body of fine spatial data used to study local economic outcomes. In granular settings in which people choose from a large set of potential residence‐workplace pairs, observed outcomes in part reflect idiosyncratic choices. Using analytical examples, Monte Carlo simulations, and event studies of neighborhood employment booms, we demonstrate that calibration procedures that equate observed shares and modeled probabilities perform very poorly in these high‐dimensional settings. Parsimonious specifications of spatial linkages deliver better counterfactual predictions. To quantify the uncertainty about counterfactual outcomes induced by the idiosyncratic component of individuals' decisions, we introduce a quantitative spatial model with a finite number of individuals. Applying this model to Amazon's proposed second headquarters in New York City reveals that its predicted consequences for most neighborhoods vary substantially across realizations of the individual idiosyncrasies.

title: Promoting Women to Managerial Roles in the Bangladeshi Garment Sector
abstract: Women remain disadvantaged in promotion to managerial positions. We conduct a field experiment with 24 large garment factories in Bangladesh to test for inefficient representation of women among line supervisors. We identify the marginal female and male candidates for supervisory positions and randomly assign them to manage production lines. We document four findings: (1) In contrast to widespread negative beliefs about women's ability as supervisors at baseline, female candidates selected by the factories had similar skills to males; (2) during the trial, females performed worse than males, which we show is related to negative bias against them; (3) after the trial, however, many female candidates were retained as supervisors and, conditional on that, performed similar to males; and (4) after the end of our intervention, factories permanently increased the share of women among newly appointed supervisors. A conceptual framework of experimentation over discrimination rationalizes all these facts and cautions against the standard logic to test for discrimination: when there is uncertainty about the performance of the discriminated group, equal—or even worse—performance of the marginal candidates of that group is no longer sufficient to rule out inefficient discrimination.
title_cn: 促进孟加拉国服装行业女性晋升管理岗位
abstract_cn: 女性在晋升管理职位方面仍处于劣势。我们在孟加拉国24家大型服装厂开展了一项田野实验，以检验女性在流水线主管中的代表性是否不足。我们识别出主管职位的边际女性候选人和边际男性候选人，并随机分配他们管理生产线。我们得到四项发现：（1）与基线调查中普遍存在的关于女性主管能力的负面看法相反，工厂选出的女性候选人技能与男性相近；（2）在试验期间，女性表现不如男性，我们表明这与针对她们的负面偏见有关；（3）然而试验结束后，许多女性候选人被留任为主管，且在此条件下表现与男性相近；（4）在我们的干预结束后，工厂永久性地提高了新任命主管中女性的比例。一个关于歧视问题的实验概念框架可以解释上述全部事实，并对检验歧视的标准逻辑提出警示：当被歧视群体的表现存在不确定性时，该群体边际候选人表现相当——甚至更差——已不足以排除无效率的歧视。

title: Tying with Network Effects
abstract: We develop a leverage theory of tying in markets with network effects. When a monopolist in one market cannot perfectly extract surplus from consumers, tying can be a mechanism through which unexploited consumer surplus is used as a demand-side leverage to create a “quasi-installed base” advantage in another market characterized by network effects. Our mechanism does not require any precommitment to tying; rather, tying emerges as a best response that lowers the quality of tied-market rivals. While tying can lead to exclusion of tied-market rivals, it can also expand use of the tying product, leading to ambiguous welfare effects. (JEL D41, D85, K21, L15, L40)
title_cn: 网络效应下的搭售
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个具有网络效应的市场中搭售的杠杆理论。当某一市场的垄断者无法完全攫取消费者剩余时，搭售可以成为一种机制：未被攫取的消费者剩余被用作需求侧杠杆，在另一个具有网络效应的市场中创造“准安装基础”优势。我们的机制并不要求对搭售作出任何事前承诺；相反，搭售是作为一种降低被搭售市场竞争对手质量的最优反应而出现。尽管搭售可能导致被搭售市场的竞争对手被排斥，但它也可能扩大搭售产品的使用，从而产生不确定的福利效应。（JEL D41, D85, K21, L15, L40）

title: Racial Disparities in Housing Returns
abstract: We show that higher rates of distressed home sales (i.e., foreclosures and short sales) among Black and Hispanic homeowners severely reduce realized housing returns for these groups—in particular, to a level below that realized by White homeowners. Yet absent financial distress, houses owned by minorities do not appreciate at substantially slower rates than houses owned by nonminorities. Racial differences in liquidity and income stability, which are imperfectly observed by lenders, are important determinants of differences in distress. Policies that prevent foreclosure among distressed minorities can mitigate the racial gap in returns. (JEL D31, G51, J15, R31)
title_cn: 住房收益率的种族差异

title: Gender-Biased Technological Change: Milking Machines and the Exodus of Women from Farming
abstract: This paper studies how gender-biased technological change in agriculture affected women’s work in twentieth-century Norway. In the 1950s, dairy farms began widely adopting milking machines to replace milking cows by hand, a task typically performed by young women. We show that the machines pushed rural young women in dairy-intensive areas out of farming. The displaced women moved to cities where they acquired more education and found better-paying, skilled employment. Our results suggest that the adoption of milking machines broke up allocative inefficiencies associated with moving costs across sectors, which improved the economic status of women relative to men. (JEL J16, J24, J43, J61, N34, N54, O33)
title_cn: 性别偏向型技术变革：挤奶机与女性从农业中的大规模退出

title: Sequential Learning under Informational Ambiguity
abstract: This paper investigates a sequential social learning problem in which individuals face ambiguity about others’ signal structures and have max-min expected utility preferences, thereby exhibiting ambiguity aversion. Unlike previous findings, which suggest that learning outcomes depend on the specifics of the learning environment, this study establishes information cascades as a robust outcome under ambiguity. With sufficient ambiguity, cascades arise almost surely, regardless of the statistical properties of signal structures. Moreover, standard results predicting the absence of cascades can easily break down: Even minimal ambiguity can trigger cascades when signals are bounded and lead to incorrect herding when signals are unbounded. (JEL D81, D82, D83)
title_cn: 信息模糊性下的序贯学习
abstract_cn: 本文研究一个序贯社会学习问题：个体对他人信号结构存在模糊性，并具有最大最小期望效用偏好，从而表现出模糊厌恶。与以往认为学习结果取决于学习环境具体特征的研究发现不同，本文确立信息瀑布是在模糊性下的一种稳健结果。当模糊性足够大时，无论信号结构具有何种统计性质，信息瀑布几乎必然出现。此外，预测信息瀑布不会出现的标准结果很容易失效：即使极小的模糊性，在信号有界时也能触发信息瀑布，而在信号无界时则会导致错误的羊群行为。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

title: Monotonicity among Judges: Evidence from Judicial Panels and Consequences for Judge IV Designs
abstract: Judge IV designs rely on monotonicity—each judge being weakly stricter than more lenient judges in all cases. I measure monotonicity in judicial panels in five different settings and find that it is violated in up to 50 percent of nonunanimous cases. The monotonicity violations are not detected by conventional tests, but they would typically induce little bias in judge IV estimates. (JEL C26, K41, K42, O17)

title: Monetary Cooperation during Global Inflation Surges
abstract: We study optimal monetary policy during times of global scarcity of tradable goods. The optimal monetary response entails a surge in inflation, which helps rebalance production toward the tradable sector. While the inflation costs are fully borne domestically, however, the gains in terms of higher supply of tradable goods partly spill over to the rest of the world. National central banks may thus fall into a coordination trap and implement an excessively tight monetary policy causing an unnecessarily sharp global contraction. (JEL E24, E31, E32, E52, F11, F31, F42)
title_cn: 全球通胀飙升期间的货币合作
abstract_cn: 我们研究可贸易品全球稀缺时期的最优货币政策。最优货币反应会带来通胀上升，这有助于将生产重新平衡至可贸易部门。然而，通胀成本完全由本国承担，而可贸易品供给增加所带来的收益却部分外溢至世界其他地区。因此，各国央行可能落入协调陷阱，实施过度紧缩的货币政策，造成不必要的全球急剧收缩。（JEL E24, E31, E32, E52, F11, F31, F42）

title: Optimal Taxation and Market Power
abstract: Should optimal income taxation change when firms have market power? We analyze how the planner can optimally tax labor income of workers and profits of entrepreneurs. We derive optimal tax rates that depend on markups and identify four distinct components: the Mirrleesian incentive effect, the Pigouvian tax correction of the negative externality of market power, redistribution through altered factor prices, and reallocation of output toward the most productive firms. We quantify the optimal tax for the US economy and provide concrete proposals how to use income taxation to redistribute income while incentivizing production in the presence of market power. (JEL D24, D31, D43, H21, H23, H24, H25)
title_cn: 最优税收与市场势力
abstract_cn: 当企业拥有市场势力时，最优所得税是否应改变？我们分析计划者如何最优地对劳动者的劳动收入和企业家的利润征税。我们推导出取决于加成率的最优税率，并识别出四个不同组成部分：Mirrleesian 激励效应、对市场势力负外部性的庇古税纠正、通过要素价格变化实现的再分配，以及将产出重新配置到生产率最高的企业。我们对美国经济的最优税收进行量化，并就如何在存在市场势力的情况下利用所得税进行收入再分配、同时激励生产提出具体建议。（JEL D24, D31, D43, H21, H23, H24, H25）

title: Risk Preferences and Field Behavior: The Relevance of Higher-Order Risk Preferences
abstract: Using new methods, we measure the intensities of higher-order risk preferences (prudence and temperance) in an incentivized experiment with 658 adolescents. Aligned with theory, we find that higher-order risk preferences are strongly related to field behavior, including prevention, health, addictive behavior, and financial decision-making. Most importantly, we show that ignoring prudence and temperance can yield misleading conclusions about the relation of risk preferences to field behavior, and that survey measures of risk tolerance often relate to field behavior because they capture higher-order risk preferences. (JEL C83, D81, D91, J13)
title_cn: 风险偏好与实地行为：高阶风险偏好的相关性
abstract_cn: 我们使用新方法，在一个包含 658 名青少年的有激励实验中测量高阶风险偏好（审慎与节制）的强度。与理论一致，我们发现高阶风险偏好与实地行为密切相关，包括预防行为、健康、成瘾行为和金融决策。最重要的是，我们表明，忽略审慎与节制可能会对风险偏好与实地行为之间的关系得出误导性结论，并且风险容忍度的调查测量往往与实地行为相关，是因为它们捕捉到了高阶风险偏好。（JEL C83, D81, D91, J13）

title: The Opportunity Atlas: Mapping the Childhood Roots of Social Mobility
abstract: We construct a public atlas of mean outcomes in adulthood by childhood census tract. Outcomes vary sharply across neighborhoods: For children whose parents earn $27,000, the standard deviation of mean household income in adulthood is $10,420 across tracts within counties. Only half the variation in outcomes is explained by traditional measures of neighborhood opportunity like poverty rates. Experimental and quasi-experimental estimates indicate 60 percent of the variation in outcomes across neighborhoods is driven by causal effects. We demonstrate how our statistics can be applied to better target policies to improve low-opportunity areas and help families move to affordable high-opportunity areas. (JEL G51, I32, I38, J12, R23)
title_cn: 机会地图集：绘制社会流动性的童年根源
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个公共图谱，按儿童时期的人口普查区展示成年期的平均结果。结果在社区之间差异显著：对于父母收入为 27,000 美元的儿童，在县内各普查区之间，其成年期平均家庭收入的标准差为 10,420 美元。结果差异中只有一半能由贫困率等传统社区机会指标解释。实验和准实验估计表明，社区间结果差异的 60% 由因果效应驱动。我们展示了如何应用我们的统计结果，更好地瞄准旨在改善低机会地区的政策，并帮助家庭搬迁至可负担的高机会地区。（JEL G51, I32, I38, J12, R23）

title: Across-Country Wage Compression in Multinationals
abstract: Many employers link wages at establishments outside of the home region to the level at headquarters. We show this using new data on 1,200 multinationals’ establishments across the world and linked employee-level data on their establishments in Brazil. Headquarters wage changes arising from minimum wage and exchange rate shocks are partially transmitted to workers employed in the same position abroad. Wage change transmission appears to be direct and results from firm-wide wage-setting procedures rather than associated technology or employment changes. “Anchored” wage setting is somewhat associated with particular characteristics of the job × employer × headquarters-establishment country-pair. (JEL F23, F31, J24, J31, J38, M16, O15)
title_cn: 跨国公司中的跨国工资压缩
abstract_cn: 许多雇主将总部所在地区以外分支机构的工资与总部工资水平挂钩。我们利用关于全球 1200 家跨国公司分支机构的新数据，以及这些公司在巴西分支机构的关联员工层面数据，证明了这一点。由最低工资和汇率冲击引起的总部工资变化，会部分传导至海外同一岗位的员工。工资变化传导似乎是直接的，并且源于全企业范围的工资设定程序，而非相关的技术或就业变化。“锚定”工资设定在一定程度上与岗位×雇主×总部—分支机构所在国配对的特定特征相关。（JEL F23, F31, J24, J31, J38, M16, O15）

title: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments for 2SLS with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
abstract: We develop a test for instrument strength based on the bias of two-stage least squares (2SLS) that (1) generalizes Stock and Yogo’s and Sanderson and Windmeijer’s tests to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, and (2) extends Montiel Olea and Pflueger’s robust test for models with a single endogenous regressor to multiple endogenous regressors. Our test can be based either on an absolute bias criterion or on the 2SLS bias relative to a worst-case benchmark. We also develop extensions to test whether weak instruments cause bias in individual 2SLS coefficients. In simulations, our test controls size and is powerful, and we provide efficient code packages for its practical implementation. We demonstrate our testing procedures in the context of the estimation of state-dependent fiscal multipliers, following recent leading estimates.
title_cn: 含多个内生回归变量的2SLS弱工具变量稳健检验
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个基于两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）偏差的工具变量强度检验。该检验（1）将 Stock 和 Yogo 以及 Sanderson 和 Windmeijer 的检验推广为对异方差和自相关稳健，并且（2）将 Montiel Olea 和 Pflueger 针对单一内生回归变量模型的稳健检验扩展到多个内生回归变量。我们的检验既可以基于绝对偏差准则，也可以基于相对于最坏情形基准的 2SLS 偏差。我们还作了扩展，以检验弱工具变量是否会导致单个 2SLS 系数的偏差。在模拟中，我们的检验能够控制检验水平且具有较高功效，并且我们提供了便于实际实施的高效代码包。我们参照近期前沿估计，在状态依赖财政乘数的估计背景下展示了我们的检验程序。

title: Markups Across Space and Time
abstract: In this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold in different regions, not from deviations from uniform pricing. We propose a simple model consistent with these facts.
title_cn: 空间与时间中的加成率
abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于零售业加成率在跨空间和时间上表现的直接证据。加成率使用毛利率来衡量。我们考虑三个加总层面：整个零售业、企业层面和产品层面。我们发现：（1）加成率随时间相对稳定，并呈轻微顺周期特征；（2）加成率存在较大的地区离散度；（3）本地收入与本地加成率之间存在正的横截面相关性；（4）地区间加成率差异源于不同地区销售商品组合的差异，而不是源于对统一定价的偏离。我们提出了一个与这些事实相一致的简单模型。

title: The Economics of Equilibrium with Indivisible Goods
abstract: This paper develops a theory of competitive equilibrium with indivisible goods based entirely on economic conditions on demand. The key idea is to analyze complementarity and substitutability between bundles of goods, rather than merely between goods themselves. This approach allows us to formulate sufficient and essentially necessary conditions for equilibrium existence—which unify settings with complements and settings with substitutes. Our analysis has implications for auction design.
title_cn: 不可分商品的均衡经济学
abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个完全基于需求侧经济条件的不可分商品竞争均衡理论。核心思想是分析商品束之间的互补性与替代性，而不仅仅是单个商品之间的互补性与替代性。这一方法使我们能够给出均衡存在性的充分条件以及本质上必要的条件——这些条件统一了含互补品的设定与含替代品的设定。我们的分析对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

title: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity
abstract: We study the aggregate and redistributive effects of currency devaluations in a small open economy model with leverage-constrained banks and heterogeneous households. Our framework captures three stylized facts about financial dollarization in emerging economies: (1) a sizable share of domestic deposits is denominated in foreign currency; (2) these deposits represent significant foreign currency liabilities for local banks; and (3) dollar deposits are mainly held by wealthier households. A devaluation increases the real burden of foreign currency debt, causing an erosion of banks’ net worth, which depresses credit supply and economic activity. While richer households are partially insulated through their dollar deposits, poorer households cut consumption sharply in response to rising borrowing costs and falling real labor income. In our model deposit, dollarization amplifies the contractionary effects of a devaluation on output, investment, and consumption, in line with new empirical evidence for emerging economies. To achieve this result, both constrained intermediaries and heterogeneous households are crucial. In our framework, regulating dollarization can result in widespread welfare gains, especially for poorer households.
title_cn: 贬值、存款美元化与家庭异质性
abstract_cn: 我们研究一个小型开放经济模型中货币贬值的总量效应与再分配效应，该模型包含受杠杆约束的银行和异质性家庭。我们的框架刻画了新兴经济体金融美元化的三个典型事实：(1) 相当大比例的国内存款以外币计价；(2) 这些存款构成当地银行重要的外币负债；(3) 美元存款主要由较富裕家庭持有。贬值会加重外币债务的实际负担，导致银行净值缩水，进而压低信贷供给和经济活动。较富裕家庭通过其美元存款得到部分缓冲，而较贫穷家庭则因借贷成本上升和实际劳动收入下降而大幅削减消费。在我们的模型中，存款美元化放大了贬值对产出、投资和消费的收缩性效应，这与关于新兴经济体的新经验证据一致。要得到这一结果，受约束的金融中介和异质性家庭都至关重要。在我们的框架中，对美元化加以监管可以带来广泛的福利收益，尤其是对较贫穷家庭而言。

title: Inflation Risk and the Finance-Growth Nexus
abstract: When firms finance using long-term nominal debt issued by financial intermediaries, changes in expected inflation lead to a wealth transfer across sectors. Higher expected inflation decreases firms’ real liabilities and default risk, which helps reduce debt overhang. However, it hurts intermediaries’ real assets, leading to a contraction in credit supply. We theoretically demonstrate that intermediary financing conditions play a key role in the transmission of nominal shocks, influencing the premium investors require for bearing inflation risk. We provide empirical evidence supporting our novel inflation transmission mechanism and connect our findings to the banking stress of 2023. We also show that Taylor rules responding to both financial and real variables can help stabilise our economy.
title_cn: 通胀风险与金融—增长联系
abstract_cn: 当企业通过金融中介发行的长期名义债务融资时，预期通胀的变化会引发跨部门的财富转移。更高的预期通胀会降低企业的实际负债和违约风险，有助于缓解债务积压。然而，这也会损害金融中介的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥关键作用，并影响投资者为承担通胀风险所要求的溢价。我们提供了实证证据支持这一新的通胀传导机制，并将我们的发现与2023年银行业压力联系起来。我们还表明，同时对金融变量和实际变量作出反应的泰勒规则有助于稳定经济。

title: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
abstract: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.
title_cn: 银行在经济周期中的信息生产
abstract_cn: 银行生产的信息驱动其贷款决策和宏观经济结果，但这些信息本质上是私有的，因而难以分析。我们利用保密监管数据构建了一种新的银行信息质量测度，这些数据包含银行对美国企业贷款的私有风险评估。当地方经济状况恶化时，信息质量会提高，尤其是对新贷款、大额贷款和预期损失较高的贷款而言。在地方房价快速上涨期间，信息质量则会下降。我们的结果为信贷市场中信息生产具有逆周期性的理论提供了经验支持。

title: Costly Multidimensional Screening
abstract: A screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive component is optimal. The result holds for general type and allocation spaces, and allows for nonlinear and interdependent valuations. We discuss applications to monopoly pricing, bundling, and labour market screening.
title_cn: 有成本的多维筛选
abstract_cn: 一种筛选工具如果造成社会浪费，则是有成本的；否则是生产性的。委托人筛选一个具有多维私人信息和拟线性偏好的代理人，该偏好可沿两个成分可加可分：一维生产性成分和多维有成本成分。委托人能否通过同时使用有成本工具，改进简单的一维机制？我们表明，如果代理人对这两个成分的偏好以适当定义的方式正相关，那么仅筛选生产性成分就是最优的。该结果适用于一般类型空间和配置空间，并允许非线性和相互依赖的估值。我们讨论其在垄断定价、捆绑销售和劳动力市场筛选中的应用。

title: Bridges
abstract: Bridges are critical but sparse links in land transport networks. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in bridge construction over major rivers in the U.S. to measure the causal effects of land transport infrastructure. Bridges are more often built upstream than downstream of tributary confluences—where smaller rivers join larger rivers—generating local differences in connectivity. Local connectivity advantages have negative effects on per capita income. In contrast, more substantial changes in connectivity arising from the opening of major bridges increase per capita economic activity. A narrative explanation that can reconcile both results is that land transport infrastructure creates productivity advantages that drive economic growth, structural transformation, and urbanization over large spatial scales, but local sorting within the cities that form around early transport routes then reverses this gradient over smaller spatial scales.
title_cn: 桥梁
abstract_cn: 桥梁是陆路交通网络中关键但稀疏的连接环节。我利用美国主要河流上桥梁建设的准实验变异，来衡量陆路交通基础设施的因果效应。桥梁更多地建在支流汇流处的上游而非下游——即较小河流汇入较大河流之处——从而产生地方连通性的差异。地方连通性优势对人均收入具有负面影响。相比之下，由大型桥梁开通带来的更大幅度连通性变化则提高了人均经济活动。一种能够调和这两类结果的叙事性解释是：陆路交通基础设施创造生产率优势，在大空间尺度上推动经济增长、结构转型和城市化；但围绕早期交通路线形成的城市内部的本地分选，又会在较小空间尺度上逆转这一梯度。

title: Algorithm Design: A Fairness-Accuracy Frontier
abstract: Algorithm designers increasingly care not only about accuracy but also about fairness across predefined groups. We study the trade-off between these objectives and characterize it by a fairness-accuracy frontier: the set of outcomes that cannot be simultaneously improved in both dimensions. The shape of this frontier is governed by a simple property of the inputs, which we call group skew. In particular, reducing accuracy for both groups to increase fairness is justified if and only if inputs are group skewed. We also study an information design problem in which a designer regulates inputs but another agent chooses the algorithm. We show that, when inputs are not group skewed, banning group identity or other informative inputs is strictly suboptimal.
title_cn: 算法设计：公平性-准确性前沿
abstract_cn: 算法设计者日益不仅关注准确率，也关注预先定义群体间的公平性。我们研究这两类目标之间的权衡，并用公平—准确率前沿来刻画这一权衡：该前沿由无法在两个维度上同时改进的结果集合构成。其形状由输入的一项简单性质决定，我们称之为群体偏斜。特别地，为提升公平性而降低两个群体的准确率，当且仅当输入具有群体偏斜时才是合理的。我们还研究一个信息设计问题：设计者监管输入，而另一个主体选择算法。我们表明，当输入不具有群体偏斜时，禁止使用群体身份或其他信息性输入是严格次优的。

title: Marginal Returns to Public Universities
abstract: This article studies the returns to enrolling in U.S. public universities by comparing the long-term outcomes of barely admitted versus barely rejected applicants. I use administrative admission records spanning all 35 public universities in Texas, which collectively enroll 10% of all American public university students, to systematically identify and employ decentralized cutoffs in SAT/ACT scores that generate discontinuities in admission and enrollment. The typical marginally admitted student gains an additional year of education in the four-year sector, becomes 12 percentage points more likely to ever earn a bachelor’s degree, and eventually earns 8% more than their marginally rejected but otherwise identical counterpart. Marginally admitted students pay no additional tuition costs thanks to offsetting grant aid; cost-benefit calculations show internal rates of return of 26% for the marginal students themselves, 16% for society (which must pay for the additional education), and 7% for the government budget. Earnings gains are similar across admitting institutions of varying selectivity, but smaller for students from low-income families, who spend more time enrolled but complete fewer degrees and major in less lucrative fields. Finally, I develop a method to separately identify effects for students on the extensive margin of attending any university versus those on the margin of attending a more selective one, revealing larger effects on the extensive margin.
title_cn: 公立大学的边际回报
abstract_cn: 本文通过比较勉强被录取与勉强被拒绝申请者的长期结果，研究就读美国公立大学的回报。我使用覆盖得克萨斯州全部35所公立大学的行政录取记录——这些学校合计招收了全美公立大学学生的10%——来系统识别并利用SAT/ACT分数中分散的录取门槛，这些门槛在录取和入学上产生不连续。典型的边缘录取学生将在四年制高等教育部门多获得一年教育，最终获得学士学位的概率提高12个百分点，并最终比仅在录取上边缘被拒绝、其他方面相同的对应者多获得8%的收入。由于抵消性助学金资助，边缘录取学生不需支付额外学费；成本收益计算显示，边际学生自身的内部收益率为26%，社会为16%（社会必须为额外教育付费），政府预算为7%。不同选拔性的录取院校带来的收入增益相近，但来自低收入家庭的学生收入增益较小；这些学生入学时间更长，但完成的学位更少，且主修收入较低的专业。最后，我开发一种方法，分别识别处于是否就读任何大学的外延边际上的学生与处于就读更具选拔性大学这一边际上的学生的效应，发现外延边际上的效应更大。

title: Who’s Afraid of the Minimum Wage? Measuring the Impacts on Independent Businesses Using Matched U.S. Tax Returns
abstract: A common concern surrounding minimum wage policies is their impact on independent businesses, which are often feared to be less able to bear or pass on cost increases. We examine how these typically small and medium-size firms accommodate minimum wage increases along product and labor market margins using a matched owner-firm-worker panel data set drawn from the universe of U.S. tax records over a 10-year period, and using state minimum wage changes as identifying variation. We find that on average, firms in highly exposed industries do not substantially reduce employment—they do not lay off workers but moderately reduce part-time hiring. Instead, these firms are able to fully finance the new labor costs with new revenues, leaving average owner profits unchanged. Higher wage floors, however, forestall entry, particularly for less productive firms, reducing the number of independent firms operating in these industries by roughly 2%. Yet these industries do not shrink; instead, incumbent responses and strong positive selection among entrants reshape industries that rely heavily on low-wage workers, yielding fewer but more productive firms after the cost shock. We also take a worker-level perspective to examine how potentially vulnerable individuals are affected by minimum wage increases. Using panels of low-earning and young workers, we find that their average earnings rise substantially with the minimum wage, while they are no less likely to be employed. Worker transitions indicate that minimum wage increases boost retention and that worker reallocation from independent firms toward corporations buffers disemployment impacts from reduced hiring at independent firms.
title_cn: 谁害怕最低工资？利用匹配的美国纳税申报数据衡量其对独立企业的影响
abstract_cn: 围绕最低工资政策的一个常见担忧是其对独立企业的影响，人们往往担心这些企业承受或转嫁成本上升的能力较弱。我们使用一个匹配的所有者—企业—劳动者面板数据集，考察这些通常为中小型的企业如何沿产品市场和劳动力市场边际适应最低工资上调；该数据集取自为期10年的美国税收记录全集，并以州最低工资变化作为识别变异。我们发现，平均而言，受最低工资影响较大的行业中的企业并未大幅减少就业——它们不裁员，但会适度减少兼职招聘。相反，这些企业能够以新增收入完全覆盖新增劳动力成本，使所有者平均利润保持不变。然而，更高的工资下限会阻碍进入，尤其是生产率较低的企业进入，使这些行业中经营的独立企业数量减少约2%。但这些行业并未萎缩；相反，现有企业的反应以及进入者中强烈的正向选择重塑了严重依赖低工资劳动者的行业，在成本冲击后形成数量更少但生产率更高的企业。我们还从劳动者层面考察可能处于弱势的个体如何受到最低工资上调的影响。使用低收入劳动者和年轻劳动者的面板数据，我们发现其平均收入随最低工资大幅上升，而其就业概率并未降低。劳动者流动情况表明，最低工资上调提高了留任率，并且劳动者从独立企业向公司制企业再配置，缓冲了独立企业招聘减少所带来的就业减少影响。

title: Choice and Opportunity Costs
abstract: We define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an additional new consistency condition on preferences. However, we argue that the maximised utility cannot be straightforwardly interpreted as a welfare relevant “revealed preference”. A generalisation of our model accommodates additional departures from standard rationality in the form of menu effects.
title_cn: 选择与机会成本
abstract_cn: 我们将选择 x 的（物理意义上的）机会成本定义为：若 x 不可得时将会选择的备选项；并将任何未被选择的备选项的机会成本定义为 x 本身。经济主体对由备选项及其机会成本构成的配对具有偏好。由于成本影响选择且选择反过来影响成本，选择源于个体内部均衡，而非简单最大化。尽管包含重要的理性假设，由此产生的行为仍可能高度非标准，并允许非传递性选择。理性的效用最大化由偏好的一个额外的新一致性条件加以保证。然而，我们认为，被最大化的效用不能直接解释为与福利相关的“显示性偏好”。我们模型的一个推广可以容纳以菜单效应形式出现的、对标准理性的进一步偏离。

title: A Model of Social Duties
abstract: We develop and test a model of social duties. The model distinguishes unconditional duties to take or avoid certain actions from conditional duties that depend on the actions’ payoffs. It also distinguishes strict duties (must do) from liberal duties (ought to do). The disutility associated with duty violation depends on the duty’s strictness and is proportional to the externality the violation causes. The model rationalizes behavioral patterns that are incompatible with consequentialist preferences. Our tests comprise parameter estimation based on subjects’ behavior across different situations as well as measurement of duties through spectators’ appropriateness ratings.
title_cn: 社会义务模型
abstract_cn: 我们构建并检验了一个社会义务模型。该模型区分了采取或避免某些行动的无条件义务与取决于行动收益的有条件义务，也区分了严格义务（必须做）与宽松义务（应当做）。违反义务所带来的负效用取决于义务的严格程度，并与违反义务所造成的外部性成比例。该模型能够合理解释与后果主义偏好不相容的行为模式。我们的检验包括基于受试者在不同情境中的行为进行参数估计，以及通过旁观者的适当性评分来测量义务。

title: Private Private Information
abstract: Private signals model noisy information about an unknown state. Although these signals are called private, they may still carry information about each other. Our paper introduces the concept of private private signals, which contain information about the state but not about other signals. To achieve privacy, signal quality may need to be sacrificed. We study the informativeness of private private signals and characterize those that are optimal in the sense that they cannot be made more informative without violating privacy. We discuss implications for privacy in recommendation systems, information design, causal inference, and mechanism design.
title_cn: 私密的私人信息
abstract_cn: 私人信号刻画关于未知状态的噪声信息。尽管这些信号被称为私人信号，它们仍可能携带关于彼此的信息。本文引入私人—私人信号（private private signals）的概念：这类信号包含关于状态的信息，但不包含关于其他信号的信息。为实现隐私，可能不得不牺牲信号质量。我们研究私人—私人信号的信息量，并刻画如下意义上最优的信号：在不违反隐私的前提下，其信息量无法再提高。我们讨论这对推荐系统、信息设计、因果推断和机制设计中隐私问题的启示。

title: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
abstract: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for linking preferences for personal and social consumption and attitudes toward risk. We also offer an experimental test of the theory in which subjects were confronted with risky personal choices, riskless social choices, and risky social choices. Revealed preference tests show that subject choices are generally consistent within each choice domain but frequently involve at least some errors. We test for consistency across choice domains using a revealed preference test that accounts for these errors. The choices of a large majority of subjects are consistent with the predictions of our theory.
title_cn: 社会偏好与个人偏好的联系：理论与实验
abstract_cn: 我们给出了将个人消费偏好与社会消费偏好以及风险态度联系起来的充分必要条件。我们还对该理论进行了实验检验，实验中受试者面对有风险的个人选择、无风险的社会选择和有风险的社会选择。显示性偏好检验表明，受试者的选择在各个选择域内大体一致，但常常至少包含一些错误。我们使用一种考虑这些错误的显示性偏好检验来考察不同选择域之间的一致性。绝大多数受试者的选择与我们的理论预测相一致。

title: Health Shocks, Health Insurance, Human Capital, and the Dynamics of Earnings and Health
abstract: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.

title: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
abstract: Experimental evidence from Pakistan shows that distance poses a large and discontinuous access constraint: women with village-based training centers are four times more likely to access valued training opportunities. More than half of the travel penalty is incurred when crossing the village boundary. Exogenous stipend variation reveals that this boundary effect is costly to offset and is not explained by travel costs. Security considerations are an important factor: providing secure group transport raises take-up, while women with greater safety concerns and those traversing underpopulated areas, a proxy for insecurity, have lower take-up. The training has similar positive benefits for women attending inside- and outside-village centers.
title_cn: 玻璃墙：女性获取有价值技能培训机会所面临约束的实验证据
abstract_cn: 来自巴基斯坦的实验证据表明，距离构成了显著且不连续的获取约束：村庄内设有培训中心的女性获得有价值培训机会的可能性是其他女性的四倍。超过一半的出行惩罚发生在跨越村庄边界时。外生津贴变动显示，这一边界效应的抵消成本很高，且不能由出行成本解释。安全考量是重要因素：提供安全的集体接送服务会提高参与率，而安全担忧更强的女性以及穿行于人口稀少地区（不安全程度的代理变量）的女性参与率更低。培训对在村内和村外中心参加的女性具有相似的正向收益。

title: Ever since Allais
abstract: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.
title_cn: 自阿莱以来
abstract_cn: 阿莱对期望效用理论（EUT）的批评推动了风险下的选择理论的发展，这些理论放松了独立性公理，但遵循排序（完备性与传递性）和单调性（相对于一阶随机占优）的基本/传统公理。与旨在检验独立性的实验研究不同，我们的实验是全面的，检验了 EUT 所依据的整套公理。我们的计量分析也是非参数的，并在每个个体受试者层面进行。对绝大多数受试者而言，对独立性的偏离相对于对排序和/或单调性的偏离较小。

title: The Causal Effects of Youth Cigarette Addiction and Education
abstract: We develop and estimate a life-cycle model of addiction in which forward-looking youth choose to smoke, attend school, work part-time, and consume while facing borrowing constraints. The model features multiple channels for studying the reciprocal causal effects of addiction and education. Variations in endowments and cigarette prices are sources of identification. We show that education causally reduces smoking. A counterfactual experiment finds that in the absence of cigarette smoking, college attendance increases by 2 percentage points in the population. An alternative 25% additional excise tax achieves similar results. Impacts vary substantially across persons of different cognitive and noncognitive abilities.
title_cn: 青少年香烟成瘾与教育的因果效应
abstract_cn: 我们构建并估计了一个成瘾的生命周期模型：具有前瞻性的年轻人选择是否吸烟、上学、从事兼职工作以及消费，同时面临借贷约束。该模型包含多条渠道，用于研究成瘾与教育之间的相互因果效应。禀赋和香烟价格的变化是识别来源。我们表明，教育会因果性地减少吸烟。一项反事实实验发现，若不存在吸烟，总人口中的大学入学率将提高2个百分点。另一种方案是额外征收25%的消费税，也能取得类似结果。这些影响在不同认知能力和非认知能力的人群之间差异显著。

title: Booms, Busts, and Mismatch in Capital Markets: Evidence from the Offshore Oil and Gas Industry
abstract: How efficiently do markets reallocate capital in booms and busts? Using a novel dataset of offshore drilling contracts, I examine the role of matching in shaping industry reallocation. Oil companies search and match with capital (rigs) in a decentralized market. I find that oil and gas booms increase the option value of searching, which leads agents to avoid bad matches, reducing mismatch through a sorting effect. I provide an identification strategy to disentangle unobserved demand changes from the sorting effect. Estimating a model, I find substantial benefits to the sorting effect and an intermediary, but I find that demand-smoothing policies are ineffective.
title_cn: 资本市场的繁荣、萧条与错配：来自海上油气行业的证据
abstract_cn: 市场在繁荣与萧条时期重新配置资本的效率如何？本文利用一套新的海上钻井合同数据集，考察匹配在塑造行业再配置中的作用。石油公司在分散市场中搜寻资本（钻井平台）并与之匹配。我发现，油气繁荣提高了搜寻的期权价值，这使经济主体避免不良匹配，从而通过排序效应减少错配。我提供了一种识别策略，用以将不可观测的需求变化与排序效应区分开来。通过对模型进行估计，我发现排序效应和中介具有可观收益，但需求平滑政策无效。

title: US Public Debt and Safe Asset Market Power
abstract: The US government is the dominant supplier of global safe assets and faces a downward-sloping demand for its debt. We develop a model of the global economy in which US public debt generates special value for holders, endowing the US government with market power. We use variations in demand elasticities during high- and low-volatility regimes to distinguish this model from a price-taking benchmark and find that the data reject price-taking behavior in favor of the US government exploiting market power. We quantify the distortions, finding significant underprovision of safe assets, convenience yield markups, and welfare benefits for the United States.
title_cn: 美国公共债务与安全资产的市场势力
abstract_cn: 美国政府是全球安全资产的主导供应者，并面对向下倾斜的债务需求。我们构建了一个全球经济模型，其中美国公共债务为持有者带来特殊价值，使美国政府拥有市场势力。我们利用高波动与低波动状态下需求弹性的变化，将该模型与价格接受者基准区分开来，发现数据拒绝价格接受行为，而支持美国政府运用市场势力。我们量化了这些扭曲，发现安全资产供给显著不足、存在便利收益率加成，以及美国获得福利收益。

title: On the Nature of Entrepreneurship
abstract: This paper examines the nature of entrepreneurship using a novel panel dataset based on US Internal Revenue Service data. We analyze income growth trajectories and the determinants of entrepreneurial choice for business owners. Compared with prior household survey–based studies, we find that self-employed individuals have significantly higher average incomes and steeper income growth than their wage-earning matched peers. Contrary to survey evidence, we find a limited role for nonpecuniary motives, uninsurable risk, and liquidity constraints driving entrepreneurial choice. Prior work experience predicts entrepreneurial entry. Entry and exit rates into self-employment remain stable over time, including during the Great Recession.
title_cn: 论创业的本质
abstract_cn: 本文利用一个基于美国国税局（IRS）数据的新面板数据集考察创业的性质。我们分析了企业主的收入增长轨迹以及创业选择的决定因素。与以往基于家庭住户调查的研究相比，我们发现自雇者的平均收入显著更高，且其收入增长比匹配的可比工薪劳动者更陡峭。与调查证据相反，我们发现非货币动机、不可保险风险和流动性约束在驱动创业选择方面的作用有限。先前的工作经历可以预测创业进入。自雇的进入率和退出率随时间保持稳定，包括在大衰退期间。

title: Enlightenment Ideals and Belief in Progress in the Run-up to the Industrial Revolution: A Textual Analysis
abstract: We trace the evolution of the language of science, religion, and political economy in the centuries leading to the British Industrial Revolution. Using textual analysis of 264,443 works printed in England between 1500 and 1900, we test whether British culture manifested a belief in progress associated with science and industry. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, there was a separation in the languages of science and religion beginning in the mid-eighteenth century. Second, volumes using language at the nexus of science and political economy became more progress-oriented during the Enlightenment. Third, volumes using industrial language—especially those at the science-political economy nexus—were more progress-oriented beginning in the eighteenth century.
title_cn: 启蒙理想与工业革命前夕的进步信念：一项文本分析
abstract_cn: 我们追溯了在通往英国工业革命的数百年间科学、宗教和政治经济学语言的演变。通过对 1500—1900 年间在英格兰印刷的 264,443 部作品进行文本分析，我们检验了英国文化是否表现出一种与科学和工业相关联的进步信念。我们的分析得出三个主要发现。第一，自 18 世纪中叶起，科学语言与宗教语言出现了分离。第二，在启蒙运动期间，使用处于科学与政治经济学交汇处语言的书籍变得更加以进步为导向。第三，使用工业语言的书籍——尤其是处于科学与政治经济学交汇处的书籍——自 18 世纪起更加以进步为导向。

title: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention
abstract: A salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self-perpetuating: a downward bias in the firm quality distribution necessitates larger interventions in future crises. Our mechanism is quantitatively important: we show that if policymakers ignore such distortionary effects on firm quality dynamics, the resultant credit intervention would almost double the optimal amount.
title_cn: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
abstract_cn: 近几十年来，危机干预中出现了一个显著趋势：政府和中央银行绕过银行及其他信贷中介，直接向非金融企业提供资金。我们通过聚焦企业质量动态来分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任经济中，生产率高的企业比生产率低的企业更有可能在危机中存活。政府资金支持能够拯救更多企业，但无法根据企业生产率加以定制，从而削弱了危机的净化效应。这种政策扭曲具有自我延续性：企业质量分布的向下偏误使得未来危机中需要更大规模的干预。我们的机制在定量上很重要：我们表明，如果政策制定者忽视此类对企业质量动态的扭曲效应，由此产生的信贷干预规模将几乎是最优规模的两倍。
