title: All Along the Watchtower: Military Landholders and Serfdom Consolidation in Early Modern Russia
abstract: This article examines the emergence of coercive labour institutions using the case of serfdom in early modern Russia. We argue that serfdom consolidated under the pressure of landholding military elites who gained political influence due to the prolonged struggle with steppe nomads. To contain nomadic raids, the Russian state erected defence lines on the southern frontier, and granted land in the area to soldiers in charge of its defence. The soldiers could not farm while on defence duty, nor could they compete in the market for peasant labour, as the land had been selected for its defensive rather than agricultural value. The system was therefore only sustainable by restricting labour mobility. In response to the volume of landholders’ collective petitions, the Russian state gradually tied peasants to the land and institutionalized serfdom in the written law. Using newly digitized population data from the 17th century, we show a higher prevalence of serfs and military landholders in districts on the defence line. We also find a higher prevalence of small estates—up to 25 serf households—sufficient to support a soldier and his family. Placebo tests show that these patterns do not hold for non-serf peasants, or for merchants and artisans. To ensure causality, we develop a novel algorithm that reconstructs the optimal invasion routes for nomads and pinpoints the optimal location of the defence line using topographic data. Our results highlight the primacy of political economy factors over purely economic ones, such as the land–labour ratio or the grain trade, in the development of serfdom. This sheds new light on the possible mechanisms of institutional divergence between Eastern and Western Europe in the early modern period.
title_cn: 瞭望塔沿线：近代早期俄罗斯的军事土地持有者与农奴制巩固
abstract_cn: 本文以近代早期俄罗斯的农奴制为例，考察强制性劳动制度的兴起。我们认为，农奴制是在占有土地的军事精英的压力下得以巩固的，而这些精英因与草原游牧民族的长期斗争而获得了政治影响力。为遏制游牧民族的袭击，俄罗斯国家在南部边疆修筑防线，并把该地区的土地授予负责防御的士兵。士兵在执勤防御时无法耕作，也无法在农民劳动力市场上竞争，因为这些土地是按防御价值而非农业价值选定的。因此，这一制度只有通过限制劳动力流动才能维持。为回应土地占有者大量的集体请愿，俄罗斯国家逐步将农民束缚于土地，并在成文法中将农奴制制度化。利用新近数字化的17世纪人口数据，我们发现防线沿线各县的农奴和军事土地占有者比例更高。我们还发现，规模最多为25户农奴、足以供养一名士兵及其家庭的小型地产也更为普遍。安慰剂检验表明，这些模式并不适用于非农奴农民，也不适用于商人和手工业者。为确保因果性，我们开发了一种新算法，利用地形数据重构游牧民族的最优入侵路线，并精确定位防线的最优位置。我们的结果表明，在农奴制的发展中，政治经济因素相对于土地—劳动力比率或谷物贸易等纯经济因素具有首要地位。这为近代早期东欧与西欧之间制度分化的可能机制提供了新的启示。

title: Life-Cycle Wages and Human Capital Investments: Selection and Missing Data
abstract: We derive wage equations with individual-specific coefficients from a structural model of human capital investment over the life-cycle. This model allows for interruptions in labour market participation and deals with missing data and attrition problems. We propose a new framework that deals with missingness at random and is based on factor decompositions that allow for flexible control of selection. Our approach leads to an interactive effect wage specification, which we estimate using long administrative panel data on male wages in the private sector in France. A structural function approach shows that interruptions negatively affect average wages. Interestingly, they also negatively affect the inter-decile range of wages after twenty years. This is only partly due to the fact that interruptions are endogenous.
title_cn: 生命周期工资与人力资本投资：选择与缺失数据
abstract_cn: 我们从生命周期人力资本投资的结构模型推导出具有个体特定系数的工资方程。该模型允许劳动力市场参与中断，并处理数据缺失和样本流失问题。我们提出一个新的框架来处理随机缺失，该框架基于因子分解，从而能够灵活控制选择。我们的方法得到交互效应的工资设定，并使用法国私营部门男性工资的长期行政面板数据进行估计。结构函数方法表明，参与中断会对平均工资产生负面影响。有趣的是，二十年后，它们还会对工资的十分位间差距产生负面影响。这仅部分归因于中断具有内生性。

title: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone
abstract: In many industries, buyers diversify their supplier base to manage supplier disruption risk. We investigate the importance of such diversification as a determinant of demand and supplier entry in the context of the internet backbone, the worldwide network of undersea fibre-optic cables that underpins the internet. We specify a model of international bandwidth demand and cable operators’ dynamic entry and supply choices. The model is estimated using novel data on cross-border data flows, prices, cable characteristics, and disruptions. Counterfactual analysis reveals that supplier diversification accounts for a large share of entry and surplus created between 2005 and 2021. Relative to the socially optimal level of entry, distortions due to suppliers’ inability to capture fully the social benefits of diversity are as large as distortions due to business stealing.
title_cn: 多元化、市场进入与全球互联网骨干网
abstract_cn: 在许多行业中，买方通过多元化供应商基础来管理供应商中断风险。我们考察这种多元化作为需求和供应商进入决定因素的重要性，背景是互联网骨干网，即支撑互联网运行的全球海底光缆网络。我们设定一个国际带宽需求与光缆运营商动态进入和供给选择的模型。该模型使用关于跨境数据流、价格、光缆特征和中断事件的新数据进行估计。反事实分析表明，供应商多元化解释了2005—2021年间进入和创造的剩余的很大一部分。相对于社会最优进入水平，供应商无法充分获取多样性社会收益所导致的扭曲，与商业窃取所导致的扭曲一样大。

title: Taxes Depress Corporate Borrowing: Evidence from Private Firms
abstract: We use variation in state corporate income tax rates to re-examine the relation between taxes and corporate leverage. Contrary to prior research, corporate leverage rises after tax cuts for small private firms. An estimated dynamic equilibrium model shows that tax cuts make capital more productive and spur the use of leverage. Tax cuts also produce more distant default thresholds and lower credit spreads. These effects outweigh the lower interest tax deduction and lead to higher optimal leverage choices, especially for firms with flexible investment policies. The presence of the interest tax deduction raises consumer welfare in equilibrium.
title_cn: 税收抑制企业借款：来自非上市企业的证据
abstract_cn: 我们利用州企业所得税税率的变化重新考察税收与企业杠杆率之间的关系。与既有研究相反，针对小型私营企业的减税之后，企业杠杆率反而上升。一个估计得到的动态均衡模型表明，减税使资本更具生产率，并促进杠杆的使用。减税还会使违约边界更远，并降低信用利差。这些效应超过了利息税前扣除价值的下降，并导致更高的最优杠杆选择，尤其是对于投资政策灵活的企业。在均衡中，利息税前扣除的存在提高了消费者福利。

title: Structural Change, Land Use and Urban Expansion
abstract: How do cities grow in the process of structural transformation? To answer this question, we develop a multi-sector spatial equilibrium model with endogenous land use: land is used either for agriculture or housing. Urban land, densely populated due to commuting frictions, expands out of agricultural land. With low productivity and high subsistence needs, farmland is expensive, households cannot afford large homes and cities are very dense. Increasing productivity reallocates factors away from agriculture, freeing up land for urban expansion and limiting the increase in land values despite higher income and urban population. With the area of cities growing faster than urban population, urban density can persistently decline, as in the data over a long period. The quantitative evaluation calibrated to historical data assembled for France over 180 years explains a large fraction of the joint evolution of urban areas, population density and land values across time and space.
title_cn: 结构变迁、土地利用与城市扩张
abstract_cn: 城市在结构转型过程中如何增长？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个具有内生土地利用的多部门空间均衡模型：土地用于农业或住房。由于通勤摩擦，城市用地人口密集，并通过占用农业用地而扩张。在低生产率和较高的基本生存需求下，农田价格高昂，家庭无力负担大面积住房，城市非常密集。生产率提高使要素从农业中重新配置出去，释放土地用于城市扩张，并在收入和城市人口增加的情况下限制土地价值上升。当城市面积增长快于城市人口时，城市密度可以持续下降，正如长期数据所示。基于为法国180多年历史数据校准的定量评估，能够解释城市面积、人口密度和土地价值在时间和空间上的共同演化中的很大一部分。

title: Demand Stimulus as Social Policy
abstract: We exploit a panel of city-level data with rich demographic information to estimate the distributional effects of Department of Defense spending and its effects on a range of social outcomes. The income and employment generated by defence spending accrue predominantly to households without a bachelor's degree. These households as well as Black and Hispanic households tend to disproportionately benefit from this spending. Defence spending also promotes a range of beneficial social outcomes that are often targeted by government programs, including reductions in poverty, divorce rates, disability rates, and mortality rates, as well as increases in homeownership rates, health insurance rates, and occupational prestige. We compare the effects of defence spending with the effects of general demand shocks and explore reasons for the differential effects of the shocks.
title_cn: 需求刺激作为社会政策
abstract_cn: 我们利用一个包含丰富人口统计信息的城市层面面板数据，估计国防部支出的分配效应及其对一系列社会结果的影响。国防支出所产生的收入和就业主要归于没有学士学位的家庭。这些家庭以及黑人和西班牙裔家庭往往不成比例地从这项支出中受益。国防支出还促进了一系列有益的社会结果，而这些结果常常是政府项目所针对的目标，包括降低贫困率、离婚率、残疾率和死亡率，以及提高住房自有率、医疗保险覆盖率和职业声望。我们将国防支出的效应与一般需求冲击的效应进行比较，并探讨这些冲击产生不同效应的原因。

title: The Economics of Scaling Early Childhood Programs: Lessons from the Chicago School
abstract: Many ideas succeed in small trials but weaken considerably at scale. Using early childhood investment as a case study, this paper develops a dynamic microfounded human capital model stylized in the Chicago tradition. The framework features optimizing agents, complementary skill formation, and a policymaker choosing scaling strategies. The model shows that naive extrapolation from pilots systematically overestimates societal impact by overlooking voltage drops: declining benefit-cost profiles due to unrepresentative samples and contexts. Optimal scaling requires option C thinking, a mechanism-based design approach that anticipates these failures through backward induction from real-world implementation constraints. Studies in this special issue enrich the model’s insights.
title_cn: 规模化幼儿教育项目的经济学：来自芝加哥学派的经验
abstract_cn: 许多想法在小规模试验中取得成功，但在规模化时明显减弱。本文以幼儿教育投资为案例，构建一个按芝加哥传统进行风格化设定的动态微观基础人力资本模型。该框架包含最优化经济主体、互补性技能形成，以及选择规模化策略的政策制定者。模型表明，从试点进行的朴素外推会因忽视电压降（voltage drops）而系统性地高估社会影响：由于样本和情境不具代表性，收益-成本曲线下降。最优规模化需要选项 C 思维，这是一种基于机制的设计方法，通过从现实实施约束出发进行逆向归纳来预见这些失败。本期特刊中的研究丰富了该模型的洞见。

title: Permanent Capital Losses after Banking Crises
abstract: We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. We find that bank stocks experience large, permanent declines at the onset of crises. These losses predict commensurate long-term declines in banks’ earnings and dividends, rather than elevated future equity returns. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector.
title_cn: 银行业危机后的永久性资本损失
abstract_cn: 我们研究了46个经济体历史上银行业危机期间银行损失的驱动机制，以及政策干预在恢复银行资本状况方面的有效性。我们发现，银行股在危机爆发时经历大幅且永久性的下跌。这些损失预示着银行盈利和股息将出现幅度相称的长期下降，而不是未来股票收益率上升。银行损失主要由不良资产减记驱动，而不是由恐慌期间的资产出售驱动。危机期间强有力的流动性干预仅预示银行市值小幅、暂时上升。总体而言，这些结果表明，危机期间的银行损失并非主要源于暂时性的价格错位。早期流动性干预可以避免银行业危机，但仅在特定条件下才有效。一旦银行权益出现大幅下跌，政策应对在历史上未能阻止银行业持续资本不足。

title: Republican Support and Economic Hardship: The Enduring Effects of the Opioid Epidemic
abstract: In this article, we establish a causal connection between two of the most salient social developments in the United States over the past decades: the opioid epidemic and the political realignment between the Republican and Democratic parties. Drawing on unsealed records from litigation against Purdue Pharma, we uncover rich geographic variation in the marketing of prescription opioids that serves as a quasi-exogenous source of exposure to the epidemic. We use this variation to document significant increases in drug-related mortality and greater reliance on public transfer programs. This induced economic hardship led to substantial changes in the political landscape of the communities most affected by the opioid epidemic. We estimate that from the mid-2000s to 2022, exposure to the opioid epidemic continuously increased the Republican vote share in House, presidential, and gubernatorial elections. By the 2022 House elections, a one-standard-deviation increase in our measure of exposure led to a 4.5 percentage point increase in the Republican vote share. From 2012 until 2022, this increase in the House vote share translated into Republicans winning additional seats.
title_cn: 共和党支持与经济困境：阿片类药物流行的持久影响
abstract_cn: 本文建立过去几十年美国两项最突出的社会发展现象之间的因果联系：阿片类药物流行病与共和党和民主党之间的政治重组。利用针对普渡制药（Purdue Pharma）诉讼中解封的记录，我们发现了处方阿片类药物营销中丰富的地理差异，这种差异构成了对该流行病暴露的准外生来源。我们利用这一差异记录了药物相关死亡率的显著上升以及对公共转移支付项目的更大依赖。由此引发的经济困难导致受阿片类药物流行病影响最严重的社区政治格局发生重大变化。我们估计，从2000年代中期到2022年，对阿片类药物流行病的暴露持续提高了共和党在众议院选举、总统选举和州长选举中的得票率。到2022年众议院选举时，我们的暴露度量每提高一个标准差，导致共和党得票率提高4.5个百分点。从2012年到2022年，众议院得票率的这一提高转化为共和党赢得额外席位。

title: Diversifying Society’s Leaders? The Determinants and Causal Effects of Admission to Highly Selective Private Colleges
abstract: We use anonymized admissions data from several colleges linked to income tax records and SAT and ACT test scores to study the determinants and causal effects of attending Ivy-Plus colleges (Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Duke, and Chicago). Children from families in the top 1% are more than twice as likely to attend an Ivy-Plus college as those from middle-class families with comparable SAT/ACT scores. Two-thirds of this gap is due to higher admission rates for students with comparable test scores from high-income families; the remaining third is due to differences in rates of application and matriculation. In contrast, children from high-income families have no admissions advantage at flagship public colleges. The high-income admissions advantage at Ivy-Plus colleges is driven by three factors: (i) preferences for children of alumni, (ii) weight placed on nonacademic credentials, and (iii) athletic recruitment. Using a new research design that isolates idiosyncratic variation in admissions decisions for waitlisted applicants, we show that attending an Ivy-Plus college instead of the average flagship public college increases students’ chances of reaching the top 1% of the earnings distribution by 50%, nearly doubles their chances of attending an elite graduate school, and almost triples their chances of working at a prestigious firm. The three factors that give children from high-income families an admissions advantage are uncorrelated or negatively correlated with postcollege outcomes, whereas academic credentials such as SAT/ACT scores are highly predictive of postcollege success.
title_cn: 社会领导者多元化？高度选拔性私立高校录取的决定因素与因果效应
abstract_cn: 我们使用若干所高校的匿名录取数据，并将其与所得税记录以及 SAT 和 ACT 考试成绩相匹配，以研究就读常春藤+院校（Ivy-Plus colleges；包括常春藤联盟、斯坦福大学、麻省理工学院、杜克大学和芝加哥大学）的决定因素和因果效应。来自收入前 1% 家庭的孩子，其就读常春藤+院校的可能性是 SAT/ACT 成绩相当的中产家庭孩子的两倍以上。这一差距的三分之二源于考试成绩相当但来自高收入家庭的学生录取率更高；其余三分之一源于申请率和最终入学率的差异。相比之下，来自高收入家庭的孩子在旗舰公立高校并不具有录取优势。常春藤+院校中高收入家庭的录取优势由三个因素驱动：(i) 对校友子女的偏好，(ii) 对非学术资质的重视，以及 (iii) 体育招生。我们采用一种新的研究设计，分离出候补名单申请者录取决定中的个体特异性变异，并据此表明：就读常春藤+院校而非平均水平的旗舰公立高校，使学生进入收入分布前 1% 的概率提高 50%，使其就读精英研究生院的机会几乎翻倍，并使其在知名企业工作的机会几乎增至三倍。赋予高收入家庭孩子录取优势的这三个因素，与大学毕业后的结果不相关或负相关；而 SAT/ACT 成绩等学术资质则对大学毕业后的成功具有很强的预测力。

title: Bargaining and Inequality in the Labor Market
abstract: We use novel surveys of firms and workers, linked to administrative employer-employee data, to study the prevalence and importance of individual bargaining in wage determination. We show that simple survey questions accurately elicit firms’ bargaining strategies. Using the elicited strategies for 772 German firms, we document that the majority of firms are willing to engage in individual wage bargaining. Labor market factors predict firms’ strategies better than firm characteristics. Survey responses from nearly 10,000 full-time workers indicate that most workers provide their salary expectations before they receive a job offer. Most outside offers are rejected, with the worker remaining at the incumbent firm. There is substantial heterogeneity in workers’ bargaining behavior, which translates into within-firm wage inequality. Firms that set pay via individual bargaining have a 3 percentage point higher gender wage gap.
title_cn: 劳动力市场中的议价与不平等
abstract_cn: 我们利用与行政雇主—雇员数据相链接的新型企业和劳动者调查，研究个体谈判在工资决定中的普遍性和重要性。我们表明，简单的调查问题能够准确获取企业的谈判策略。利用从 772 家德国企业获取的谈判策略，我们发现大多数企业愿意进行个体工资谈判。劳动力市场因素对企业谈判策略的预测能力优于企业特征。近 10,000 名全职劳动者的调查回答表明，大多数劳动者在收到工作录用通知之前就给出自己的薪资预期。大多数外部录用邀约被拒绝，劳动者仍留在当前雇主处。劳动者的谈判行为存在显著异质性，并转化为企业内工资不平等。通过个体谈判设定工资的企业，其性别工资差距高 3 个百分点。

title: Demand Analysis under Latent Choice Constraints
abstract: Consumer choices are constrained in many markets due to either supply-side rationing or information frictions. Examples include matching markets for schools and colleges; entry-level labour markets; limited brand awareness and inattention in consumer markets; and selective admissions to healthcare services. We analyse a general random utility model for consumer preferences that allows for endogenous characteristics and a reduced-form choice-set formation rule that can be derived from models of the examples described above. We show non-parametric identification of this model, propose an estimator, and apply these methods to study admissions in the market for kidney dialysis in California. Our identification results require two sets of instruments, one that only affects consumer preferences and the other that only affects choice sets. We show that both instruments are necessary for identification. These results also suggest tests of choice-set constraints, which we apply to the dialysis market. We find that dialysis facilities are less likely to admit new patients when they have a higher-than-normal caseload and that patients are more likely to travel further when nearby facilities have high caseloads. Finally, we estimate consumers’ preferences and facilities’ rationing rules using a Gibbs sampler.
title_cn: 潜在选择约束下的需求分析
abstract_cn: 消费者选择在许多市场中受到约束，原因要么是供给侧配给，要么是信息摩擦。例子包括学校和高校的匹配市场、入门级劳动力市场、消费者市场中有限的品牌认知和注意力不足，以及医疗服务的选择性准入。我们分析一个用于消费者偏好的一般随机效用模型，该模型允许特征内生，并包含一个简约式选择集形成规则，该规则可从上述各例的模型中推导得到。我们证明该模型的非参数识别，提出一个估计量，并将这些方法应用于研究加利福尼亚州肾脏透析市场的收治情况。我们的识别结果需要两组工具变量：一组仅影响消费者偏好，另一组仅影响选择集。我们证明两组工具变量对识别都是必要的。这些结果还提示了选择集约束的检验，我们将其应用于透析市场。我们发现，当透析机构的病例量高于正常水平时，其接收新患者的可能性更低；当附近机构的病例量较高时，患者更可能前往更远的地方。最后，我们使用 Gibbs 抽样器估计消费者偏好和机构配给规则。

title: The Social Integration of International Migrants: Evidence from the Networks of Syrians in Germany
abstract: We use Facebook data to study Syrian migrants’ social integration in Germany, establishing five findings: (1) Migrants’ social integration varies across regions, driven by causal, place-based effects. (2) This spatial variation reflects how frequently Germans befriend neighbors and how likely they are to befriend migrants versus other Germans. Using a mover’s design, we show that both factors are shaped more by local institutions and policies than by persistent native characteristics. (3) Integration courses boost intergroup friending rates. (4) Migrants receive help from Germans, such as finding jobs or housing. (5) Germans quasi-randomly exposed to migrants in high school are likelier to befriend migrants later.
title_cn: 国际移民的社会融合：来自德国叙利亚人网络的证据
abstract_cn: 我们利用 Facebook 数据研究叙利亚移民在德国的社会融入，得到五项发现：(1) 移民的社会融入因地区而异，且由基于地点的因果效应驱动。(2) 这种空间差异反映了德国人与邻居结交的频率，以及他们与其他德国人相比与移民结交的可能性。采用搬迁者设计（mover’s design），我们表明这两个因素更多由本地制度和政策塑造，而非由持久的本地居民特征塑造。(3) 融入课程提高了群体间交友率。(4) 移民从德国人那里获得帮助，例如找工作或住房。(5) 在高中阶段准随机接触到移民的德国人，日后更有可能与移民成为朋友。

title: It Takes a Village: The Economics of Parenting with Neighborhood and Peer Effects
abstract: During adolescence, peer interactions become increasingly central to children’s development, whereas the direct influence of parents wanes. Nevertheless, parents can continue to exert leverage by shaping their children’s peer groups. We construct and estimate a model of parenting with peer and neighborhood effects where parents intervene in peer formation and show that the model captures empirical patterns of skill accumulation, parenting style, and peer characteristics among US high school students. We find that interventions that move children to better neighborhoods lose impact when they are scaled up, because parents’ equilibrium responses push against successful integration with the new peer group.
title_cn: 举全村之力：邻里效应与同伴效应下的养育经济学
abstract_cn: 在青春期，同伴互动对儿童发展日益居于核心位置，而父母的直接影响则逐渐减弱。尽管如此，父母仍可通过塑造子女的同伴群体来继续施加影响。我们构建并估计了一个包含同伴效应与邻里效应的父母养育模型，其中父母会干预同伴形成；并表明该模型能够刻画美国高中生在技能积累、养育风格和同伴特征方面的经验模式。我们发现，将儿童迁移到更好社区的干预在扩大规模时效果会减弱，因为父母的均衡反应会阻碍儿童与新同伴群体的成功融合。

title: The Value of Ratings: Evidence from Their Introduction in Securities Markets
abstract: We study the first-ever ratings for corporate securities. In 1909, John Moody published a book that partitioned the majority of listed railroad bonds into letter-graded ratings. These ratings had no regulatory implications and were largely explainable using publicly available information. We find that lower-than-market-implied ratings caused a rise in secondary market bond yields and that bonds that were rated experienced a substantial decline in their bid-ask spreads, consistent with reduced information asymmetries and improved liquidity. Our findings suggest that ratings can improve information transmission and highlight their potential value for the functioning of financial markets.
title_cn: 评级的价值：来自证券市场引入评级制度的证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究公司证券史上首个评级。1909年，约翰·穆迪（John Moody）出版了一本书，将大多数上市铁路债券划分为字母评级。这些评级没有监管含义，且在很大程度上可由公开可得信息解释。我们发现，低于市场隐含水平的评级导致二级市场债券收益率上升；而被评级的债券买卖价差大幅下降，这与信息不对称减少和流动性改善相一致。我们的发现表明，评级可以改善信息传递，并凸显其对金融市场运行的潜在价值。

title: Indirect Persuasion
abstract: We provide an organizational economics foundation for commitment to information structures in persuasion. An uninformed principal faces a joint screening-and-persuasion problem: she wants to influence a receiver’s belief about a payoff-relevant state using information elicited from a privately informed agent. The agent’s messages are publicly observed, so the principal cannot commit to a garbling of private communications. We show that commitment only to an employment contract with the agent permits the principal to implement the optimal unconstrained intermediation scheme. We apply our result to a brokerage contracting with sell-side analysts, where private communication is constrained by conflict-of-interest regulations, showing that public investment rating schemes can sidestep these regulations.
title_cn: 间接说服
abstract_cn: 我们为说服情境下对信息结构的承诺提供了组织经济学基础。一个不知情的委托人面临筛选与说服的联合问题：她希望利用从拥有私人信息的代理人那里获取的信息，影响接收者关于某一与支付相关状态的信念。代理人的消息会被公开观察到，因此委托人无法承诺对私下沟通的信息进行模糊化处理。我们证明，只有对与代理人签订的雇佣合同作出承诺，委托人才能够实施最优的无约束中介方案。我们将这一结果应用于与卖方分析师有关的经纪合同安排；在该情形中，私下沟通受到利益冲突监管的约束，而公开投资评级方案能够绕过这些监管。

title: Mandated versus Voluntary Adaptation to Natural Disasters: The Case of US Wildfires
abstract: Despite escalating losses in climate-related disasters, adoption of protective technologies and behaviors is limited by risk misperception, externalities, and insurance market frictions. One response to these market failures is to mandate these investments. We measure the effect of California’s wildfire building codes on own and neighboring structure survival using comprehensive data on US homes exposed to wildfires since 2000. Differences across jurisdictions and vintages reveal remarkable resilience effects of building codes. Codes also increase survival of neighboring homes by reducing structure-to-structure spread. We then develop and estimate a model of social benefits of mandatory building standards versus other adaptation policies.
title_cn: 自然灾害的强制性适应与自愿性适应：以美国野火为例
abstract_cn: 尽管气候相关灾害造成的损失不断上升，防护性技术和行为的采用仍受风险误判、外部性和保险市场摩擦的限制。应对这些市场失灵的一种方式是强制要求进行这些投资。我们利用2000年以来受野火影响的美国住宅的综合数据，衡量加州野火建筑规范对自身及邻近建筑结构存续的影响。不同辖区和建筑年代的差异显示，建筑规范具有显著的韧性效应。规范还通过减少建筑结构间的火势蔓延，提高邻近住宅的存续概率。随后，我们构建并估计一个模型，比较强制性建筑标准与其他适应政策的社会收益。

title: Automation and Polarization
abstract: We develop an assignment model of automation. Each of a continuum of tasks of variable complexity is assigned to either capital or one of a continuum of labor skills. We characterize conditions for interior automation, whereby tasks of intermediate complexity are performed by capital. Interior automation arises when low-skill wages are low and effective cost of capital in low-complexity tasks is high. Minimum wages make interior automation less likely. Higher capital productivity causes employment and wage polarization, changes the skill premium nonmonotonically, and reduces the real wage of workers with comparative advantage profiles close to that of capital.
title_cn: 自动化与极化
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个自动化的任务分配模型。复杂程度可变的任务构成一个连续统，其中每项任务被分配给资本或劳动技能连续统中的某一技能水平。我们刻画了内部自动化（interior automation）的条件，即中等复杂度的任务由资本完成。当低技能工资较低，且资本在低复杂度任务中的有效成本较高时，内部自动化会出现。最低工资会降低内部自动化出现的可能性。资本生产率提高会导致就业和工资极化，非单调地改变技能溢价，并降低比较优势特征与资本相近的工人的实际工资。

title: Endogenous Treatment Models with Social Interactions: An Application to the Impact of Exercise on Self-Esteem
abstract: We address the estimation of endogenous treatment models with social interactions in both the treatment and outcome equations. We model the interactions between individuals via a game theoretic approach based on discrete Bayesian games. We employ a nested pseudo joint likelihood algorithm when obtaining the model’s parameters and provide relevant treatment effects and procedures for their estimation. Our empirical application examines the impact of an individual’s exercise frequency on their level of self-esteem. We find that an individual’s exercise frequency is influenced by their expectation of their friends’ exercise frequency. Moreover, an individual’s level of self-esteem is affected by their level of exercise and, at relatively lower levels of self-esteem, by the expectation of their friends’ self-esteem.
title_cn: 具有社会互动的内生处理模型：锻炼对自尊影响的一个应用
abstract_cn: 我们研究处理方程和结果方程均存在社会互动的内生处理模型的估计问题。我们通过基于离散贝叶斯博弈的博弈论方法对个体之间的互动进行建模。在获取模型参数时，我们采用嵌套伪联合似然算法，并给出相关的处理效应及其估计程序。我们的实证应用考察个体锻炼频率对其自尊水平的影响。我们发现，个体的锻炼频率受到其对朋友锻炼频率预期的影响。此外，个体的自尊水平受到其锻炼水平的影响，并且在自尊水平相对较低时，还受到对朋友自尊水平预期的影响。

title: The End of the American Dream? Inequality and Segregation in US Cities
abstract: Since the 1980s, the United States has experienced both an increase in income inequality and a rise in residential segregation by income. We develop a general equilibrium model with residential choice, where segregation and inequality amplify each other because of a local spillover affecting educational returns. We calibrate the model to a representative US metro in 1980 and use the micro estimates of neighborhood exposure effects in Chetty and Hendren (2018b) to discipline the spillover. We then explore the economy’s response to an unexpected skill premium shock and show that segregation played a significant role in amplifying the increase in inequality.
title_cn: 美国梦的终结？美国城市中的不平等与隔离
abstract_cn: 自20世纪80年代以来，美国既经历了收入不平等加剧，也经历了按收入划分的居住隔离上升。我们构建了一个包含居住选择的一般均衡模型；在该模型中，由于存在影响教育回报的本地溢出效应，隔离与不平等会相互放大。我们将模型校准到1980年美国一个代表性都市区，并利用 Chetty and Hendren（2018b）对邻里暴露效应的微观估计来约束该溢出效应。随后，我们考察经济对未预期技能溢价冲击的反应，并表明隔离在放大不平等上升方面发挥了重要作用。

title: Making Information More Valuable
abstract: We study what changes to an agent's decision problem increase her value for information. We prove that information becomes more valuable if and only if the agent's reduced-form payoff in her belief becomes more convex. When the transformation corresponds to the addition of an action, the requisite increase in convexity occurs if and only if a simple geometric condition holds, which extends in a natural way to the addition of multiple actions. We apply these findings to two scenarios: a monopolistic screening problem in which the good is information and delegation with information acquisition.
title_cn: 使信息更有价值
abstract_cn: 我们研究经济主体决策问题的何种变化会提高其对信息的估值。我们证明，当且仅当经济主体以信念为自变量的简约式收益变得更凸时，信息才会变得更有价值。当该变换对应于新增一个行动时，所需的凸性提高当且仅当一个简单的几何条件成立时才会出现，而该条件可以自然推广到新增多个行动的情形。我们将这些发现应用于两类情形：商品为信息的垄断筛选问题，以及含信息获取的授权问题。

title: Efficiency and Redistribution in Environmental Policy: An Equilibrium Analysis of Agricultural Supply Chains
abstract: I build an empirical model of the South American agricultural sector to show how environmental policy is transmitted along a supply chain when regulation at the externality’s source is infeasible. Given obstacles to a first-best carbon tax on farmers, I show how second-best alternatives—downstream agribusiness taxes—reduce upstream emissions, but their effectiveness is limited by poor targeting while also being regressive. Agribusiness monopsony power worsens targeting by lowering pass-through to upstream farmers in uncompetitive and emissions-intense regions, thus eroding the Pigouvian signal where social cost is highest. By contrast, small-scale but well-targeted upstream interventions perform robustly when markets face preexisting distortions.
title_cn: 环境政策中的效率与再分配：农业供应链的均衡分析
abstract_cn: 我构建了一个南美洲农业部门的实证模型，以说明当在外部性的源头进行监管不可行时，环境政策如何沿供应链传导。鉴于对农民征收第一最优碳税存在障碍，我表明次优替代方案——下游农业企业税——能够减少上游排放，但其有效性受制于目标定位不佳，同时也具有累退性。农业企业的买方垄断力量会恶化目标定位：在缺乏竞争且排放密集的地区，它降低了对上游农民的传导，从而在社会成本最高之处削弱庇古信号。相比之下，当市场面临既有扭曲时，小规模但目标定位良好的上游干预表现稳健。

title: How Cultural Diversity Drives Innovation: Surnames and Patents in US History
abstract: This paper examines the impact of cultural diversity on innovation. Focusing on the United States from 1850 to 1940, we develop a novel surname-based measure of cultural diversity and combine this with patent data. Leveraging quasi-random variation in counties’ surname compositions driven by historical immigration, we find that rising diversity increased both the quantity and the quality of innovation within counties and for individual inventors. Examining mechanisms, we provide evidence suggesting that greater surname diversity accelerated innovation both by expanding the range of ideas, skills, and perspectives available for recombination and by fostering the diverse social interactions that facilitate idea sharing.
title_cn: 文化多样性如何驱动创新：美国历史上的姓氏与专利
abstract_cn: 本文考察文化多样性对创新的影响。我们聚焦1850—1940年的美国，构建了一种新的基于姓氏的文化多样性测度，并将其与专利数据相结合。利用由历史移民驱动的各县姓氏构成中的准随机变异，我们发现，多样性上升同时提高了县层面和个体发明者层面的创新数量与质量。在考察机制时，我们提供的证据表明，更大的姓氏多样性加速创新，既通过扩大可用于重组的想法、技能和视角的范围，也通过促进有助于想法分享的多样化社会互动。

title: A Study of the Microdynamics of Early-Childhood Learning
abstract: This paper investigates the weekly evolution of skills as measured by unique data from a widely-emulated early childhood home-visiting program in rural China. The design of the study avoids input endogeneity issues and lack of comparable measures of skills that plague previous studies. Skills, nominally classified as the same, in fact, do not appear to share a common unit scale across levels. They are produced by skill-lifecycle-stage-specific learning processes. A novel dynamic stochastic skill production model for multiple skills is developed, aligning with empirical evidence. The model explains the "fadeout" of measures of learning through forgetting or depreciation of skills.
title_cn: 幼儿期学习的微观动态研究
abstract_cn: 本文利用来自中国农村一项被广泛效仿的幼儿家访项目的独特数据，考察技能的周度演变。该研究设计避免了困扰以往研究的投入内生性问题以及缺乏可比技能测度的问题。名义上归为同一类的技能，在不同水平上事实上似乎并不共享同一单位尺度。它们由技能生命周期阶段特定的学习过程所生产。本文构建了一个与经验证据相一致的多技能动态随机技能生产模型。该模型通过技能的遗忘或折旧解释了学习测度的消退。

title: To Own or to Rent? The Effects of Transaction Taxes on Housing Markets
abstract: Using sales and leasing data, this paper finds three novel effects of a higher property transaction tax: higher buy-to-rent transactions alongside lower buy-to-own transactions despite both being taxed, a lower sales-to-leases ratio, and a lower price-to-rent ratio. This paper explains these facts by developing a search model with entry of investors and households, households choosing to own or rent in the presence of credit frictions, and homeowners deciding when to move house. A higher transaction tax reduces homeowners’ mobility and increases demand for rental properties, which explains the empirical facts and leads to a lower homeownership rate. The deadweight loss is large at 111% of tax revenue, with more than half of this due to distorting decisions to own or rent.
title_cn: 买房还是租房？交易税对住房市场的影响
abstract_cn: 本文利用销售和租赁数据发现，提高房产交易税会带来三个新效应：尽管购房出租交易和购房自住交易均被征税，购房出租交易增加而购房自住交易减少；销售与租赁交易之比下降；房价租金比下降。本文通过构建一个搜寻模型来解释这些事实，模型中包含投资者和家庭的进入、家庭在信贷摩擦下选择自有还是租赁，以及房主决定何时换房。更高的交易税会降低房主的流动性并增加对租赁住房的需求，这解释了上述经验事实，并导致更低的住房自有率。无谓损失很大，相当于税收收入的 111%，其中一半以上来自对自有或租赁决策的扭曲。

title: Digital Distractions with Peer Influence: The Impact of Mobile App Usage on Academic and Labor Market Outcomes
abstract: Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students’ own and their peers’ app usage affect academic performance, physical health, and labor market outcomes. Our analysis draws on administrative data from a Chinese university covering three student cohorts over four years. We exploit random roommate assignments, differential exposure to a policy shock (gaming restrictions for minors), and differential exposure to a discrete event (the introduction of a blockbuster video game) for identification. App usage is contagious: a one s.d. increase in roommates’ in-college app usage raises own usage by 5.8%. High app usage is harmful across all measured outcomes. A one s.d. increase in app usage reduces GPAs by 36.2% of a within-cohort-major s.d. and lowers wages by 2.3%. Roommates’ app usage reduces a student’s GPA and wages through both disruptions and behavioral spillovers, generating a total negative effect that exceeds half the magnitude of the impact from the student’s own app usage. Extending China’s three-hour-per-week gaming restriction for minors to college students would boost their initial wages by 0.9%. High-frequency GPS and app usage data show that heavy app users spend less time in study halls, are more frequently late or absent from class, and get less sleep.
title_cn: 同伴影响下的数字分心：移动应用使用对学业与劳动力市场结果的影响
abstract_cn: 对青少年过度使用手机的担忧日益加剧。我们给出了行为性同伴效应与情境性同伴效应的估计，并提供了关于学生自身及其同伴的 App 使用如何影响学业表现、身体健康和劳动力市场结果的全面证据。我们的分析使用中国某大学的行政数据，涵盖三个学生队列、时间跨度为四年。我们利用随机室友分配、对政策冲击（未成年人游戏限制）的不同暴露程度，以及对一个离散事件（一款爆款电子游戏上线）的不同暴露程度进行识别。App 使用具有传染性：室友在校期间 App 使用量增加一个标准差（s.d.），会使自身使用量提高 5.8%。高 App 使用量对所有测度结果均产生不利影响。App 使用量增加一个标准差，会使 GPA 下降相当于同队列同专业内标准差 36.2% 的幅度，并使工资降低 2.3%。室友的 App 使用既通过干扰、也通过行为溢出降低学生的 GPA 和工资，所产生的总负向效应超过学生自身 App 使用影响幅度的一半。将中国针对未成年人的每周三小时游戏限制扩展到大学生，会使其起薪提高 0.9%。高频 GPS 和 App 使用数据显示，重度 App 使用者花在自习室的时间更少、上课迟到或缺勤的频率更高，并且睡眠更少。

title: Slum Upgrading and Long-Run Urban Development: Evidence from Indonesia
abstract: Developing countries face massive urbanization and slum upgrading is a popular policy to improve shelter for many. Yet, preserving slums at the expense of formal developments can raise concerns of misallocation of land. We estimate causal, long-term impacts of the 1969–84 KIP programme, which provided basic upgrades to 5 million residents covering 25% of land in Jakarta, Indonesia. We assemble high-resolution data on programme boundaries and 2015 outcomes and address programme selection bias through localized comparisons. On average, KIP areas today have lower land values, shorter buildings, and are more informal, per a photographs-based slum index. The negative effects are concentrated within 5 km of the CBD. We develop a spatial equilibrium model to characterize the welfare implications of KIP. Counterfactuals suggest that 79% of the welfare effects stem from removing KIP in the centre and highlight how to mitigate losses to displaced residents.
title_cn: 贫民窟改造与长期城市发展：来自印度尼西亚的证据
abstract_cn: 发展中国家面临大规模城市化，贫民窟改造是改善许多人住房条件的常见政策。然而，以牺牲正规开发为代价保留贫民窟，可能引发土地错配的担忧。我们估计了1969—1984年KIP项目的因果性长期影响；该项目为500万居民提供了基本改造，覆盖印度尼西亚雅加达25%的土地。我们整理了项目边界与2015年结果的高分辨率数据，并通过局部比较处理项目选择偏差。平均而言，根据基于照片构建的贫民窟指数，如今KIP地区的土地价值更低、建筑物更矮，且非正规程度更高。负面影响集中在中央商务区（CBD）5公里范围内。我们构建了一个空间均衡模型来刻画KIP的福利含义。反事实分析表明，79%的福利效应源于取消市中心的KIP，并突出说明如何减轻被迫搬迁居民的损失。

title: Auctions with Frictions: Recruitment, Entry, and Limited Commitment
abstract: Auction models are convenient abstractions of informal price-formation processes that arise in markets for assets or services. These processes involve frictions like bidder recruitment costs for sellers, participation costs for bidders, and limitations on sellers’ commitment abilities. This paper develops an auction model that captures such frictions. We derive novel insights, notably that outcomes are often inefficient, that markets sometimes unravel, and that the observability of competition may have a large effect.
title_cn: 带有摩擦的拍卖：招募、进入与有限承诺
abstract_cn: 拍卖模型是对资产或服务市场中出现的非正式价格形成过程的一种便捷抽象。这些过程涉及摩擦，例如卖方招募竞标者的成本、竞标者的参与成本，以及卖方承诺能力的限制。本文构建了一个刻画此类摩擦的拍卖模型。我们得出了一些新的洞见，尤其是：结果常常是无效率的，市场有时会瓦解，而竞争的可观测性可能产生很大影响。

title: The Price of Housing in the United States, 1890–2006
abstract: We construct the first annual market rent and home sales price series for American cities over the twentieth century using 2.7 million newspaper real estate listings. Our findings revise several stylized facts about U.S. housing markets. Real market rents did not fall during the postwar period in most cities and rose nationally by 60% from 1890 to 2006. We also document higher sales price growth between 1953 and 1987 relative to previous series. Real prices reached almost four times their 1890 level by 2006. Prices grew most in metros with high demand and low levels of construction. We find that the rent-to-price ratio fell from about 8% in the early twentieth century to 3% by 2006, consistent with declines in the cost of owning housing relative to renting. For the typical year in our period, the annual return to owning housing was 9%, driven mostly by rental returns of 7.7%, with capital gains contributing only 1.3%. While capital gains were close to zero from 1890 to 1940, they grew to nearly a third of total returns from 1970 to 2006.

title: What Do Policies Value?
abstract: When a policy prioritizes one person over another, is it because they benefit more, or because they are preferred? This paper develops a method to uncover the values consistent with observed allocation decisions. We estimate how much each person benefits from an intervention, and then reconcile the allocation with (i) the welfare weights assigned to different people; (ii) heterogeneous treatment effects of the intervention; and (iii) weights on different outcomes. We demonstrate this approach by analyzing Mexico’s PROGRESA anti-poverty programme. The analysis reveals that while the programme prioritized certain subgroups—such as indigenous households—the fact that those groups benefited more implies that the programme did not actually assign them a higher welfare weight. We also find evidence that the policy valued outcomes differently from households. The PROGRESA case illustrates how the method makes it possible to audit existing policies, and to design future policies that better align with values.
title_cn: 政策重视什么？
abstract_cn: 当一项政策在一个人与另一个人之间优先前者时，是因为前者受益更多，还是因为前者更受偏好？本文提出一种方法，用以揭示与观察到的分配决策相一致的价值取向。我们估计每个人从某项干预中获益多少，然后将分配结果与以下因素进行一致性对照：(i) 赋予不同个人的福利权重；(ii) 干预的异质性处理效应；(iii) 对不同结果的权重。我们通过分析墨西哥的 PROGRESA 反贫困项目来展示这一方法。分析表明，尽管该项目优先考虑某些子群体——例如原住民家庭——但这些群体受益更多这一事实意味着，项目实际上并未赋予他们更高的福利权重。我们还发现证据表明，该政策对结果的评价不同于家庭。PROGRESA 案例说明了该方法如何使审查现有政策、并设计更符合价值取向的未来政策成为可能。

title: The Origins and Control of Forest Fires in the Tropics
abstract: Environmental externalities—uncompensated damages imposed on others—lie at the root of climate change, pollution, deforestation and biodiversity loss. Empirical evidence is limited, however, as to how externalities drive private decision making. We study one such behaviour, illegal tropical forest fires, using 15 years of daily satellite data covering over 107,000 fires across Indonesia. Weather-induced variation in fire spread risk and variation in who owns surrounding land allow us to identify how far externalities influence the decision to use fire. Relative to when all spread risks are internalized, we find that firms overuse fire when surrounded by unleased government lands where property rights are weak. In contrast, and consistent with the Coase Theorem, firms treat risks to nearby private concessions similarly to risks to their own land. Government sanctions, concentrated on fires spreading to populated areas, also deter fires, consistent with Pigouvian deterrence.
title_cn: 热带森林火灾的成因与控制
abstract_cn: 环境外部性——对他人施加而未获补偿的损害——是气候变化、污染、森林砍伐和生物多样性丧失的根源。然而，关于外部性如何驱动私人决策的经验证据仍有限。我们研究一种此类行为，即非法热带森林火灾，使用覆盖印度尼西亚超过107,000起火灾的15年逐日卫星数据。由天气引致的火势蔓延风险变化，以及周围土地所有者的差异，使我们能够识别外部性在多大程度上影响用火决策。相对于所有蔓延风险都被内部化的情形，我们发现，当企业周围是产权薄弱的未租让政府土地时，企业会过度用火。相反，与科斯定理一致，企业对邻近私人特许经营地的风险的处理方式，与对其自有土地风险的处理方式相似。集中于蔓延至人口密集地区的火灾的政府制裁也能抑制火灾，这与庇古式威慑相一致。

title: Patents, News, and Business Cycles
abstract: We exploit information in patent applications to construct an instrumental variable for the identification of technology news shocks that relaxes all the identifying assumptions traditionally used in the literature. The instrument recovers news shocks that have no effect on aggregate productivity in the short-run, but are a significant driver of its trend component. The shock prompts a broad-based expansion in anticipation of the future increase in total factor productivity (TFP), with output, consumption, and investment all rising well before any material increase in TFP is recorded. Despite the positive conditional comovements, the shock only accounts for a modest share of fluctuations of macroeconomic aggregates at business cycle frequencies. Financial markets price-in news shocks on impact, while most of the macro aggregates respond with some delay.
title_cn: 专利、消息与经济周期
abstract_cn: 我们利用专利申请中的信息构建了一个工具变量，用于识别技术消息冲击，并放松了文献中传统使用的所有识别假设。该工具变量识别出的消息冲击在短期内对总量生产率没有影响，但却是其趋势成分的重要驱动因素。该冲击会引发广泛扩张，以预期未来全要素生产率（TFP）上升；产出、消费和投资均在 TFP 出现任何实质性上升之前就已明显上升。尽管存在正向的条件联动，该冲击只能解释商业周期频率上宏观经济总量波动的一小部分。金融市场在冲击发生时即将其定价，而大多数宏观总量则滞后一段时间才作出反应。

title: What’s My Employee Worth? The Effects of Salary Benchmarking
abstract: Firms are allowed to use aggregate data on market salaries to set pay, a practice known as salary benchmarking. Using national payroll data, we study firms that gain access to a tool that reveals market benchmarks for each job title. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the benchmark information reduces salary dispersion by 25%. Thus, salary dispersion must stem partly from aggregate uncertainty about the salaries offered by other firms. Our model formalizes how salary dispersion can arise even in competitive labour markets for identical workers when such uncertainty exists, and we discuss implications for an ongoing policy debate.
title_cn: 我的员工值多少？薪酬基准比较的影响
abstract_cn: 企业被允许使用关于市场薪酬的总体数据来设定薪酬，这种做法被称为薪酬基准化（salary benchmarking）。利用全国工资单数据，我们研究了获得一种工具的企业，该工具揭示每个职位的市场基准。使用双重差分设计，我们发现基准信息使薪酬离散度降低了25%。因此，薪酬离散度必定部分源于关于其他企业所提供薪酬的总体不确定性。我们的模型形式化了：当这种不确定性存在时，即使对于同质劳动者而言处于竞争性劳动力市场，薪酬离散度也可能产生；我们还讨论了其对正在进行的政策辩论的含义。

title: The Effect of Provider Diversity on Racial Health Disparities: Evidence from the Military
abstract: We assess the relationship between the racial diversity of medical providers and racial health disparities in the use of preventive care and in patient outcomes. We use unique data from the Military Health System, where we observe providers as patients so that we can identify their race, and where moves across bases change exposure to provider race in a plausibly exogenous fashion. We consider patients with four chronic, deadly, but manageable illnesses, where the relationship with the provider may have the most direct impact on health. We find striking evidence that provider racial diversity leads to reduced disparities in maintenance of preventive care and mortality.

title: The Surrogate Index: Combining Short-Term Proxies to Estimate Long-Term Treatment Effects More Rapidly and Precisely
abstract: A common challenge in estimating the impact of interventions (e.g. job training programmes, educational programmes) is that many outcomes of interest (e.g. lifetime earnings or other labour market outcomes) are observed with a long delay. In biomedical settings, this is often addressed by using short-term outcomes as so-called “surrogates” for the outcome of interest, e.g. tumour size as a surrogate for mortality in cancer studies. We build on this literature by combining multiple, possibly qualitatively distinct, short-term outcomes (e.g. short-run earnings and employment indicators) systematically into a “surrogate index”. Under the Prentice surrogacy assumption, which requires that the primary outcome is independent of the treatment conditional on the surrogates, we show that the average treatment effect on the surrogate index equals the treatment effect on the long-term outcome. We also relate the surrogacy assumption to a set of structural, causal assumptions. We then characterize the bias that arises from violations of each of the key assumptions, and we provide simple methods to validate these assumptions using additional observed outcomes. We apply our method to analyse the long-term impacts of a multi-site job training experiment in California. Rather than waiting a full 9 years to directly observe the long-term impact, we show that it is possible to use short-term (the first six quarters) outcomes as surrogates. Given the surrogacy assumption one could have estimated the programme’s long-term impacts on mean employment rates using the employment rates observed in the first six quarters, with a 35% reduction in standard errors relative to a simple difference in means estimator based on all 9 years of data.
title_cn: 替代指标指数：结合短期代理变量更快速、更精确地估计长期处理效应
abstract_cn: 估计干预（如职业培训项目、教育项目）影响时的一个常见挑战是，许多关注的结果（如终生收入或其他劳动力市场结果）需要很长时间才能被观测到。在生物医学情境中，这通常通过将短期结果作为关注结果的所谓“替代指标”来处理，例如在癌症研究中使用肿瘤大小作为死亡率的替代指标。我们在此基础上，将多个可能性质不同的短期结果（如短期收入和就业指标）系统地组合成一个“替代指数”。在 Prentice 替代性假设下，即要求给定替代指标时主要结果与处理独立，我们证明替代指数上的平均处理效应等于长期结果上的处理效应。我们还将替代性假设与一组结构性因果假设联系起来。随后，我们刻画了违背各关键假设时产生的偏差，并提供简单方法，利用额外观测结果来验证这些假设。我们将该方法应用于分析加利福尼亚州一个多地点职业培训实验的长期影响。我们表明，不必等待整整 9 年才直接观测长期影响，而是可以使用短期（前六个季度）结果作为替代指标。在替代性假设下，人们本可以利用前六个季度观测到的就业率来估计该项目对平均就业率的长期影响，相对于基于全部 9 年数据的简单均值差估计量，标准误降低 35%。

title: The Impact of EITC on Education, Labour Market Trajectories, and Inequalities
abstract: As a complement to the federal earned income tax credit (EITC), some states offer their own EITC, typically calculated as a percentage of the federal EITC. In this paper, we analyse the effect of state EITC on education using policy discontinuities at US state borders. Our estimates reveal that an increase in the state EITC leads to a statistically significant increase in the high school dropout rate. We then use a life-cycle matching model with directed search and endogenous educational choices, search intensities, hirings, hours worked, and separations to investigate the effects of EITC on the labour market in the long run and along the transitional dynamics. We show that a tax credit targeted at low-wage (and low-skilled) workers reduces the relative return to schooling, thereby generating a powerful disincentive to pursue long-term studies. In the long run, this results in an increase in the proportion of low-skilled workers in the economy, which may have important implications for employment, productivity, and income inequality. Finally, we use the model to determine the optimal design of the EITC.
title_cn: EITC 对教育、劳动力市场轨迹和不平等的影响
abstract_cn: 作为联邦劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的补充，一些州提供本州自己的 EITC，通常按联邦 EITC 的一定比例计算。本文利用美国州边界处的政策不连续性，分析州 EITC 对教育的影响。我们的估计结果显示，州 EITC 提高会导致高中辍学率出现统计上显著的上升。随后，我们构建一个包含定向搜寻的生命周期匹配模型，并将教育选择、搜寻强度、雇佣、工作小时和离职内生化，以考察 EITC 在长期以及沿转移动态对劳动力市场的影响。我们表明，面向低工资（和低技能）劳动者的税收抵免会降低教育的相对收益率，从而对接受长期教育形成强烈负向激励。长期来看，这会提高经济中低技能劳动者的比例，并可能对就业、生产率和收入不平等产生重要影响。最后，我们利用该模型确定 EITC 的最优设计。

title: Sanctions and the Exchange Rate
abstract: Trade wars and financial sanctions are again becoming an increasingly common part of the international economic landscape, and the dynamics of the exchange rate are often used in real time to evaluate the effectiveness of sanctions and policy responses. We show that sanctions limiting a country’s exports or freezing its assets depreciate the exchange rate, while sanctions limiting imports appreciate it, even when both types of policies have exactly the same effect on real allocations, including household welfare and government fiscal revenues. Beyond the direct effect from sanctions, increased precautionary savings in foreign currency also depreciate the exchange rate when they are not offset by the sale of official reserves or financial repression of foreign-currency savings. We show that the dynamics of the ruble exchange rate following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 are quantitatively consistent with the combined effects of these forces calibrated to the observed sanctions and government policies. We evaluate the associated welfare, fiscal and inflationary consequences for both Russia and the coalition of Western countries.
title_cn: 制裁与汇率
abstract_cn: 贸易战和金融制裁再次日益成为国际经济格局中更常见的组成部分，而汇率动态常被实时用于评估制裁和政策应对的有效性。我们表明，限制一国出口或冻结其资产的制裁会使汇率贬值，而限制进口的制裁会使汇率升值，即使这两类政策对实际配置——包括家庭福利和政府财政收入——具有完全相同的影响。除制裁的直接效应外，外币预防性储蓄增加也会使汇率贬值，前提是这些储蓄未被出售官方储备或对外币储蓄的金融抑制所抵消。我们表明，2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后卢布汇率的动态，在数量上与根据观察到的制裁和政府政策校准的这些力量共同效应一致。我们评估了这些效应对俄罗斯和西方国家联盟相关的福利、财政和通胀后果。

title: Religion, Education, and the State
abstract: This paper explores how state and religious providers of education compete during the nation building process. Using novel administrative data, we characterize the evolution of Indonesia’s Islamic education system and religious school choice after the introduction of mass public primary schooling in the 1970s. Funded through informal taxation, Islamic schools competed with the state by entering in the same markets. While primary enrollment shifted towards state schools, religious education increased overall as Islamic schools absorbed growing demand for secondary education. In the short run, electoral support for the secular regime weakened in markets with greater public school construction. Over the long run, Islamic schools established at this juncture are more differentiated in terms of religious curriculum, and cohorts exposed to mass public schooling as children are more invested in religion than in the national identity. Our findings offer a new perspective on the political economy of education reforms and the emergence of parallel systems of public goods provision.
title_cn: 宗教、教育与国家
abstract_cn: 本文考察在国家建构过程中，国家与宗教教育提供者如何竞争。我们利用新的行政数据，刻画了20世纪70年代大规模公立小学教育引入之后，印尼伊斯兰教育体系与宗教学校选择的演变。伊斯兰学校通过非正式税收获得资金，并通过进入相同市场与国家展开竞争。尽管小学入学转向公立学校，但随着伊斯兰学校吸收了不断增长的中等教育需求，宗教教育总体上有所增加。短期内，在公立学校建设更多的市场中，对世俗政权的选举支持有所减弱。从长期看，在这一节点建立的伊斯兰学校在宗教课程上更具区分度，而童年时期受到大规模公立学校教育影响的队列，对宗教的投入高于对国家认同的投入。我们的发现为教育改革的政策经济学以及并行的公共品供给体系的出现提供了新的视角。

title: Homeownership, Polarization, and Inequality
abstract: Why are job polarization and income inequality higher in large U.S. cities? I offer a new explanation: when house prices grow faster in large cities, middle-income households increasingly cannot afford to own a house there. They move to smaller cities and the middle of the income distribution in large cities hollows out, making them more polarized and unequal. I document that (1) cities with higher price growth experienced larger polarization and increase in inequality since 1980 and (2) middle-income households migrate more often to cheaper locations for housing-related reasons than low- or high-income households. Using a spatial equilibrium model with tenure choice and skill heterogeneity, I find that excess growth of prices relative to incomes and rents in large cities accounts for nearly all of the gap in polarization and almost one-half of the gap in inequality growth between large and small cities from 1980 to 2019.
title_cn: 住房自有、极化与不平等
abstract_cn: 为什么美国大城市的就业极化和收入不平等更高？我提出一种新的解释：当大城市房价增长更快时，中等收入家庭越来越无力在当地拥有住房。他们迁往较小城市，大城市收入分布的中间部分被掏空，使这些城市更加极化和不平等。我记录了：(1) 自1980年以来，房价增长更快的城市经历了更大程度的极化和不平等上升；(2) 中等收入家庭因住房相关原因迁往更便宜地点的频率高于低收入或高收入家庭。利用一个包含租买选择和技能异质性的空间均衡模型，我发现，大城市房价相对于收入和租金的超额增长，解释了大城市与小城市之间自1980年至2019年极化差距的几乎全部，以及不平等增长差距的近一半。

title: Policy Diffusion and Polarization across U.S. States
abstract: Economists have studied the impact of numerous state laws, from welfare rules to voting ID requirements. Yet for all this policy evaluation, what do we know about policy diffusion—how these policies are introduced and spread from state to state? We present a series of facts based on a data set of 602 U.S. state policies spanning the past seven decades. First, proxies of state capacity do not predict a higher likelihood of innovating new policies, but the political leaning of the state does predict a higher likelihood of introducing partisan laws since 1990. Second, the diffusion of policies from 1950 to 2000 is best predicted by proximity—a state is more likely to adopt a policy if nearby states have already done so—as well as similarity in voter policy preferences. Third, since 2000, party alignment has become the strongest predictor of diffusion, and the speed of adoption has increased. Models of learning and correlated preferences can account for the earlier patterns, but the findings for the last two decades indicate a sharply increasing role of party control. We conclude that party polarization has emerged as a key factor recently for policy adoption, plausibly leading to a worse match between state policies and voter preferences.
title_cn: 美国各州之间的政策扩散与极化
abstract_cn: 经济学家研究了大量州法律的影响，从福利规则到投票身份证要求。然而，尽管有这些政策评估，我们对政策扩散——这些政策如何被引入并从一个州传播到另一个州——又了解多少？我们基于涵盖过去七十年、包含602项美国州政策的数据集呈现了一系列事实。第一，州能力的代理变量并不能预测更高的创新新政策可能性，但自1990年以来，州的政治倾向确实能预测更高的引入党派性法律的可能性。第二，1950年至2000年的政策扩散最好由邻近性——如果附近州已经采纳某项政策，一个州就更可能采纳该政策——以及选民政策偏好的相似性来预测。第三，自2000年以来，政党一致性已成为扩散的最强预测因素，且采纳速度有所加快。学习模型和相关偏好模型可以解释较早的模式，但过去二十年的发现表明，政党控制的作用急剧上升。我们得出结论：政党极化近来已成为政策采纳的关键因素，并可能使州政策与选民偏好之间的匹配变得更差。

title: Contract Terms, Employment Shocks, and Default in Credit Cards
abstract: Regulatory concerns over a tension between expanding financial access and limiting default have led to significant restrictions on contract terms in a number of countries, despite limited evidence on their effectiveness. We use a large nation-wide RCT to examine new borrower responses to changes in interest rates and minimum payments for a credit card that accounted for 15% of all first-time formal loans in Mexico. Default rates were 19% over the 26 month experiment and a 30 pp decrease in interest rates decreased default by 2.5 pp with no effects on the newest borrowers. Doubling minimum payments increased default by 0.8 pp during the experiment but reduced it by 1 pp afterwards, possibly by reducing debt. Matching the experimental sample to their formal employment histories we find that the effect of job separation—more common among new borrowers—on default is seven times larger than the effect of the 30 pp interest rate change. We provide a simple framework for interpreting the experimental results, and rationalize the smaller contract term effects by their limited effects on cash flow rather than by differences in per-peso impacts.
title_cn: 合同条款、就业冲击与信用卡违约
abstract_cn: 监管机构对扩大金融可得性与限制违约之间张力的担忧，已导致若干国家对合同条款施加重大限制，尽管关于这些限制有效性的证据有限。我们使用一项大规模全国性随机对照试验（RCT），考察新借款人对一张信用卡利率和最低还款额变化的反应；该信用卡占墨西哥所有首次正规贷款的15%。在为期26个月的实验中，违约率为19%；利率下降30个百分点使违约率下降2.5个百分点，但对最新借款人没有影响。将最低还款额提高一倍，在实验期间使违约率上升0.8个百分点，但在实验结束后使其下降1个百分点，可能是通过减少债务实现的。将实验样本与其正规就业历史进行匹配后，我们发现，离职——在新借款人中更常见——对违约的影响是30个百分点利率变化影响的七倍。我们提供了一个解释实验结果的简单框架，并说明较小的合同条款效应应归因于这些条款对现金流的影响有限，而非归因于每比索影响的差异。

title: The Value of Information in a Congested Fishery
abstract: We model a fishery with potential congestion, in which firms obtain public and private signals about the location of the densest fish stock. We analytically determine the regions of parameter space where greater precision of public and/or private information increases welfare, and we examine the effects of two types of information sharing. Using high-resolution data from the world’s largest fishery, we estimate the structural model. Point estimates imply that more precise private information raises welfare, whereas more precise public information has a negligible effect on welfare. Moreover, welfare is much more sensitive to changes in the precision of private information than to changes in the precision of public information. This difference reflects the fact that public information increases congestion more than private information does. We also find empirically that a small amount of information sharing can reduce welfare, whereas more extensive information sharing raises welfare, as do information clubs.
title_cn: 拥挤渔场中的信息价值
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个存在潜在拥堵的渔场模型，其中企业获得关于最密集鱼群位置的公共信号和私人信号。我们解析地确定了参数空间中公共信息和/或私人信息精度提高会提升福利的区域，并考察了两类信息共享的影响。利用来自世界最大渔场的高分辨率数据，我们估计了结构模型。点估计表明，更精确的私人信息会提高福利，而更精确的公共信息对福利的影响可忽略不计。此外，福利对私人信息精度变化的敏感程度远高于对公共信息精度变化的敏感程度。这一差异反映了一个事实：公共信息比私人信息更多地增加拥堵。我们还实证发现，少量信息共享可能降低福利，而更广泛的信息共享会提高福利，信息俱乐部亦然。

title: Vanguard: Black Veterans and Civil Rights After World War I
abstract: Nearly 400,000 Black men were drafted into the National Army during World War I, where they toiled primarily as menial laborers in segregated units. Leveraging novel variation from the World War I draft lottery and millions of digitized military and NAACP records, we document the pioneering role these men played in the early civil rights movement. Relative to observably similar individuals from the same draft board, Black men randomly inducted into the Army were significantly more likely to join the nascent NAACP and become prominent community leaders in the New Negro era. We find little evidence that these effects are explained by migration or improved socioeconomic status. Rather, corroborating historical accounts about the catalyzing influence of institutional racism in the military, we show that increased civic activism was driven by soldiers who experienced the most discriminatory treatment while serving their country.
title_cn: 先锋：第一次世界大战后的黑人退伍军人与民权
abstract_cn: 第一次世界大战期间，近40万名黑人男性被征召入国民军，他们主要在种族隔离部队中从事低微的体力劳动。我们利用第一次世界大战征兵抽签带来的新变异，以及数百万份数字化的军队和NAACP记录，记录了这些人在早期民权运动中发挥的开创性作用。相对于来自同一征兵委员会、可观测特征相似的个人，被随机征召入伍的黑人男性显著更有可能加入初生的NAACP，并在新黑人时代成为杰出的社区领袖。我们几乎没有发现证据表明这些效应可由迁移或社会经济地位改善来解释。相反，与关于军队中制度性种族主义具有催化影响的历史记述相印证，我们表明，公民行动主义的增加是由那些在为国服役期间遭受最歧视性待遇的士兵所驱动的。

title: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
abstract: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
title_cn: 美元主导地位与货币政策传导
abstract_cn: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否已使货币政策失效？一种新兴观点认为，如果一国以美元计价其出口，汇率就无法稳定经济活动，因为经典的支出转换渠道被削弱。该观点基于这样一个前提：出口价格以美元计价时具有粘性，从而切断了出口需求与货币贬值之间的联系。但数据并不支持这一假设：以美元计价的商品往往价格更灵活，替代弹性也更高。我们提出一个假设更符合现实的模型，并表明即使采用美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍能显著提振出口和经济活动。任何扩张的限制都不是需求，而是供给能力。我们还表明，汇率向美元价格的传导较低并不能说明价格粘性。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也很小：低传导是均衡结果，而不是名义摩擦的证据。

title: On the Optimal Design of a Financial Stability Fund
abstract: We develop a model of a Financial Stability Fund (the “Fund” henceforth) for a union of sovereign countries. By design, the contract prevents country defaults, as well as undesired expected losses, which in a union translate into excessive risk mutualizations. A participant country has greater ability to borrow and share risks than using sovereign debt financing. The Fund contract also provides better incentives for the country to reduce endogenous risks. These efficiency gains arise from the ability of the Fund to offer long-term contingent financial contracts, subject to limited enforcement and moral hazard constraints. We develop the theory and quantitatively compare the constrained-efficient Fund economy with an incomplete markets economy with default. We calibrate our economy to the euro area “stressed countries” in the debt crisis (2010–2). Substantial welfare gains are achieved, particularly in times of crisis. The Fund is, in fact, a risk-sharing, crisis prevention and resolution mechanism, which transforms the participant countries’ defaultable sovereign debt into the union’s safe assets. In sum, our theory can help to improve current official lending practices and, for example, to eventually design a European Fiscal Fund.
title_cn: 论金融稳定基金的最优设计
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个针对主权国家联盟的金融稳定基金（下称“基金”）模型。该契约在设计上可防止国家违约，也可防止非意愿的预期损失；在联盟中，这类损失会转化为过度的风险共同化。与通过主权债务融资相比，参与国能够以更强的能力借款和分担风险。基金契约还为该国减少内生风险提供了更好的激励。这些效率收益源于基金能够提供长期或有金融契约，但受制于有限执行约束和道德风险约束。我们发展该理论，并将受约束有效的基金经济与存在违约的不完全市场经济进行定量比较。我们将经济校准至债务危机（2010—2012年）中的欧元区“承压国家”。由此实现了显著的福利收益，尤其是在危机时期。实际上，基金是一种风险分担、危机预防与危机解决机制，它将参与国的可违约主权债务转化为联盟的安全资产。总之，我们的理论有助于改进现行官方借贷实践，例如最终设计一个欧洲财政基金。

title: Repurchase Options in the Market for Lemons
abstract: We study repurchase options (repo contracts) in a competitive asset market with adverse selection. Gains from trade emerge from a liquidity need, but private information about asset quality prevents the full realization of trades. In equilibrium, a single repo contract pools all assets. The embedded repurchase option mitigates adverse selection by improving the volume of trades relative to outright sales. However, liquidity provision can be inefficiently low as lenders compete to attract high-quality assets via high haircuts and low rates. The equilibrium has a closed form and aligns well with empirical patterns across Mortgage-Backed Securities repos.
title_cn: 柠檬市场中的回购期权
abstract_cn: 我们研究存在逆向选择的竞争性资产市场中的回购期权（回购协议）。交易收益源于流动性需求，但关于资产质量的私人信息使交易无法充分实现。在均衡中，单一回购协议将所有资产混同。内嵌的回购期权相对于直接出售提高了交易量，从而缓解逆向选择。然而，由于资金出借方通过高折扣率和低利率竞争以吸引高质量资产，流动性供给可能无效率地过低。该均衡具有闭式解，并与抵押贷款支持证券回购中的经验模式高度吻合。

title: A Walrasian Mechanism with Markups for Nonconvex Markets
abstract: We introduce markup equilibrium—an extension of Walrasian equilibrium in which consumers pay a fixed percentage markup over producer prices. In quasilinear markets, markup equilibria exist despite nonconvexities. They are resource-feasible and envy-free, incur no budget deficit, and require little more communication and computation than ordinary Walrasian equilibrium. The associated markup mechanism is asymptotically incentive-compatible. We also introduce a Bound-Form First Welfare Theorem, which states that for any feasible allocation, the welfare loss compared to the first-best is bounded, using any price vector, by the sum of the resulting (i) budget surplus and (ii) rationing losses suffered by the participants. Using producer prices, this bound implies that any markup equilibrium with a small markup and few unallocated goods is nearly efficient.
title_cn: 一个面向非凸市场的带加成瓦尔拉斯机制
abstract_cn: 我们引入加价均衡——瓦尔拉斯均衡的一种扩展，其中消费者在生产者价格之上支付固定百分比加价。在拟线性市场中，尽管存在非凸性，加价均衡仍然存在。它们是资源可行的且无嫉妒的，不产生预算赤字，并且所需沟通与计算仅略多于普通瓦尔拉斯均衡。相应的加价机制是渐近激励相容的。我们还引入界限形式第一福利定理（Bound-Form First Welfare Theorem），该定理表明：对任意可行配置，使用任意价格向量，相对于第一最优的福利损失都可由由此产生的（i）预算盈余与（ii）参与者所承受的配给损失之和给出上界。使用生产者价格时，这一界意味着，任何加价较小且未分配商品较少的加价均衡都近乎有效。

title: Algorithmic Recommendations and Human Discretion
abstract: Human decision-makers frequently override the recommendations generated by predictive algorithms, but it is unclear whether these discretionary overrides add valuable private information or reintroduce human biases and mistakes. We develop new quasi-experimental tools to measure the impact of human discretion over an algorithm on the accuracy of decisions, even when the outcome of interest is only selectively observed, in the context of bail decisions. We find that 90% of the judges in our setting underperform the algorithm when they make a discretionary override, with most making override decisions that are no better than random. Yet the remaining 10% of judges outperform the algorithm in terms of both accuracy and fairness when they make a discretionary override. We provide suggestive evidence on the behaviour underlying these differences in judge performance, showing that the high-performing judges are more likely to use relevant private information and are less likely to overreact to highly salient events compared to the low-performing judges.
title_cn: 算法推荐与人类自由裁量
abstract_cn: 人类决策者经常推翻预测算法给出的建议，但这些自由裁量式推翻究竟是增加了有价值的私人信息，还是重新引入了人类偏差和错误，仍不清楚。我们开发了新的准实验工具，以保释决定为背景，衡量人对算法的自由裁量对决策准确性的影响，即使在所关注结果仅能被选择性观测的情况下也是如此。我们发现，在我们的设定中，90%的法官在做出自由裁量式推翻时表现不如算法，其中大多数人的推翻决定并不优于随机。然而，其余10%的法官在做出自由裁量式推翻时，在准确性和公平性两方面都优于算法。我们提供了提示性证据，说明法官表现差异背后的行为，表明与低表现法官相比，高表现法官更可能使用相关的私人信息，也更不可能对高显著性事件反应过度。

title: Temporal-Difference Estimation of Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
abstract: We study the use of Temporal-Difference learning for estimating the structural parameters in dynamic discrete choice models. Our algorithms are based on the conditional choice probability approach but use functional approximations to estimate various terms in the pseudo-log-likelihood function. We suggest two approaches: The first—linear semi-gradient—provides approximations to the recursive terms using basis functions. The second—Approximate Value Iteration—builds a sequence of approximations to the recursive terms by solving non-parametric estimation problems. Our approaches are fast and naturally allow for continuous and/or high-dimensional state spaces. Furthermore, they do not require specification of transition densities. In dynamic games, they avoid integrating over other players’ actions, further heightening the computational advantage. Our proposals can be paired with popular existing methods such as pseudo-maximum-likelihood, and we propose locally robust corrections for the latter to achieve parametric rates of convergence. Monte Carlo simulations confirm the properties of our algorithms in practice.
title_cn: 动态离散选择模型的时序差分估计
abstract_cn: 我们研究将时间差分学习用于估计动态离散选择模型中的结构参数。我们的算法基于条件选择概率方法，但使用函数近似来估计伪对数似然函数中的各项。我们提出两种方法：第一种——线性半梯度——使用基函数对递归项进行近似。第二种——近似值迭代——通过求解非参数估计问题构造递归项的一系列近似。我们的方法速度快，并且自然允许连续和/或高维状态空间。此外，它们不需要指定转移密度。在动态博弈中，它们避免了对其他参与人行动进行积分，从而进一步提高了计算优势。我们的方案可以与伪最大似然等流行的现有方法结合使用，并且我们为后者提出局部稳健修正，以实现参数收敛速率。蒙特卡洛模拟在实践中证实了我们算法的性质。

title: Supply Chain Disruption and Reorganization: Theory and Evidence From Ukraine’s War
abstract: How do localized conflicts disrupt supply chains and prompt firms to reorganize them? How do these forces affect firm-level and aggregate economic activity? Using firm-to-firm Ukrainian railway-shipment data before and during the 2014 Russia–Ukraine conflict, we document that firms with prior supplier and buyer exposure to the conflict areas substantially decreased their output. Simultaneously, firms reorganized their production linkages away from partners directly or indirectly exposed to the conflict shock. We build a general-equilibrium production-network model with endogeneous link formation, and we show that our model’s sufficient statistics accurately explains the observed relative decline in firm output once we account for network reorganization. Calibrating our model to the Ukrainian economy, we find that the localized conflict decreased aggregate output in nonconflict areas by 5.5%. This effect increases to 8.4% if we abstract from endogeneous link formation, suggesting that production-network reorganization partially mitigates the detrimental, far-reaching aggregate economic costs of conflicts.
title_cn: 供应链中断与重组：来自乌克兰战争的理论与证据
abstract_cn: 局部冲突如何扰乱供应链并促使企业重组供应链？这些力量又如何影响企业层面和总体经济活动？利用2014年俄乌冲突前及冲突期间的乌克兰企业间铁路货运数据，我们发现，此前其供应商和买方暴露于冲突地区的企业产出大幅下降。同时，企业重组其生产联系，使其远离直接或间接暴露于冲突冲击的伙伴。我们构建了一个具有内生连接形成的一般均衡生产网络模型，并表明，在考虑网络重组后，模型的充分统计量能够准确解释观察到的企业产出相对下降。将模型校准至乌克兰经济，我们发现局部冲突使非冲突地区的总产出下降5.5%。如果抽象掉内生连接形成，该效应增至8.4%，这表明生产网络重组部分缓解了冲突带来的不利且影响深远的总体经济成本。

title: Failing Banks
abstract: Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks subject to runs were fundamentally insolvent, barring large value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.
title_cn: 濒临倒闭的银行
abstract_cn: 银行为何倒闭？我们构建了一个覆盖1863年至2024年多数商业银行的面板数据，以研究美国倒闭银行的历史。倒闭银行的特征是资产损失上升、偿付能力恶化，以及日益依赖昂贵的非核心融资。这些共性意味着，利用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标可以高度预测银行倒闭。在存款保险制度建立之前，伴随挤兑的倒闭很常见，但这些倒闭与疲弱的基本面密切相关，这使非基本面挤兑的重要性受到质疑。此外，倒闭银行资产的低回收率表明，多数遭遇挤兑的倒闭银行从根本上已经资不抵债，除非接管处置过程造成大规模价值损毁。总体而言，我们的证据表明，银行倒闭和银行业危机的主要原因几乎总是、并且在任何地方都是银行基本面恶化。

title: Political Foundations of Racial Violence in the Post-Reconstruction South
abstract: Election results act as powerful signals, shaping social behavior in ways that can be dramatic and even violent. This article shows how racial violence in the post-Reconstruction U.S. South was tied to the local performance of the anti-Black Democratic Party in presidential elections. Using a regression discontinuity design based on close presidential vote shares, we find that Southern counties where Democrats lost the popular vote between 1880 and 1900 were nearly twice as likely to experience Black lynchings in the following four years. Despite no corresponding changes in local office holding, these defeats were salient among local elites. We show that Southern newspapers, closely aligned with the Democratic Party, amplified narratives of Black criminality in the aftermath of Democratic losses. Such accusations were, in turn, frequently invoked by lynch mobs. These findings point to the strategic use of racial violence by Democratic elites, foreshadowing the institutionalized vote suppression of Jim Crow.
title_cn: 重建后南方种族暴力的政治基础
abstract_cn: 选举结果作为强有力的信号，会以显著甚至暴力的方式塑造社会行为。本文表明，重建后美国南方的种族暴力与反黑人民主党在总统选举中的地方得票表现相关。基于总统得票份额接近的断点回归设计，我们发现，在1880—1900年间民主党输掉普选票的南方各县，其随后四年发生黑人遭私刑事件的可能性接近翻倍。尽管地方公职任职情况没有相应变化，这些败选仍对地方精英十分显著。我们表明，与民主党紧密结盟的南方报纸在民主党败选后放大了黑人犯罪叙事。这些指控反过来常被私刑暴民援引。这些发现指向民主党精英对种族暴力的策略性使用，并预示了吉姆·克劳制度化的投票压制。

title: Normalizations and Misspecification in Skill Formation Models
abstract: An important class of structural models studies the determinants of skill formation and the optimal timing of interventions. In this article, I provide new identification results for these models and investigate the effects of seemingly innocuous scale and location restrictions on parameters of interest. To do so, I first characterize the identified set of all parameters without these additional restrictions and show that important policy-relevant parameters are point identified under weaker assumptions than commonly used in the literature. The implications of imposing standard scale and location restrictions depend on how the model is specified, but they generally impact the interpretation of parameters and may affect counterfactuals. Importantly, with the popular constant elasticity of substitution (CES) production function, commonly used scale restrictions fix identified parameters and lead to misspecification. Consequently, simply changing the units of measurements of observed variables might yield ineffective investment strategies and misleading policy recommendations. I show how existing estimators can easily be adapted to solve these issues. As a byproduct, this article also presents a general and formal definition of when restrictions are truly normalizations.
title_cn: 技能形成模型中的归一化与错误设定
abstract_cn: 一类重要的结构模型研究技能形成的决定因素以及干预的最优时机。本文为这类模型提供新的识别结果，并考察看似无害的尺度限制和位置限制对目标参数的影响。为此，我首先刻画在没有这些额外限制时所有参数的识别集，并表明重要的政策相关参数在比文献中常用假设更弱的假设下即可点识别。施加标准尺度限制和位置限制的含义取决于模型的设定方式，但它们通常会影响对参数的解释，并可能影响反事实。重要的是，在常用的常替代弹性（CES）生产函数下，常用的尺度限制会固定已识别的参数并导致错误设定。因此，仅仅改变观测变量的计量单位，就可能产生无效的投资策略和误导性的政策建议。我说明现有估计量如何能够很容易地加以调整以解决这些问题。作为副产品，本文还给出了限制在何时真正是归一化的一般且正式的定义。

title: Mentoring and Schooling Decisions: Causal Evidence
abstract: Inequality of opportunity occurs when children of equal academic performance are sent to different-quality schools because their parents differ in socioeconomic status. We demonstrate that children from low–socioeconomic status (SES) families are significantly less likely to enter the academic track, even after conditioning on prior school performance. We then provide causal evidence that a low-intensity mentoring program can improve the education outcomes of low-SES children and reduce inequality of opportunity. Low-SES children randomly assigned to mentors for 1 year are 20% more likely to enter a high-track program. Mentorship affects both parents and children and has positive long-term implications for children’s educational trajectories. The effects are enduring and scalable.
title_cn: 导师指导与就学决策：因果证据
abstract_cn: 机会不平等是指学业表现相同的儿童因父母社会经济地位不同而被送往质量不同的学校。我们表明，来自低社会经济地位（SES）家庭的儿童进入学术轨的概率显著更低，即使在控制此前的学校表现之后也是如此。随后我们提供因果证据，表明低强度导师制项目能够改善低 SES 儿童的教育结果并减少机会不平等。被随机分配接受为期一年导师指导的低 SES 儿童进入高轨项目的概率高出 20%。导师指导同时影响父母和儿童，并对儿童的教育轨迹具有积极的长期含义。这些效应具有持久性且可扩展。

title: Effects of Multigenerational Exposure to Early-Life Advantage: Lessons from a Primate Study
abstract: This paper uses three decades of data on rhesus monkeys to investigate the multigenerational effects of early-life advantage. Monkeys and their offspring are both randomly assigned to be reared together or apart from their mothers. For the first time, we document the intergenerational complementarity of early-life advantage, where the benefits of maternal rearing are present only for offspring of mothers who were themselves mother reared. This illustrates the intergenerational dynamics of social advantage and how the value of an intervention can depend on the experiences of the previous generation. Our paper demonstrates how studies of primates can inform human development.
title_cn: 多代暴露于生命早期优势的影响：来自一项灵长类研究的启示
abstract_cn: 本文利用三十年的恒河猴数据，考察早期生活优势的多代效应。猴子及其后代均被随机分配为与母亲共同抚养或与母亲分离抚养。我们首次记录了早期生活优势的代际互补性：母亲抚养的收益仅存在于那些其母亲本身由母亲抚养的后代中。这揭示了社会优势的代际动态，以及一项干预措施的价值如何可能取决于上一代的经历。本文表明，灵长类动物研究如何为人类发展研究提供启示。

title: A Structural Meta-Analysis of Welfare Reform Experiments and Their Impacts on Children
abstract: Using a model of maternal labor supply and investment in children, this paper synthesizes the findings from three separate welfare reform experiments across six sites. The proposed model maps variation in experimental design to parameters that define labor supply behavior, childcare use, and the importance of money and childcare arrangements in the development of child skills. The estimation procedure—which aggregates available evidence to identify the model’s key causal parameters—amounts to a structural meta-analysis. A number of counterfactuals underscore the utility of this model-based approach for understanding the mechanisms behind treatment effects and the roles played by heterogeneity and selection in shaping impacts.
title_cn: 福利改革实验及其对儿童影响的结构元分析

title: Parenting with Patience: Parental Incentives and Child Development
abstract: We construct a dynamic model of child development where forward-looking parents and children jointly take actions to increase the child’s cognitive and noncognitive skills within a Markov perfect equilibrium framework. In addition to time and money investments in their child, parents also choose whether to use explicit incentives to increase the child’s self-investment, which may reduce the child’s future intrinsic motivation to invest by reducing the child’s discount factor. We use the estimated model parameters to show that the use of extrinsic motivation has large costs in terms of the child’s future incentives to invest in themselves.

title: Child Skill Production: Accounting for Parental and Market-Based Time and Goods Investments
abstract: Families invest time, home goods/services, and market-based childcare in their children. We study these investments, focusing on the role of parental human capital and the substitutability of inputs in skill production. We develop a relative demand estimation strategy that uses intratemporal optimality to estimate the substitutability and relative productivity of inputs. We show how relative demand restrictions simplify and improve estimation of the dynamics of skill production. We estimate the skill production technology for American children aged 5–12, finding moderately strong complementarity between inputs and little difference in the technology by parental education. Counterfactual simulations show that estimated input complementarity has important implications for policies that subsidize inputs or provide free childcare.
title_cn: 儿童技能生产：纳入父母与市场化的时间及物品投资
abstract_cn: 家庭在子女身上投入时间、家庭用品和服务以及市场化儿童照护。我们研究这些投入，重点关注父母人力资本的作用以及技能生产中投入品的可替代性。我们提出一种相对需求估计策略，利用期内最优性来估计投入品的可替代性和相对生产率。我们展示相对需求约束如何简化和改进对技能生产动态的估计。我们估计了5–12岁美国儿童的技能生产技术，发现投入品之间具有中等强度的互补性，且技能生产技术因父母教育程度不同而差异很小。反事实模拟表明，估计出的投入品互补性对补贴投入品或提供免费儿童照护的政策具有重要含义。

title: Why Don’t Struggling Students Do Their Homework? Disentangling Motivation and Study Productivity as Drivers of Human Capital Formation
abstract: Using field experimental data (study time tracking and randomized incentives), we identify a structural model of learning. Student effort is influenced by external costs/benefits and unobserved heterogeneity: motivation (willingness to study) and productivity (conversion rate of time into skill). We estimate academic labor supply elasticities and skill technology. Productivity and motivation are uncorrelated. Low productivity, not low motivation, is the stronger predictor of academic struggles. School quality augments productivity and accelerates skill production. We find that dynamic skill complementarities arise mainly from children’s aging and from a feedback loop between investment activity and productivity rather than from carrying forward past skill stocks.
title_cn: 为什么学习困难学生不完成作业？区分动机与学习生产率作为人力资本形成的驱动因素
abstract_cn: 我们利用田野实验数据（学习时间追踪和随机激励），识别出一个学习结构模型。学生努力受外部成本/收益和不可观测异质性影响：动机（学习意愿）和生产率（将时间转化为技能的转化率）。我们估计了学业劳动供给弹性和技能生产技术。生产率与动机不相关。低生产率而非低动机是学业困难更强的预测因素。学校质量会提高生产率并加速技能生产。我们发现，动态技能互补性主要源于儿童年龄增长，以及投资活动与生产率之间的反馈回路，而非源于既往技能存量的结转。
